--[[
	Part-Icles Core  -  runtime engine.

	Call :Activate() once at script start to connect the Heartbeat loop.
	Call :Deactivate() at teardown to disconnect + clean up active emits.

	---- Emit (one item, no recursion) ----
	:Emit(item, link?, emitCtx?)
	   Fires one immediate emit on `item` (BasePart / Attachment / Model / Beam / etc.).
	   Use :AbsoluteEmit when you want children to fire too.

	:EmitAnimate(item, link?, emitCtx?)
	   Starts one Animate cycle on `item`. Visual animates in place (3D types) or
	   spawns a singleton clone (Screen / ImageLabel).

	:EnableEmit(item, link?, emitCtx?)
	   Honors authored EmitCount + EmitDelay + EmitDuration attributes. Fires the
	   burst then runs the loopBody for EmitDuration seconds.

	:EnableEmitAt(item, originCF, options?)
	   Like :EnableEmit but spawns from `originCF` instead of `item`'s authored CFrame.
	   Supports BasePart / Attachment / Model only. options = { ChainCtx, OriginResolver,
	   UseFullOrigin, IgnoreLink }. UseFullOrigin defaults true (includes rotation);
	   IgnoreLink defaults false (respects authored Link weld).

	---- Recursive emit (item + all descendants) ----
	:AbsoluteEmit(item, _parentFiredPE?, emitCtx?) -> duration: number?
	   Fires every emitter under `item` (transformed items via :EnableEmit, raw PE / Trail
	   / Beam via native APIs). Walks the descendant tree, deduping via _parentFiredPE.
	   Returns total real-time duration in seconds (or nil for infinite  -  AnimateLoop
	   unbounded, Timescale stuck at 0). Pair with .await(n) for an emit-and-wait pattern.

	:AbsoluteEmitAt(item, originCF, options?) -> duration: number?
	   Recursive form of :EnableEmitAt. Same emitCtx threading as :AbsoluteEmit; transformed
	   descendants spawn from `originCF` instead of their authored CFrame. Raw types in the
	   tree emit from their authored position (origin override is BasePart/Attachment/Model
	   only). Returns total duration (or nil for infinite).

	---- Enable / Disable (no emit  -  just on/off state) ----
	:Enable(item, link?, duration?, emitCtx?)
	   Starts the continuous-emit loopBody for `duration` seconds (defaults to math.huge).
	   Animate-mode short-circuits to AnimateLoop=true + :EmitAnimate.

	:Disable(item)
	   Stops all activity on `item`: cancels loops, clears Active tables, sets cfg.Enabled=false,
	   cancels PE/Trail native gens, sets raw Beam/Highlight descendants Enabled=false.

	:AbsoluteEnable(item)
	   Recursive enable. Transformed item → cfg.Enabled=true + :Enable(math.huge), sets
	   _PartIclePlaying gate so the EnabledLoop listener doesn't double-fire. Raw PE / Trail
	   / Beam / Highlight descendants get Enabled=true. Containers (Folder, Model, BasePart)
	   walk children with the covered flag so descendants aren't double-toggled.

	:AbsoluteDisable(item)
	   Recursive disable. Transformed item → :Disable. Raw PE / Trail / Beam / Highlight
	   descendants get Enabled=false. Symmetric to :AbsoluteEnable.

	---- Timescale (per-particle time distortion) ----
	:SetTimescale(item, scale, duration?, permanent?)
	   Override Timescale to `scale` for `duration` seconds (or until next ClearTimescale
	   if `permanent`). Wins over authored Timescale graph during its window.

	:ClearTimescale(item)
	   Remove the override; authored Timescale graph (or 1) resumes.

	:AbsoluteSetTimescale / :AbsoluteClearTimescale
	   Recursive variants over `item` + transformed descendants.

	---- Authoring / texture / state ----
	:Transform(part)                                  -  convert into a Part-Icle emitter
	:TransformModel(model, typeDef)                   -  Model variant
	:Preload(root, force?)                            -  pin textures for upcoming emit
	:Deload(root, force?)                             -  release texture pins
	:GetData(item)                                    -  flat data table read from config
	:GetFolder() / :GetPoolFolder()                   -  runtime folder accessors
	:ReapplyLink(pData)                               -  per-frame link CFrame writer

	---- Statics + sub-services ----
	.await(n)                                         -  yields task for n seconds; nil = no-op
	.parseDuration(raw)                               -  parse "min,max" range string to number
	.LinkService                                      -  standalone link-tracking service
	.TransformCompleted                               -  BindableEvent fired post-:Transform

	---- emitCtx ----
	emitCtx (optional table threaded through every emit path):
	  ChainCtx            = { ChainId, Depth } event-chain context
	  EmitIndex           = burst-index (set by EnableEmit's count loop)
	  EmitCount           = burst-count
	  EventOriginCF       = origin override (set by EnableEmitAt / AbsoluteEmitAt)
	  EventOriginResolver = live-resolver function fired at spawn time
	  UseFullOrigin       = bool; AtCFrame includes rotation
	  IgnoreLink          = bool; bypass authored Link weld
]]

local UIS = game:GetService('UserInputService')
local _RunService = game:GetService('RunService')
local ParticlesMod = require(script.Particles)

local Particle = {}
Particle.Beam = {}
-- Focus tracking; connections stored so Deactivate can release them. Client-only.
Particle._focused = true
Particle._unfocusedAt = 0
if _RunService:IsClient() then
	Particle._focusConn = UIS.WindowFocused:Connect(function() Particle._focused = true; Particle._unfocusedAt = 0 end)
	Particle._blurConn = UIS.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function() Particle._focused = false; Particle._unfocusedAt = os.clock() end)
end

-- Engine state.
Particle.ActiveEmits = {}    -- pData array for live clones; Heartbeat walks this
Particle.ActiveLoops = {}    -- item → Enable-loop task thread
Particle.ActiveAnimates = {} -- item → pData (max 1 cycle per source)
-- Chain-driven duration loops run detached so parallel chain fires don't cancel each other.
Particle.ActiveChainLoops = {}
Particle.Connection = nil
Particle._CachedFolder = nil
Particle._engineGen = 0
-- Hard cap on concurrent particles; user Module code still runs at cap.
Particle.MAX_ACTIVE_PARTICLES = 1000
Particle._capWarnLastAt = 0
-- PartLife linger visuals (post-pData) count toward the cap.
Particle._lingerVisualCount = 0

-- Mixin pattern: sub-modules attach methods to Particle.
require(script.GetData)(Particle)
require(script.Transform)(Particle)
require(script.Update)(Particle)
require(script.UpdateBeam)(Particle)
-- Timescale loaded before Emit mixins so Particle._seedTsOverride is attached when those emit-site seed calls run.
require(script.Timescale)(Particle)
require(script.Emit)(Particle)
require(script.EmitAnimate)(Particle)
require(script.EmitModel)(Particle)
require(script.UpdateModel)(Particle)
require(script.PointLight)(Particle)
require(script.Highlight)(Particle)
require(script.TrailEmitter)(Particle)
require(script.ScreenEmit)(Particle)
require(script.ImageEmit)(Particle)
require(script.LinkTrack)(Particle)
require(script.Orientation)(Particle)
require(script.ZOffset)(Particle)
-- Engine mixin owns Activate / Deactivate / GetFolder / GetPoolFolder (big Heartbeat
-- callback split out to keep init.luau under the 500-line code cap).
require(script.Engine)(Particle)
-- Lifecycle loaded last (touches earlier mixins).
require(script.Lifecycle)(Particle)

-- Once-per-session warning fired when a public emit-creating method is called
-- before :Activate(). Particles will be created but the Heartbeat isn't connected,
-- so they'll never advance. Helps scripters spot the missing :Activate() call
-- instead of debugging invisible particles.
function Particle:_warnIfNotActivated(methodName)
	if self.Connection then return end
	if self._notActivatedWarned then return end
	self._notActivatedWarned = true
	warn(string.format(
		"[Part-Icles] :%s() called before :Activate()  -  particles will not update until the engine is activated. Call Particle:Activate() once at startup.",
		methodName
	))
end

-- Apply Orientation + ZOffset on emit frame to avoid a 1-frame snap.
function Particle:_applyEmitVisualPasses(pData)
	local t = pData.Type
	if t ~= "Part" and t ~= "Model" and t ~= "Attachment" then return end
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local camPos = cam and cam.CFrame.Position
	-- Seed _postUpdateCF from spawn pose so frame-1 overlays don't compound on themselves.
	local hasO = pData.Orientation and pData.Orientation ~= "None"
	local hasZ = pData.ZOffset and pData.ZOffset ~= 0
	if hasO or hasZ then pData._postUpdateCF = (t == "Model") and pData.VisualPart:GetPivot() or pData.VisualPart.CFrame end
	if hasO then self:ApplyOrientation(pData, 1/60, camPos) end
	if hasZ then self:ApplyZOffset(pData, camPos) end
end

-- Activate / Deactivate / GetFolder / GetPoolFolder live in Modules/Part/Engine.luau (mixin).

-- One-shot emit. Dispatches to the per-type EmitX. `link` is optional  -  for types that support
-- Linking (Parts / Attachment / Model), pass the instance whose CFrame the emit is tied to.
-- `emitCtx` is an optional context table propagated by the Events runtime + EnableEmitAt:
--   { ChainCtx = {ChainId, Depth}, EmitIndex = 1-based, EventOriginCF = CFrame, IgnoreLink = bool }
-- EventOriginCF + IgnoreLink are honoured by EmitPart / EmitAttachment / EmitModel for origin
-- override. Other types ignore those fields and emit at their authored CFrame.
function Particle:Emit(item, link, emitCtx)
	if not item or not item.Parent then return end
	self:_warnIfNotActivated("Emit")
	-- Hard cap on concurrent particles. Skip the visual emit but let Events.fire's
	-- user-Module spawn continue (Module is spawned separately, not from this dispatch).
	-- Once-per-second warn so a sustained overflow doesn't flood Output with one warn
	-- per dropped emit.
	-- Lingering visuals (PartLife > 0 path in Lifecycle) outlive their ActiveEmits entry
	-- but still consume world resources, so they count against the cap. _lingerVisualCount
	-- is incremented when a visual enters linger, decremented on destroy (or via
	-- _lingerCounted attribute idempotency).
	local cap = self.MAX_ACTIVE_PARTICLES or 1000
	if #self.ActiveEmits + (self._lingerVisualCount or 0) >= cap then
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - (self._capWarnLastAt or 0) >= 1 then
			self._capWarnLastAt = now
			warn(("[Part-Icles] active particle cap (%d) reached  -  new emits skipped (user Module code still runs)."):format(cap))
		end
		return
	end
	if item:IsA("Beam") and item:FindFirstChild("PartIcleProperties") then
		self:EmitBeam(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("Beam") or (item:IsA("Trail") and not item:FindFirstChild("PartIcleProperties")) then
		-- directAccess Beam (BeamNative) or directAccess Trail: no emit pipeline. Schedule the
		-- enable-for-Duration toggle that doEmitOnce uses so API-level Particle:Emit has parity.
		-- Trail's EmitDuration is sometimes a "min,max" string  -  take max for the schedule.
		local raw, d = item:GetAttribute("EmitDuration"), 0
		if typeof(raw) == "number" then d = raw
		elseif raw ~= nil then local m1, m2 = tostring(raw):match("([%-%.%d]+)%s*,%s*([%-%.%d]+)")
			d = (m1 and m2) and math.max(tonumber(m1) or 0, tonumber(m2) or 0) or (tonumber(tostring(raw)) or 0)
		end
		if d > 0 then
			task.delay(item:GetAttribute("EmitDelay") or 0, function()
				if not (item and item.Parent) then return end
				item.Enabled = true
				task.delay(d, function() if item and item.Parent then item.Enabled = false end end)
			end)
		end
	elseif item:IsA("Trail") then
		self:EmitTrail(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("PointLight") then
		self:EmitPointLight(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("Highlight") then
		self:EmitHighlight(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("Attachment") then
		self:EmitAttachment(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("Model") then
		self:EmitModel(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("BlurEffect") then
		self:EmitBlur(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("BloomEffect") then
		self:EmitBloom(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") then
		self:EmitColorCorrection(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("Atmosphere") then
		self:EmitAtmosphere(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("ImageLabel") then
		self:EmitImageLabel(item, link, emitCtx)
	elseif item:IsA("BasePart") then
		self:EmitPart(item, link, emitCtx)
	end
	-- Unknown / unwired types silently no-op.
end

-- Particle:Enable, Particle:Disable, Particle:EmitAnimate, Particle:EnableEmit, and the
-- local cancelAnimation helper live in Modules/Part/Lifecycle.luau (loaded as a mixin above).

-- Recursive fire-everything-under-root. For a transformed item, runs EnableEmit (full emit timing).
-- For a raw ParticleEmitter / Trail, fires its native API directly. Walks descendants so one call
-- on a Folder/Model containing many emitters fires them all. `_parentFiredPE` is an internal flag
-- that prevents double-firing when an ancestor already covered a subtree's native PEs via
-- ParticlesMod.EnableEmit (which internally uses GetDescendants).
local _Duration = require(script.Duration)

-- Yield helper. Companion to Particle:AbsoluteEmit's duration return value.
-- Called as `Particle.await(n)` (no colon). Nil / non-positive durations are no-ops
-- so `Particle.await(Particle:AbsoluteEmit(item))` is safe for infinite-cycle emitters.
function Particle.await(n)
	if n == nil then return end
	if type(n) ~= "number" then return end
	if n <= 0 then return end
	task.wait(n)
end

-- _absoluteEmitFire dispatches the actual emit recursion; AbsoluteEmit wraps it +
-- computes the true wall-clock duration. Split keeps the recursive Activate-warn
-- to fire once at the top level instead of every nested descendant call.
function Particle:_absoluteEmitFire(item, _parentFiredPE, emitCtx)
	if item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
		self:EnableEmit(item, nil, emitCtx)
		return
	end

	-- Engine-session predicate threaded into native PE/Trail helpers so a delayed
	-- :Emit / :Enable doesn't fire after Particle:Deactivate.
	local alive = self:_makeAliveCheck()

	-- Raw ParticleEmitter: fire directly. EmitCount defaults to 1 when the attribute is absent,
	-- matching the Studio Emit button's inline behavior. tonumber coerces string-typed attrs
	-- (e.g. EmitCount="5" set via Studio's attribute UI) so the `<= 0` comparison can't error.
	if item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
		if _parentFiredPE then return end
		local count = tonumber(item:GetAttribute("EmitCount")) or 1
		local emitDelay = tonumber(item:GetAttribute("EmitDelay")) or 0
		local emitDuration = tonumber(item:GetAttribute("EmitDuration")) or 0
		-- Zero-as-zero  -  see Modules/Part/Particles.luau.
		if count <= 0 and emitDuration <= 0 then return end
		-- Capture the native gen at schedule time so an AbsoluteDisable during EmitDelay
		-- invalidates this delayed start instead of resurrecting the emitter past the delay.
		local scheduledGen = ParticlesMod.ReadNativeGen(item)
		local function doEmit()
			if not alive() or not ParticlesMod.IsNativeGenCurrent(item, scheduledGen) then return end
			if count > 0 then item:Emit(count) end
			-- SetEnabledForDuration schedules a native-gen-tokened delayed-off so the
			-- cleanup still runs even after engine death, while a newer emit session
			-- bumping the gen prevents this closure from clobbering its window.
			if emitDuration > 0 then ParticlesMod.SetEnabledForDuration(item, emitDuration) end
		end
		if emitDelay > 0 then task.delay(emitDelay, doEmit) else doEmit() end
		return
	end

	-- Raw Trail: delegate to existing single-instance helper (parses EmitDuration range).
	if item:IsA("Trail") then
		if _parentFiredPE then return end
		ParticlesMod.EnableEmitSingle(item, alive)
		return
	end

	-- Raw Beam: continuous-streak rendering between authored Attachment0 / Attachment1.
	-- EmitDuration attribute gates a timed Enable-for-duration window; absent / zero leaves
	-- the authored Enabled state alone. No EmitCount semantic (Beams stream, not burst).
	if item:IsA("Beam") then
		if _parentFiredPE then return end
		local emitDuration = tonumber(item:GetAttribute("EmitDuration")) or 0
		local emitDelay = tonumber(item:GetAttribute("EmitDelay")) or 0
		if emitDuration > 0 then
			local scheduledGen = ParticlesMod.ReadNativeGen(item)
			local function doEmit()
				if not alive() or not ParticlesMod.IsNativeGenCurrent(item, scheduledGen) then return end
				ParticlesMod.SetEnabledForDuration(item, emitDuration)
			end
			if emitDelay > 0 then task.delay(emitDelay, doEmit) else doEmit() end
		end
		return
	end

	-- Fire native PEs for BaseParts and Attachments.
	-- Skip if a parent already called EnableEmit (which uses GetDescendants, so our PEs are already covered).
	local shouldFirePE = (item:IsA("BasePart") or item:IsA("Attachment") or item:IsA("Model")) and not _parentFiredPE
	if shouldFirePE then ParticlesMod.EnableEmit(item, alive) end

	-- Propagate the "covered" state: if we fired here OR an ancestor fired, children are already
	-- covered. The `or _parentFiredPE` term keeps a suppressed intermediate (e.g. an Attachment
	-- inside an already-fired Part) from clearing the flag  -  descendant PEs would double-fire.
	local firedCovered = shouldFirePE or _parentFiredPE
	for _, child in item:GetChildren() do
		if item:IsA("BasePart") and child:IsA("BasePart") and not child:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
			continue
		end
		self:_absoluteEmitFire(child, firedCovered, emitCtx)
	end
end

-- Recursive emit. Walks `item` + descendants firing every emitter:
--   - Transformed item → :EnableEmit (honors EmitCount + EmitDelay + EmitDuration).
--   - Raw ParticleEmitter → :Emit(count) + Enabled-for-duration window.
--   - Raw Trail → :EnableEmitSingle.
--   - Raw Beam → SetEnabledForDuration.
--   - BasePart / Attachment / Model → ParticlesMod.EnableEmit covers all native PE/Trail
--     descendants at once; recursion threads `firedCovered` so nested raw emitters
--     aren't double-fired.
-- Returns total real-time wallclock duration in seconds across every spawned effect
-- (EmitDelay + EmitDuration + Timescale-distorted Lifetime + PartLife, recursing
-- nested transformed descendants). Returns nil when any branch is effectively infinite
-- (AnimateLoop unbounded, Timescale=0, or Timescale terminal value with wrong sign).
-- Pair with .await(n) for emit-and-wait. emitCtx threads through (see file header).
function Particle:AbsoluteEmit(item, _parentFiredPE, emitCtx)
	self:_warnIfNotActivated("AbsoluteEmit")
	if not item then return 0 end
	self:_absoluteEmitFire(item, _parentFiredPE, emitCtx)
	return _Duration.computeMaxDuration(item, 0)
end

-- Recursive :EnableEmitAt. Two-pass hybrid:
--
-- (A) `item` IS a transformed Part-Icle:
--   Emit via the existing engine pipeline with origin override threaded through
--   emitCtx. No clone of the source  -  engine handles nested transformed descendants
--   automatically via the standard emit pipeline.
--
-- (B) `item` is a non-transformed 3D container (BasePart / Model / Attachment):
--   Pass 1  -  every transformed Part-Icle descendant emits via engine pipeline with
--   per-node origin override (`originCF * anchor:ToObjectSpace(node.CFrame)`). NO
--   clone of any transformed item. Each Part-Icle's 60+ attributes / RenderTemplate
--   stay in place; only the engine's per-emit Pool.acquireOrClone is invoked.
--   Pass 2  -  clone the container WITHOUT its transformed descendants (stripped from
--   the clone) so only the non-transformed parts + raw PE / Trail / Beam survive.
--   Anchor + PivotTo the clone to originCF, parent into emit folder, fire raw
--   native dispatch on the clone, scheduled destroy after totalDur.
--
-- Result: transformed Part-Icles use the lightweight engine-level origin override
-- (no 60+ attribute copy). Raw native emitters get their proper clone-and-place
-- treatment. Repeated calls are independent (each call clones a fresh raw subtree).
--
-- options (optional table):
--   ChainCtx            event-chain context
--   OriginResolver      function() -> CFrame, evaluated at spawn time (live origin)
--   UseFullOrigin       bool; AtCFrame includes rotation. Default true
--   IgnoreLink          bool; bypass authored Link. Default false. Auto-false when Link override set
--   Link                Instance; per-call Link target override
--   LinkMode            string; "Follow" / "Pivot" / "Weld" / "WeldWithoutRotation"
--   EmitParent          Instance; per-call emit-folder override
--
-- Returns total real-time duration (or nil for infinite). Pair with .await(n).
function Particle:AbsoluteEmitAt(item, originCF, options)
	self:_warnIfNotActivated("AbsoluteEmitAt")
	if not item or not originCF then return 0 end
	options = options or {}
	local totalDur = _Duration.computeMaxDuration(item, 0)

	-- (A) Transformed root: thread emitCtx into the engine pipeline.
	if item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
		local hasLinkOverride = options.Link ~= nil
		local emitCtx = {
			ChainCtx            = options.ChainCtx,
			EventOriginCF       = originCF,
			EventOriginResolver = options.OriginResolver,
			UseFullOrigin       = options.UseFullOrigin ~= false,
			IgnoreLink          = options.IgnoreLink == true and not hasLinkOverride,
			Link                = options.Link,
			LinkMode            = options.LinkMode,
			EmitParent          = options.EmitParent,
		}
		self:EnableEmit(item, options.Link, emitCtx)
		return totalDur
	end

	-- (B) Non-transformed 3D container: hybrid two-pass.
	if not (item:IsA("BasePart") or item:IsA("Model") or item:IsA("Attachment")) then
		return 0
	end

	-- Snapshot anchorCF so per-node origin (Pass 1) + clone reposition (Pass 2) both
	-- reference the same authored pivot baseline.
	local anchorCF
	if item:IsA("Model") then
		local ok, p = pcall(item.GetPivot, item); if ok then anchorCF = p end
	elseif item:IsA("BasePart") then anchorCF = item.CFrame
	elseif item:IsA("Attachment") then anchorCF = item.WorldCFrame end

	local function readWorldCF(it)
		if it:IsA("Model") then local ok, cf = pcall(it.GetPivot, it); return ok and cf or nil end
		if it:IsA("Attachment") then return it.WorldCFrame end
		if it:IsA("BasePart") then return it.CFrame end
		return nil
	end

	local function originFor(node)
		if not anchorCF then return originCF end
		local nodeCF = readWorldCF(node)
		if not nodeCF then return originCF end
		return originCF * anchorCF:ToObjectSpace(nodeCF)
	end

	local function ctxFor(node)
		return {
			ChainCtx            = options.ChainCtx,
			EventOriginCF       = originFor(node),
			EventOriginResolver = options.OriginResolver,
			UseFullOrigin       = options.UseFullOrigin ~= false,
			IgnoreLink          = options.IgnoreLink == true,
		}
	end

	-- Pass 1: per-node origin override for transformed Part-Icles on the ORIGINAL.
	-- Walks down stopping at each transformed leaf (engine pipeline recurses inside
	-- the leaf's RenderTemplate during emit, so we don't recurse past it ourselves).
	local function walkTransformed(node)
		if node:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
			self:EnableEmit(node, nil, ctxFor(node))
			return
		end
		for _, child in node:GetChildren() do
			walkTransformed(child)
		end
	end
	walkTransformed(item)

	-- Internal SkipClone path: caller owns the cloneRoot lifecycle (pool acquire +
	-- positioning + release). Skip Pass 2's clone+anchor+pivot+destroy block; fire
	-- raw native PE/Trail/Beam descendants in-place on the caller's pre-positioned
	-- subtree. Events.luau uses this so its pool reuse + Folder/PE wrappers stay
	-- intact while still picking up Pass 1's per-node origin override semantics.
	if options.SkipClone then
		ParticlesMod.EnableEmit(item, self:_makeAliveCheck())
		return totalDur
	end

	-- Pass 2: detect raw native emitters not covered by Pass 1. Skip Pass 2 entirely
	-- when nothing raw exists (saves the clone cost for pure Part-Icle containers).
	local function _underTransformedAncestor(desc)
		local cur = desc.Parent
		while cur and cur ~= item do
			if cur:GetAttribute("Transformed") then return true end
			cur = cur.Parent
		end
		return false
	end
	local hasRawEmitter = false
	for _, desc in ipairs(item:GetDescendants()) do
		if (desc:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or desc:IsA("Trail") or desc:IsA("Beam"))
			and not desc:GetAttribute("Transformed")
			and not _underTransformedAncestor(desc) then
			hasRawEmitter = true; break
		end
	end
	if not hasRawEmitter then return totalDur end

	local ok, clone = pcall(item.Clone, item)
	if not ok or not clone then return totalDur end
	pcall(function() clone.Archivable = false end)

	-- Strip transformed descendants from the clone (Pass 1 fired them on the
	-- original; keeping them in the clone would double-fire + waste the clone of
	-- their 60+ attributes).
	for _, desc in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:GetAttribute("Transformed") then pcall(function() desc:Destroy() end) end
	end

	-- Anchor every remaining BasePart in the clone so PivotTo holds.
	if clone:IsA("BasePart") then pcall(function() clone.Anchored = true end) end
	for _, desc in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("BasePart") then pcall(function() desc.Anchored = true end) end
	end

	-- Compute target CFrame. UseFullOrigin=true → originCF as-is. UseFullOrigin=false
	-- → use originCF's position with the container's authored rotation.
	local targetCF = originCF
	if not (options.UseFullOrigin ~= false) and anchorCF then
		targetCF = CFrame.new(originCF.Position) * anchorCF.Rotation
	end
	if clone:IsA("Model") then
		pcall(function() clone:PivotTo(targetCF) end)
	elseif clone:IsA("BasePart") then
		pcall(function() clone.CFrame = targetCF end)
	elseif clone:IsA("Attachment") then
		pcall(function() clone:Destroy() end)
		return totalDur
	end

	clone.Parent = self:GetFolder()
	-- Fire raw dispatch on the stripped clone. Transformed branch in _absoluteEmitFire
	-- is unreachable post-strip; only the raw PE / Trail / Beam / native-walk branches fire.
	self:_absoluteEmitFire(clone, nil, nil)

	-- Destroy clone after full emit window. Cap at 60s for infinite-duration emitters
	-- so the clone doesn't leak when totalDur is nil.
	local destroyDelay = totalDur or 60
	task.delay(destroyDelay, function()
		if clone and clone.Parent then pcall(function() clone:Destroy() end) end
	end)

	return totalDur
end

-- Particle:EnableEmitAt lives in Lifecycle.luau alongside EnableEmit / EmitAnimate /
-- Disable so the emission-control public APIs share a file. Same module-mixin pattern.

-- AbsoluteEnable / AbsoluteDisable live in Lifecycle.luau alongside Particle:Disable so the
-- single-item and recursive-state APIs share a file. Same recursion shape as AbsoluteEmit
-- (Transformed → engine path; raw PE/Trail → native .Enabled; container → walk descendants
-- skipping transformed sub-emitter RTs).

-- Preload / Deload API  -  texture-pin every texture-bearing item under `root`. Use `Preload` before
-- a skill cast so the first emit doesn't stutter on texture decode; `Deload` after the skill is
-- permanently retired to free GPU memory. Only items with `PreloadTexture=true` are touched unless
-- `force=true` is passed, in which case every transformed item / raw PE / raw Trail under root
-- gets pinned regardless of opt-in.
local _TexturePin = require(script.TexturePin)
local function _isPreloadable(i) return i:GetAttribute("Transformed") or i:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or i:IsA("Trail") end
local function _walk(root, force, action)
	if not root then return end
	local function visit(inst)
		if _isPreloadable(inst) and (force or inst:GetAttribute("PreloadTexture") == true) then action(inst) end
		for _, c in inst:GetChildren() do visit(c) end
	end
	visit(root)
end
-- Texture-pin every PreloadTexture=true descendant under `root` so the first emit
-- after Preload doesn't stall on texture decode. `force=true` pins every transformed
-- item / raw PE / raw Trail regardless of opt-in.
function Particle:Preload(root, force) _walk(root, force, _TexturePin.pinSubtree) end
-- Inverse of Preload; releases pinned textures so the engine can free GPU memory.
function Particle:Deload(root, force) _walk(root, force, _TexturePin.unpinSubtree) end

-- Standalone LinkService API. Reuses LinkMode dispatch on arbitrary BaseParts /
-- Models / Attachments  -  independent from the particle emit pipeline.
Particle.LinkService = require(script.LinkService)

-- Mutate the source item's authored Link/EmitParent. Use these for persistent
-- runtime wiring; per-call EnableEmitAt/AbsoluteEmitAt options are ephemeral.

-- target: Instance -> Link.Value + LinkSource="Object"
--         "camera"  -> LinkSource="Camera"
--         nil       -> LinkSource="None" + clear Link.Value
-- mode: optional, "Follow" / "Pivot" / "Weld" / "WeldWithoutRotation"
function Particle:SetLink(item, target, mode)
	if not item or not item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then return end
	if target == "camera" then
		pcall(function() item:SetAttribute("LinkSource", "Camera") end)
	elseif target == nil then
		pcall(function() item:SetAttribute("LinkSource", "None") end)
		local lk = item:FindFirstChild("Link")
		if lk and lk:IsA("ObjectValue") then lk.Value = nil end
	elseif typeof(target) == "Instance" then
		local lk = item:FindFirstChild("Link")
		if not lk then
			lk = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
			lk.Name = "Link"
			lk.Parent = item
		end
		lk.Value = target
		pcall(function() item:SetAttribute("LinkSource", "Object") end)
	end
	if mode then pcall(function() item:SetAttribute("LinkMode", mode) end) end
end

-- parent: Instance -> EmitParent.Value (cloned visuals go there)
--         nil      -> remove EmitParent (engine default emit folder used)
function Particle:SetEmitParent(item, parent)
	if not item or not item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then return end
	if parent == nil then
		local ep = item:FindFirstChild("EmitParent")
		if ep then pcall(function() ep:Destroy() end) end
		return
	end
	if typeof(parent) ~= "Instance" then return end
	local ep = item:FindFirstChild("EmitParent")
	if not ep then
		ep = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		ep.Name = "EmitParent"
		ep.Parent = item
	end
	ep.Value = parent
end

-- Luau autocomplete + IntelliSense: the mixin pattern `require(script.X)(Particle)`
-- attaches methods at runtime, which Luau's static analyzer cannot follow. The cast
-- below tells the analyzer the public shape so users typing `Part:` see every API.
-- Field types are conservative (Instance + any) since most accept multiple authoring
-- types via internal dispatch (BasePart / Attachment / Model / Beam / etc.).
export type ParticleAPI = {
	-- Lifecycle
	Activate: (self: ParticleAPI) -> (),
	Deactivate: (self: ParticleAPI) -> (),
	Enable: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance, link: Instance?, duration: number?, emitCtx: any?) -> (),
	Disable: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance) -> (),
	AbsoluteEnable: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance) -> (),
	AbsoluteDisable: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance) -> (),

	-- Emit
	Emit: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance, link: Instance?, emitCtx: any?) -> (),
	EmitAnimate: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance, link: Instance?, emitCtx: any?) -> (),
	EnableEmit: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance, link: Instance?, emitCtx: any?) -> (),
	EnableEmitAt: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance, originCF: CFrame, options: {[string]: any}?) -> (),
	AbsoluteEmit: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance, _parentFiredPE: boolean?, emitCtx: any?) -> number?,
	AbsoluteEmitAt: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance, originCF: CFrame, options: {[string]: any}?) -> number?,

	-- Timescale
	SetTimescale: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance, scale: number, duration: number?, permanent: boolean?) -> (),
	ClearTimescale: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance) -> (),
	AbsoluteSetTimescale: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance, scale: number, duration: number?, permanent: boolean?) -> (),
	AbsoluteClearTimescale: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance) -> (),

	-- Authoring + utilities
	Transform: (self: ParticleAPI, part: Instance) -> (),
	TransformModel: (self: ParticleAPI, model: Model, typeDef: any) -> (),
	Preload: (self: ParticleAPI, root: Instance, force: boolean?) -> (),
	Deload: (self: ParticleAPI, root: Instance, force: boolean?) -> (),
	SetLink: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance, target: (Instance | string)?, mode: string?) -> (),
	SetEmitParent: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance, parent: Instance?) -> (),
	GetData: (self: ParticleAPI, item: Instance) -> any,
	GetFolder: (self: ParticleAPI) -> Folder,
	GetPoolFolder: (self: ParticleAPI) -> Folder,
	ReapplyLink: (self: ParticleAPI, pData: any) -> (),

	-- Statics
	await: (n: number?) -> (),
	parseDuration: (raw: any) -> number?,
	LinkService: typeof(require(script.LinkService)),
	TransformCompleted: BindableEvent,
	Beam: {[string]: any},
	MAX_ACTIVE_PARTICLES: number,
	ActiveEmits: {any},
	ActiveLoops: {[Instance]: thread},
	ActiveAnimates: {[Instance]: any},
}

return Particle :: ParticleAPI

children.name: AxisLinks
children.source:
--[[
	AxisLinks  -  graph-axis alias pass shared between EmitPart and AnimateLoop refresh.
	When two axes are linked, the follower's graph + seed point at the primary's, so they track
	tick-for-tick. `sanitize` is the chokepoint that filters cross-group / self / chain / cycle.
]]

local AxisLinks = {}

local GRAPH_FOLLOWERS = {"SizeX","SizeY","SizeZ","RotSpeedX","RotSpeedY","RotSpeedZ","PosOffsetX","PosOffsetY","PosOffsetZ"}

-- Same-group axis link metadata. Cross-group links rejected at sanitize.
local AXIS_GROUPS = {
	{"SizeX","SizeY","SizeZ"},
	{"RotSpeedX","RotSpeedY","RotSpeedZ"},
	{"PosOffsetX","PosOffsetY","PosOffsetZ"},
	{"RotX","RotY","RotZ"},
	{"PosX","PosY","PosZ"},
}
local AXIS_GROUP_OF = {}
for _, group in ipairs(AXIS_GROUPS) do
	local set = {}
	for _, a in ipairs(group) do set[a] = true end
	for _, a in ipairs(group) do AXIS_GROUP_OF[a] = set end
end

-- Resolve a follower's link target. Returns nil for no-link / self-link / cross-group / chain / cycle.
local function resolveAxisLink(raw, follower)
	local primary = raw and raw[follower] or nil
	if not primary or primary == "" or primary == follower then return nil end
	local group = AXIS_GROUP_OF[follower]
	if not group or not group[primary] then return nil end
	local primaryLink = raw[primary]
	if primaryLink and primaryLink ~= "" and primaryLink ~= primary and group[primaryLink] then return nil end
	return primary
end

-- Sanitize raw {axisKey -> rawAttrString} into resolved {follower -> primary or nil}.
function AxisLinks.sanitize(raw)
	local resolved = {}
	for _, group in ipairs(AXIS_GROUPS) do
		for _, a in ipairs(group) do resolved[a] = resolveAxisLink(raw, a) end
	end
	return resolved
end

function AxisLinks.applyGraphAxisAliases(graphs, seeds, axisLinks)
	if not axisLinks or not graphs or not seeds then return end
	for _, follower in ipairs(GRAPH_FOLLOWERS) do
		local primary = axisLinks[follower]
		if primary and primary ~= follower and graphs[primary] and seeds[primary] then
			graphs[follower] = graphs[primary]
			seeds[follower] = seeds[primary]
		end
	end
end

-- Range-axis sampler. Primary axes sampled once, linked followers reuse primary's scalar.
-- EvenDistribution: `{axis}Even` + emitCtx → t = i/N (skips Min so circular ranges don't
-- collide at 0/360). N=1 → midpoint.
function AxisLinks.sampleRangeAxes(data, axisLinks, axes, RangeMod, emitCtx)
	local emitIndex = emitCtx and emitCtx.EmitIndex
	local emitCount = emitCtx and emitCtx.EmitCount
	local hasEvenCtx = emitIndex and emitCount and emitCount > 0
	local sampled = {}
	for _, k in ipairs(axes) do
		local primary = axisLinks and axisLinks[k]
		if not primary then
			local even = data[k .. "Even"] == true
			if even and hasEvenCtx then
				local r = data[k]
				local t
				if emitCount == 1 then t = 0.5
				else t = emitIndex / emitCount end
				sampled[k] = r.Min + (r.Max - r.Min) * t
			else
				sampled[k] = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data[k])
			end
		end
	end
	for _, k in ipairs(axes) do
		if sampled[k] == nil then
			local primary = axisLinks and axisLinks[k]
			sampled[k] = (primary and sampled[primary]) or RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data[k])
		end
	end
	return sampled
end

-- AnimateLoop refresh: rebuild Graphs from freshData, re-roll seeds, re-apply axis aliases.
function AxisLinks.refreshLoopGraphsAndSeeds(pData, freshData, GraphMod)
	if not pData.Graphs then return end
	for k, _ in pairs(pData.Graphs) do
		if freshData[k] ~= nil then pData.Graphs[k] = freshData[k] end
	end
	if pData.Seeds then for k, _ in pairs(pData.Seeds) do
		if pData.Graphs[k] then pData.Seeds[k] = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(pData.Graphs[k]) end
	end end
	AxisLinks.applyGraphAxisAliases(pData.Graphs, pData.Seeds, freshData.AxisLinks)
end

return AxisLinks

children.name: Duration
children.source:
--[[
	Duration  -  compute true real-time wallclock for an emit dispatch.
	Honors EmitDelay, EmitDuration ranges, AnimateLoop, PartLife, and Timescale
	graph distortion (numerical integration; piecewise-linear graphs have no closed form).
	Returns nil to signal "effectively infinite" (AnimateLoop unbounded, Timescale=0,
	or Timescale clamps to a sign that never reaches the death boundary).
]]

local Graph = require(script.Parent.Graph)

local Duration = {}

local INTEGRATION_STEPS = 200

local function resolveDuration(raw)
	if raw == nil then return 0 end
	if typeof(raw) == "number" then return raw end
	local vals = {}
	for v in tostring(raw):gmatch("[^,]+") do
		local n = tonumber(v:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"))
		if n then table.insert(vals, n) end
	end
	if #vals == 0 then return 0 end
	if #vals == 1 then return vals[1] end
	return math.max(vals[1], vals[2])
end

-- Wallclock time from spawn to death for one particle authored with the given
-- lifetime + Timescale curve. Two-phase: integrate ts(real_i) for real_i in [0,1]
-- (wall time 0 → lifetime), then if effective hasn't crossed the boundary, extend
-- with the terminal ts(1) value held constant until the boundary is reached.
function Duration.computeTrueLifetime(lifetime, timescaleGraph, seed)
	if not lifetime or lifetime <= 0 then return 0 end
	if not timescaleGraph then return lifetime end

	if Graph.IsStatic(timescaleGraph) then
		local v = Graph.GetStaticValue(timescaleGraph, 1)
		if v == 1 then return lifetime end
		if v == 0 then return nil end
		if v > 0 then return lifetime / v end
		return lifetime / (-v)
	end

	local seed_ = seed or {}
	local ts0 = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(0, timescaleGraph, seed_)
	local reverse = ts0 < 0
	local eff = reverse and lifetime or 0
	local realT = 0
	local dRealT = lifetime / INTEGRATION_STEPS

	for i = 1, INTEGRATION_STEPS do
		local real_i = i / INTEGRATION_STEPS
		local ts = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, timescaleGraph, seed_)
		local prevEff = eff
		eff = eff + ts * dRealT
		if not reverse and eff >= lifetime then
			local frac = (lifetime - prevEff) / (eff - prevEff)
			return realT + frac * dRealT
		end
		if reverse and eff <= 0 then
			local frac = prevEff / (prevEff - eff)
			return realT + frac * dRealT
		end
		realT = realT + dRealT
	end

	-- Phase 2: real_i clamps at 1, ts stays constant at ts(1) per Update.luau math.
	local tsTerminal = Graph.QueryPointsWithTime(1, timescaleGraph, seed_)
	if reverse then
		if tsTerminal >= 0 then return nil end
		return realT + eff / (-tsTerminal)
	end
	if tsTerminal <= 0 then return nil end
	return realT + (lifetime - eff) / tsTerminal
end

-- Returns a lifecycle descriptor for a single item, or nil when the item is not
-- fire-eligible (no count, no duration, not a recognized emitter type).
-- Descriptor fields:
--   emitDelay   = scheduling delay before this item starts firing
--   emitDur     = burst window or continuous-Enable duration in seconds
--   lifecycle   = trailing real-time after emit ends until the last spawned particle dies
--   infinite    = true when this item is unbounded (AnimateLoop without EmitDuration,
--                 or Timescale that never reaches the death boundary)
function Duration.computeItemLifecycle(item)
	if item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
		local config = item:FindFirstChild("PartIcleProperties")
		local emitDelay = item:GetAttribute("EmitDelay") or 0
		local emitDur = resolveDuration(item:GetAttribute("EmitDuration"))
		local rawCount = item:GetAttribute("EmitCount")
		local count = rawCount == nil and 1 or rawCount
		local emissionMode = item:GetAttribute("EmissionMode") or "Emit"
		local animateLoop = item:GetAttribute("AnimateLoop") == true

		if emissionMode == "Animate" and animateLoop and emitDur <= 0 then
			return { emitDelay = emitDelay, emitDur = 0, lifecycle = 0, infinite = true }
		end
		local fires = (count > 0) or (emitDur > 0) or (emissionMode == "Animate")
		if not fires then return nil end

		local lifetime = config and config:GetAttribute("Lifetime")
		local lifetimeMax = 0
		if typeof(lifetime) == "NumberRange" then lifetimeMax = lifetime.Max
		elseif type(lifetime) == "number" then lifetimeMax = lifetime end

		local timescale = config and config:GetAttribute("Timescale")
		local trueLife = Duration.computeTrueLifetime(lifetimeMax, timescale, nil)
		if trueLife == nil then
			return { emitDelay = emitDelay, emitDur = emitDur, lifecycle = 0, infinite = true }
		end

		local partLife = (config and config:GetAttribute("PartLife")) or 0
		-- Animate mode runs at minimum one full lifecycle even with EmitDuration=0.
		if emissionMode == "Animate" and trueLife > emitDur then emitDur = trueLife end

		return { emitDelay = emitDelay, emitDur = emitDur, lifecycle = trueLife + partLife, infinite = false }
	end

	if item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
		local rawCount = item:GetAttribute("EmitCount")
		local count = rawCount == nil and 1 or rawCount
		local emitDelay = tonumber(item:GetAttribute("EmitDelay")) or 0
		local emitDur = tonumber(item:GetAttribute("EmitDuration")) or 0
		if count <= 0 and emitDur <= 0 then return nil end
		local life = item.Lifetime
		local lifeMax = (typeof(life) == "NumberRange" and life.Max) or 0
		return { emitDelay = emitDelay, emitDur = emitDur, lifecycle = lifeMax, infinite = false }
	end

	if item:IsA("Trail") then
		local tDelay = item:GetAttribute("EmitDelay") or 0
		local tDur = resolveDuration(item:GetAttribute("EmitDuration"))
		if tDur <= 0 then return nil end
		return { emitDelay = tDelay, emitDur = tDur, lifecycle = item.Lifetime or 0, infinite = false }
	end

	if item:IsA("Beam") then
		local bDelay = tonumber(item:GetAttribute("EmitDelay")) or 0
		local bDur = tonumber(item:GetAttribute("EmitDuration")) or 0
		if bDur <= 0 then return nil end
		return { emitDelay = bDelay, emitDur = bDur, lifecycle = 0, infinite = false }
	end

	return nil
end

-- Recursive walk. Returns the max finish-time across this item and its emit-eligible
-- descendants, OR nil if any branch is infinite. Mirrors EmitDispatch.descendantMaxEmitTime
-- traversal: transformed-no-op short-circuits subtree, RenderTemplate children only
-- recurse into transformed descendants (nested per-clone emitters).
function Duration.computeMaxDuration(item, accumDelay)
	if not item then return 0 end
	accumDelay = accumDelay or 0

	local info = Duration.computeItemLifecycle(item)
	local myFinish = 0
	local childAccum = accumDelay
	local skipChildren = false

	if info then
		if info.infinite then return nil end
		myFinish = accumDelay + info.emitDelay + info.emitDur + info.lifecycle
		childAccum = accumDelay + info.emitDelay
		if item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
			-- Transformed-but-no-fire would have returned nil above; non-fire descendants
			-- inside a transformed item don't run as their own AbsoluteEmit.
		end
	else
		if item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
			skipChildren = true
		end
	end

	if not skipChildren then
		for _, child in ipairs(item:GetChildren()) do
			if child.Name == "RenderTemplate" then
				for _, desc in ipairs(child:GetDescendants()) do
					if desc:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
						local sub = Duration.computeMaxDuration(desc, childAccum)
						if sub == nil then return nil end
						if sub > myFinish then myFinish = sub end
					end
				end
			else
				local sub = Duration.computeMaxDuration(child, childAccum)
				if sub == nil then return nil end
				if sub > myFinish then myFinish = sub end
			end
		end
	end

	return myFinish
end

return Duration

children.name: Emit
children.source:
--[[
	Emit Mixin  -  per-type one-shot emit for Part / Attachment / Beam.
	Clones RT, computes initial CFrame + direction, pushes pData onto Particle.ActiveEmits.
	Motion math shared with Motion Preview via PreSimulateForward / PreSimulateAttachmentForward.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local AxisLinksMod = require(script.Parent.AxisLinks)
local ParticlesMod = require(script.Parent.Particles)
local MeshFlipMod = require(script.Parent.Flipbook)
local EventsMod = require(script.Parent.Events)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local Pool = require(script.Parent.Pool)
local NestedEmit = require(script.Parent.NestedEmit)
local StaticPass = require(script.Parent.StaticPass)
local DirectionVectors = Constants.DirectionVectors
local shapeFunctions = Constants.shapeFunctions

-- Walk up the parent chain to find the nearest BasePart. Attachment nested inside
-- Attachment(s) must compose through ancestors; we anchor the visual to the first
-- BasePart so its parent-local CFrame math behaves consistently with sibling-emit types.
local function _findBasePartAncestor(inst)
	local p = inst.Parent
	while p do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then return p end
		p = p.Parent
	end
	return nil
end

return function(Particle)

-- One Part emit. Initial CFrame: link/LinkMode → Shape offset → RotXYZ → Position offset
-- → strip rotation if DirMode=Global. InvertMotion pre-simulates to endpoint.
-- emitCtx (optional): {ChainCtx, EmitIndex, EventOriginCF, EventOriginResolver, IgnoreLink, UseFullOrigin}
-- EventOriginResolver wins over EventOriginCF (live vs snapshot).
function Particle:EmitPart(part, link, emitCtx)
	if not part or not part.Parent then return end
	local data = self:GetData(part)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end
	-- Per-call ctx overrides (set by EnableEmitAt / AbsoluteEmitAt options).
	if emitCtx then
		if emitCtx.LinkMode then data.LinkMode = emitCtx.LinkMode end
		if emitCtx.EmitParent then data.EmitParent = emitCtx.EmitParent end
	end
	if emitCtx and emitCtx.IgnoreLink then
		link = nil
	else
		link = link or data.Link
	end

	local Time = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if Time <= 0 then Time = 0.001 end

	-- Follow drops link rotation; Weld/Pivot compose it.
	local unrotatedCF
	local originOverrideCF
	if emitCtx then
		if emitCtx.EventOriginResolver then originOverrideCF = emitCtx.EventOriginResolver() end
		if not originOverrideCF then originOverrideCF = emitCtx.EventOriginCF end
	end
	if originOverrideCF then
		if emitCtx and emitCtx.UseFullOrigin then
			unrotatedCF = originOverrideCF -- AtCFrame: full source orientation
		else
			-- AtPosition / AtSource: replace position only, keep target rotation.
			unrotatedCF = CFrame.new(originOverrideCF.Position) * part.CFrame.Rotation
		end
	elseif link then
		local lCF = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(link)
		local lPos = lCF.Position
		if data.LinkMode == "Follow" then unrotatedCF = CFrame.new(lPos) * part.CFrame.Rotation
		else unrotatedCF = CFrame.new(lPos) * lCF.Rotation * part.CFrame.Rotation end
	else unrotatedCF = part.CFrame end
	local dirInfo = DirectionVectors[data.EmissionDirection] or DirectionVectors[Enum.NormalId.Top]
	local rawWorldDirection = unrotatedCF[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier

	-- Shape branch. UseShape gates; shape function returns offset / rotation / outward direction.
	-- ShapePart override: when set, sample volume + spawn position in ShapePart's frame.
	-- nil falls back to existing source-frame behavior (unrotatedCF).
	local localOffset = Vector3.new()
	local shapeDir = nil
	local initialCF = unrotatedCF
	if data.UseShape then
		local shapeFunc = shapeFunctions[data.ParticleData.Shape]
		if shapeFunc then
			local shapeSrc = data.ShapePart or part
			local shapeCF = data.ShapePart and data.ShapePart.CFrame or unrotatedCF
			local sOffset, sRotation, sDirVec = shapeFunc(shapeSrc, data.ParticleData)
			localOffset = sOffset
			local sio = data.ParticleData.ShapeInOut
			if sio == Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.Inward then
				sDirVec = -sDirVec
			elseif sio == Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.InAndOut then
				if math.random() < 0.5 then sDirVec = -sDirVec end
			end
			shapeDir = (shapeCF - shapeCF.Position):VectorToWorldSpace(sDirVec)
			if data.ParticleData.LookAtInitially then
				local rx, ry, rz = initialCF:ToEulerAnglesXYZ()
				initialCF = CFrame.new((shapeCF * CFrame.new(localOffset)).Position)
					* sRotation * CFrame.Angles(rx, ry, rz)
			else
				initialCF = CFrame.new((shapeCF * CFrame.new(localOffset)).Position) * initialCF.Rotation
			end
		else
			initialCF = CFrame.new((initialCF * CFrame.new(localOffset)).Position) * initialCF.Rotation
		end
	else
		initialCF = CFrame.new((initialCF * CFrame.new(localOffset)).Position) * initialCF.Rotation
	end

	local dirMode = data.DirMode or "RigidLocal"
	local rotS = AxisLinksMod.sampleRangeAxes(data, data.AxisLinks, {"RotX","RotY","RotZ"}, RangeMod, emitCtx)
	local RX, RY, RZ = rotS.RotX, rotS.RotY, rotS.RotZ
	local rotXYZ = Constants.composeRotation(data.RotOrder or "Global", RX, RY, RZ)
	initialCF = initialCF * rotXYZ

	initialCF = Constants.applyPositionOffset(initialCF, data, link, part, RangeMod, AxisLinksMod, emitCtx)

	-- Global DirMode: drop emitter+link rotation; keep RotXYZ.
	if dirMode == "Global" then
		initialCF = CFrame.new(initialCF.Position) * rotXYZ
	end

	local baseDirection
	if shapeDir then
		baseDirection = shapeDir
	elseif dirMode == "Local" then
		baseDirection = initialCF[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
	elseif dirMode == "Global" then
		baseDirection = CFrame.new()[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
	else
		baseDirection = rawWorldDirection
	end
	local randomX, randomY = 0, 0
	if data.ParticleData.SpreadAngle.X > 0 or data.ParticleData.SpreadAngle.Y > 0 then
		randomX = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * data.ParticleData.SpreadAngle.X
		randomY = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * data.ParticleData.SpreadAngle.Y
	end
	local spreadRotation = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(randomX), math.rad(randomY), 0)

	local cf = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(), baseDirection)
	cf = cf * spreadRotation
	baseDirection = cf.LookVector

	local seeds = {
		SizeX = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.SizeX), SizeY = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.SizeY), SizeZ = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.SizeZ),
		RotSpeedX = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.RotSpeedX), RotSpeedY = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.RotSpeedY), RotSpeedZ = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.RotSpeedZ),
		PosOffsetX = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PosOffsetX), PosOffsetY = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PosOffsetY), PosOffsetZ = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PosOffsetZ),
		Speed = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Speed), Brightness = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Brightness),
		Transparency = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Transparency),
		AccelStrength = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.AccelStrength),
		Timescale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Timescale),
	}

	-- Axis-link alias: followers adopt primary's seed + graph; mutates data + seeds in-place.
	AxisLinksMod.applyGraphAxisAliases(data, seeds, data.AxisLinks)

	local invertMotion = data.InvertMotion
	local simLocalCFrames = nil
	local simEffectiveTKF = nil

	if invertMotion then
		simLocalCFrames, simEffectiveTKF = self:PreSimulateForward(data, seeds, initialCF, baseDirection, spreadRotation, link, Time, nil, initialCF.Rotation * rotXYZ:Inverse())
	end

	local visualPart = Pool.acquireOrCopyBare(data.RenderTemplate, "Part", data.Pool)
	visualPart.Archivable = false
	local parentCF_now
	if link then
		local lC = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(link)
		-- Only Weld uses full link CFrame; Follow/Pivot keep motion world-space.
		parentCF_now = (data.LinkMode == "Follow" or data.LinkMode == "Pivot") and CFrame.new(lC.Position) or lC
	else parentCF_now = CFrame.new() end
	local localCF

	if invertMotion and simLocalCFrames then
		-- Place at endpoint of forward sim. Index by effective TKF since presim caps at 500.
		local endLocalCF = simLocalCFrames[simEffectiveTKF or data.TotalKeyFrames] or simLocalCFrames[0]
		localCF = endLocalCF
		visualPart.CFrame = parentCF_now * localCF
	else
		localCF = link and parentCF_now:ToObjectSpace(initialCF) or initialCF
		visualPart.CFrame = parentCF_now * localCF
	end

	local pData = {
		Type = "Part",
		VisualPart = visualPart,
		Link = link,
		LinkMode = data.LinkMode,
		-- RigidLocal: snapshot the link's at-emit parent CFrame. Per-frame Link
		-- consumers (LinkTrack / getLinkCF / Bounce) read this instead of the live
		-- link CFrame. nil for non-RigidLocal modes.
		_rigidLocalParentCF = (data.LinkMode == "RigidLocal" and link) and parentCF_now or nil,
		Events = data.Events,
		SpecialMesh = visualPart:FindFirstChildOfClass('SpecialMesh'),
		Decal = visualPart:FindFirstChildOfClass('Decal'),
		-- SurfaceAppearance: flipbook routes to ColorMap, Transparency/Color graphs drive MeshPart
		-- because SurfaceAppearance has no per-instance Transparency / Color3 surface.
		SurfaceAppearance = visualPart:FindFirstChildOfClass('SurfaceAppearance'),

		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = invertMotion and simEffectiveTKF or math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = 0,
		AccumulatedDT = 0,
		LifeTime = Time,
		PartLife = data.PartLife,
		CurrentPosition = visualPart.Position,
		LocalCF = localCF,

		BaseDirection = baseDirection,
		-- Accumulated velocity contribution from Acceleration. Tracked explicitly so OnHit
		-- Bounce can reflect it along the hit normal (a closed-form `accel * elapsedSec`
		-- would keep integrating from t=0 across a bounce, diverging from physics).
		_accelVel = Vector3.zero,
		-- Speed multiplier: scales the speed graph's output. Compounds across bounces
		-- when Bounciness < 1  -  each bounce loses energy along the normal, so the
		-- particle's effective speed decreases on impact.
		SpeedMultiplier = 1,
		-- Persistent angular velocity from collision impulses (deg/sec, world axes).
		-- Bounce's tangential drag converts to spin; this rate compounds with each
		-- glancing impact. _spinAccum tracks the integrated rotation contribution.
		_spinRate = Vector3.zero,
		_spinAccumX = 0,
		_spinAccumY = 0,
		_spinAccumZ = 0,
		EmissionDirection = data.EmissionDirection,
		SpreadRotation = spreadRotation,
		Acceleration = data.ParticleData.Acceleration,
		Drag = data.ParticleData.Drag,
		VelocityVectored = data.VelocityVectored,

		InvertMotion = invertMotion,
		SimLocalCFrames = simLocalCFrames,

		RotMode = data.RotMode or "OverLife",
		RotOrder = data.RotOrder or "Global",
		AccRotX = 0, AccRotY = 0, AccRotZ = 0,

		Orientation = data.Orientation,
		ZOffset = data.ZOffset,
		_localWorldCF = localCF, -- seed for LinkTrack frame 0

		-- PosOffsetX/Y/Z trajectory state. DisplacementMode selects which rotation
		-- to apply: Local = SpawnRotation (post-RotXYZ particle frame); RigidLocal
		-- = SpawnEmitterRotation (same frame as SpawnRotation but with the per-
		-- particle RotXYZ contribution algebraically removed via rotXYZ:Inverse());
		-- Global = no rotation. HasPosOffsetGraphs gates per-frame work.
		SpawnRotation = localCF.Rotation,
		SpawnEmitterRotation = localCF.Rotation * rotXYZ:Inverse(),
		DisplacementMode = data.DisplacementMode,
		-- Body bbox half-diagonal for Jolt-style point-velocity sleep check.
		-- Captures rotation-induced edge speed when CoM is near-stationary.
		_sleepRadius = (visualPart and visualPart:IsA("BasePart") and visualPart.Size.Magnitude * 0.5) or 1.0,
		_prevWorldOff = Vector3.zero,
		HasPosOffsetGraphs = data.PosOffsetX ~= nil or data.PosOffsetY ~= nil or data.PosOffsetZ ~= nil,

		-- Target-accel: target.Position read live each frame, target ref fixed at emit.
		-- Disabled with InvertMotion (cached SimLocalCFrames can't track moving targets).
		HasTargetAccel = data.AccelerationTowardsInstance == true and data.AccelTarget ~= nil and data.AccelStrength ~= nil and not data.InvertMotion,
		AccelTarget = data.AccelTarget,
		TargetVel = Vector3.zero,
		NeedsFullIteration = data.VelocityVectored,
		NeedsRotAccum = (data.RotMode == "Speed") and not data.VelocityVectored,
		HasDrag = data.ParticleData.Drag ~= 0,
		HasAccel = data.ParticleData.Acceleration.Magnitude > 0,
		HasDecal = visualPart:FindFirstChildOfClass('Decal') ~= nil,

		Graphs = {
			SizeX = data.SizeX, SizeY = data.SizeY, SizeZ = data.SizeZ,
			RotSpeedX = data.RotSpeedX, RotSpeedY = data.RotSpeedY, RotSpeedZ = data.RotSpeedZ,
			PosOffsetX = data.PosOffsetX, PosOffsetY = data.PosOffsetY, PosOffsetZ = data.PosOffsetZ,
			Speed = data.Speed, Brightness = data.Brightness,
			Transparency = data.Transparency, Color = data.Color,
			AccelStrength = data.AccelStrength,
			Timescale = data.Timescale,
		},

		Seeds = seeds,
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.Timescale, seeds.Timescale, Time),
	}

	-- 1-frame pop prevention for PosOffset graphs: sample at t=0, apply to spawn
	-- pose so frame-0 visual already includes the initial offset. Initialize
	-- _prevWorldOff to worldOff(0) so the first Update step's delta is measured
	-- from this baseline (not from zero  -  which would cause a teleport at step 1
	-- for front-loaded curves where posOff ramps fast initially).
	if pData.HasPosOffsetGraphs then
		local oX = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetX) or 0
		local oY = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetY) or 0
		local oZ = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetZ) or 0
		local worldOff = Constants.resolveDisplacement(Vector3.new(oX, oY, oZ),
			data.DisplacementMode or "Global", pData.SpawnRotation, pData.SpawnEmitterRotation)
		pData._prevWorldOff = worldOff
		if oX ~= 0 or oY ~= 0 or oZ ~= 0 then
			pData.LocalCF = pData.LocalCF + worldOff
			pData.VisualPart.CFrame = pData.VisualPart.CFrame + worldOff
		end
	end

	-- 1-frame pop prevention.
	local startSize = Vector3.new(GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.SizeX, pData.Seeds.SizeX), GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.SizeY, pData.Seeds.SizeY), GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.SizeZ, pData.Seeds.SizeZ))
	local startTrans = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.Transparency, pData.Seeds.Transparency)
	local startColor = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.Color)
	local startBright = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.Brightness, pData.Seeds.Brightness)

	if pData.SpecialMesh then
		pData.SpecialMesh.Scale = startSize
	else
		pData.VisualPart.Size = startSize
	end

	if pData.SurfaceAppearance then
		-- Color graph tints SA.Color raw; Brightness graph drives SA.EmissiveTint only.
		-- EmissiveTint write pcall-guarded for older Studio builds without the property.
		pData.VisualPart.Transparency = startTrans
		pData.VisualPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(startColor.R * 255, startColor.G * 255, startColor.B * 255)
		pData.SurfaceAppearance.Color = Color3.fromRGB(startColor.R * 255, startColor.G * 255, startColor.B * 255)
		pcall(function() pData.SurfaceAppearance.EmissiveTint = Color3.new(startColor.R * startBright, startColor.G * startBright, startColor.B * startBright) end)
	elseif pData.Decal then
		pData.Decal.Transparency = startTrans
		pData.Decal.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(startColor.R * 255 * startBright, startColor.G * 255 * startBright, startColor.B * 255 * startBright)
	else
		-- Plain MeshPart: Brightness multiplies SA/Decal only.
		pData.VisualPart.Transparency = startTrans
		pData.VisualPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(startColor.R * 255, startColor.G * 255, startColor.B * 255)
	end

	-- Disable PEs BEFORE Parent so they don't auto-emit on workspace entry;
	-- EnableEmitSingle below controls their timing.
	for _, desc in visualPart:GetDescendants() do
		if desc:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then desc.Enabled = false end
	end

	visualPart.Parent = data.EmitParent or self:GetFolder()

	for _, desc in visualPart:GetDescendants() do
		if desc:IsA("Trail") then
			if desc:GetAttribute("Transformed") then continue end
			local underTransformed = false
			local cur = desc.Parent
			while cur and cur ~= visualPart do
				if cur:GetAttribute("Transformed") then underTransformed = true; break end
				cur = cur.Parent
			end
			if underTransformed then continue end
			local dur = desc:GetAttribute("EmitDuration")
			if dur ~= nil then
				if desc.Enabled ~= true then
					desc.Enabled = true
				end
				if desc:GetAttribute("_pooledTrailEnabled") ~= nil then
					desc:SetAttribute("_pooledTrailEnabled", true)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- Restore pooled Trails (deferred 1 Heartbeat). Snapshot was synced above
	-- so this is consistent with our pre-Parent enable for fresh emits.
	Pool.restoreTrails(visualPart, "Part")

	-- EnableEmitSingle schedules the EmitDuration-end Trail.Enabled=false and
	-- the PE Emit(count) burst. Trail.Enabled=true was already set above; this
	-- just registers the disable timer + PE emission.
	local alive = self:_makeAliveCheck()
	for _, child in visualPart:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("Attachment") then ParticlesMod.EnableEmitChildrenAndRepeatForAttachments(child, alive) end
		ParticlesMod.EnableEmitSingle(child, alive)
	end

	if self._parentScaleMap and self._parentScaleMap[part] then
		pData.ParentScale = self._parentScaleMap[part]
	end

	pData._sourceItem = part
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, part)
	if data.Pool ~= false then pData._sourceRT, pData._poolKind = data.RenderTemplate, "Part" end
	-- Static-graph short-circuit: constant-valued graphs nil out + stamp pData._static<Name>.
	StaticPass.apply(pData)
	-- _applyEmitVisualPasses MUST precede _registerEmit (OnEmit payload reads post-pass CFrame).
	self:_applyEmitVisualPasses(pData)
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)

	-- Flipbook target: SA.ColorMap if present, else Decal.Texture, else MeshPart.TextureID
	-- when the visual is a plain MeshPart with no Decal/SA child to write to.
	if data.CachedMeshTextures and #data.CachedMeshTextures > 0 then
		local flipTarget = pData.SurfaceAppearance or pData.Decal
		if not flipTarget and visualPart:IsA("MeshPart") then flipTarget = visualPart end
		if flipTarget then
			MeshFlipMod.Flip(pData, data.ParticleData, data.CachedMeshTextures, flipTarget, Time)
		end
	end

	-- Nested Part-Icles: source-walk; link = visualPart drives position. See NestedEmit.luau.
	pData._nestedAlive = { true }
	NestedEmit.walk(self, data.RenderTemplate, visualPart, pData._nestedAlive, emitCtx)
end

-- Attachment variant  -  sim runs in parent-BasePart-local space. DirMode 3-way split:
-- Local = post-RotXYZ; Global = world axis rebased; RigidLocal = pre-RotXYZ.
function Particle:EmitAttachment(attachment, link, emitCtx)
	if not attachment or not attachment.Parent then return end
	local data = self:GetData(attachment)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end
	if emitCtx then
		if emitCtx.LinkMode then data.LinkMode = emitCtx.LinkMode end
		if emitCtx.EmitParent then data.EmitParent = emitCtx.EmitParent end
	end
	if emitCtx and emitCtx.IgnoreLink then
		link = nil
	else
		link = link or data.Link
	end

	local Time = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if Time <= 0 then Time = 0.001 end

	-- Source world pose composes the full chain (Attachment-in-Attachment-in-BasePart).
	-- WorldCFrame is the only correct read when parent is non-BasePart; .CFrame alone
	-- yields parent-local relative to a non-BasePart frame that breaks compose math.
	local sourceWorldCF = attachment.WorldCFrame
	local worldCF
	local originOverrideCF
	if emitCtx then
		if emitCtx.EventOriginResolver then originOverrideCF = emitCtx.EventOriginResolver() end
		if not originOverrideCF then originOverrideCF = emitCtx.EventOriginCF end
	end
	if originOverrideCF then
		if emitCtx and emitCtx.UseFullOrigin then
			worldCF = originOverrideCF -- AtCFrame: full source orientation
		else
			worldCF = CFrame.new(originOverrideCF.Position) * sourceWorldCF.Rotation
		end
	elseif link then
		local linkWorldCF = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(link)
		if data.LinkMode == "Follow" then
			worldCF = CFrame.new(linkWorldCF.Position) * sourceWorldCF.Rotation
		else
			worldCF = CFrame.new(linkWorldCF.Position) * linkWorldCF.Rotation * sourceWorldCF.Rotation
		end
	else
		worldCF = sourceWorldCF
	end
	-- Walk up to find a BasePart anchor; nested-Attachment source compose through
	-- actualParent's CFrame. All downstream local-space math runs in actualParent-local.
	local actualParent = data.EmitParent or _findBasePartAncestor(attachment) or self:GetFolder()
	local actualParentCF = (actualParent and actualParent:IsA("BasePart")) and actualParent.CFrame or CFrame.new()
	local localCF = actualParentCF:ToObjectSpace(worldCF)
	local dirInfo = DirectionVectors[data.EmissionDirection] or DirectionVectors[Enum.NormalId.Top]

	-- Initial rotation (always applied)
	local dirMode = data.DirMode or "RigidLocal"
	local rotS = AxisLinksMod.sampleRangeAxes(data, data.AxisLinks, {"RotX","RotY","RotZ"}, RangeMod, emitCtx)
	local RX, RY, RZ = rotS.RotX, rotS.RotY, rotS.RotZ
	-- Initial RotX/Y/Z compose through RotOrder; see EmitPart for the rationale.
	local rotXYZ = Constants.composeRotation(data.RotOrder or "Global", RX, RY, RZ)
	local rotatedLocalCF = localCF * rotXYZ

	-- Base direction (3-way: Local / RigidLocal / Global). Sim frame is parent-local.
	local baseDirection
	if dirMode == "Local" then
		baseDirection = rotatedLocalCF[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
	elseif dirMode == "Global" then
		-- World-space axis converted to actualParent-local (handles nested-Attachment via
		-- the BasePart anchor we walked up to). Folder-anchored fallback stays world-space.
		local worldAxis = CFrame.new()[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
		if actualParent and actualParent:IsA("BasePart") then
			baseDirection = actualParent.CFrame:VectorToObjectSpace(worldAxis)
		else
			baseDirection = worldAxis
		end
	else -- RigidLocal: pre-RotXYZ pose in actualParent-local
		baseDirection = localCF[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
	end

	localCF = rotatedLocalCF

	-- simFrameCF = actualParentCF so applyPositionOffset converts world offset into
	-- actualParent-local space (matches our sim frame after the BasePart walk-up).
	localCF = Constants.applyPositionOffset(localCF, data, link, attachment, RangeMod, AxisLinksMod, emitCtx, actualParentCF)

	-- Global: apply inv(actualParent.Rotation) so parent cancels at engine-multiply,
	-- leaving rotXYZ alone. Uses actualParent (BasePart anchor) so nested-Attachment
	-- sources don't fall to identity here.
	if dirMode == "Global" then
		if actualParent and actualParent:IsA("BasePart") then
			localCF = CFrame.new(localCF.Position) * actualParent.CFrame.Rotation:Inverse() * rotXYZ
		else
			localCF = CFrame.new(localCF.Position) * rotXYZ
		end
	end

	local randomX, randomY = 0, 0
	if data.ParticleData.SpreadAngle.X > 0 or data.ParticleData.SpreadAngle.Y > 0 then
		randomX = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * data.ParticleData.SpreadAngle.X
		randomY = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * data.ParticleData.SpreadAngle.Y
	end
	local spreadRotation = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(randomX), math.rad(randomY), 0)

	local cf = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(), baseDirection)
	cf = cf * spreadRotation
	baseDirection = cf.LookVector

	local seeds = {
		Speed = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Speed),
		RotSpeedX = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.RotSpeedX),
		RotSpeedY = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.RotSpeedY),
		RotSpeedZ = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.RotSpeedZ),
		PosOffsetX = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PosOffsetX),
		PosOffsetY = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PosOffsetY),
		PosOffsetZ = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PosOffsetZ),
		Timescale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.Timescale),
	}
	-- Aliases: RotSpeed only (no Size on Attachments).
	AxisLinksMod.applyGraphAxisAliases(data, seeds, data.AxisLinks)

	local invertMotion = data.InvertMotion
	local simLocalCFrames = nil
	local simEffectiveTKF = nil

	if invertMotion then
		simLocalCFrames, simEffectiveTKF = self:PreSimulateAttachmentForward(data, seeds, localCF, baseDirection, spreadRotation, Time, nil, localCF.Rotation * rotXYZ:Inverse())
	end

	local visualAttachment = Pool.acquireOrCopyBare(data.RenderTemplate, "Attachment", data.Pool)
	visualAttachment.Archivable = false

	if invertMotion and simLocalCFrames then
		local endLocalCF = simLocalCFrames[simEffectiveTKF or data.TotalKeyFrames] or simLocalCFrames[0]
		localCF = endLocalCF
	end

	-- actualParent + actualParentCF computed earlier (before sim) so PreSimulate
	-- and rotation/shape compose operate in the right frame.

	visualAttachment.CFrame = localCF
	visualAttachment.Parent = actualParent

	-- Restore nested-Trail Enabled snapshot after Parent so they track from spawn pose.
	-- Mirrors the Part path at line ~273.
	Pool.restoreTrails(visualAttachment, "Attachment")

	-- pData.LocalCF in parentCF_now-local space (link path) or actualParent-local (unlinked).
	local pDataLocalCF = localCF
	if link then
		local linkWorldCF = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(link)
		local convCF = (actualParent and actualParent:IsA("BasePart")) and actualParent.CFrame or CFrame.new()
		local linkLocalCF = convCF:ToObjectSpace(linkWorldCF)
		local parentCF_now
		if data.LinkMode == "Follow" or data.LinkMode == "Pivot" then
			parentCF_now = CFrame.new(linkLocalCF.Position)
		else
			parentCF_now = linkLocalCF
		end
		pDataLocalCF = parentCF_now:ToObjectSpace(localCF)
	end

	-- RigidLocal: snapshot link's WORLD CFrame at emit. Per-frame Attachment Link
	-- consumers convert this to visualParent-local at sample time so a moving
	-- visualParent stays correct.
	local rigidLocalSnapshot = nil
	if data.LinkMode == "RigidLocal" and link then
		rigidLocalSnapshot = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(link)
	end

	local pData = {
		Type = "Attachment",
		VisualPart = visualAttachment,
		Link = link,
		LinkMode = data.LinkMode,
		_rigidLocalParentCF = rigidLocalSnapshot,
		Events = data.Events,

		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = invertMotion and simEffectiveTKF or math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = 0,
		AccumulatedDT = 0,
		LifeTime = Time,
		PartLife = data.PartLife,
		LocalCF = pDataLocalCF,
		_localWorldCF = pDataLocalCF, -- seed for LinkTrack frame 0
		BaseDirection = baseDirection,
		_accelVel = Vector3.zero,
		SpeedMultiplier = 1,
		_spinRate = Vector3.zero,
		_spinAccumX = 0, _spinAccumY = 0, _spinAccumZ = 0,
		EmissionDirection = data.EmissionDirection,
		SpreadRotation = spreadRotation,
		Acceleration = data.ParticleData.Acceleration,
		Drag = data.ParticleData.Drag,
		VelocityVectored = data.VelocityVectored,

		InvertMotion = invertMotion,
		SimLocalCFrames = simLocalCFrames,

		RotMode = data.RotMode or "OverLife",
		RotOrder = data.RotOrder or "Global",
		AccRotX = 0, AccRotY = 0, AccRotZ = 0,

		Orientation = data.Orientation,
		ZOffset = data.ZOffset,

		-- PosOffsetX/Y/Z trajectory graph state (see Part emit above for semantics).
		SpawnRotation = pDataLocalCF.Rotation,
		SpawnEmitterRotation = pDataLocalCF.Rotation * rotXYZ:Inverse(),
		DisplacementMode = data.DisplacementMode,
		-- Attachment has no Size; 1.0 fallback for the sleep point-velocity check.
		_sleepRadius = 1.0,
		_prevWorldOff = Vector3.zero,
		HasPosOffsetGraphs = data.PosOffsetX ~= nil or data.PosOffsetY ~= nil or data.PosOffsetZ ~= nil,

		NeedsFullIteration = data.VelocityVectored,
		NeedsRotAccum = (data.RotMode == "Speed") and not data.VelocityVectored,
		HasDrag = data.ParticleData.Drag ~= 0,
		HasAccel = data.ParticleData.Acceleration.Magnitude > 0,

		Graphs = {
			Speed = data.Speed,
			RotSpeedX = data.RotSpeedX, RotSpeedY = data.RotSpeedY, RotSpeedZ = data.RotSpeedZ,
			PosOffsetX = data.PosOffsetX, PosOffsetY = data.PosOffsetY, PosOffsetZ = data.PosOffsetZ,
			Timescale = data.Timescale,
		},
		Seeds = seeds,
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.Timescale, seeds.Timescale, Time),
	}

	-- 1-frame pop prevention for PosOffset (see EmitPart for semantics).
	if pData.HasPosOffsetGraphs then
		local oX = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetX) or 0
		local oY = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetY) or 0
		local oZ = pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetZ) or 0
		local worldOff = Constants.resolveDisplacement(Vector3.new(oX, oY, oZ),
			data.DisplacementMode or "Global", pData.SpawnRotation, pData.SpawnEmitterRotation)
		pData._prevWorldOff = worldOff
		if oX ~= 0 or oY ~= 0 or oZ ~= 0 then
			pData.LocalCF = pData.LocalCF + worldOff
			pData.VisualPart.CFrame = pData.VisualPart.CFrame + worldOff
		end
	end

	pData._sourceItem = attachment
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, attachment)
	if data.Pool ~= false then pData._sourceRT, pData._poolKind = data.RenderTemplate, "Attachment" end
	-- Static-graph short-circuit: constant-valued graphs nil out + stamp pData._static<Name>.
	StaticPass.apply(pData)
	self:_applyEmitVisualPasses(pData)
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)

	for _, desc in visualAttachment:GetDescendants() do
		if desc:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then desc.Enabled = false end
	end
	local aliveAtt = self:_makeAliveCheck()
	for _, child in visualAttachment:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("Attachment") then ParticlesMod.EnableEmitChildrenAndRepeatForAttachments(child, aliveAtt) end
		ParticlesMod.EnableEmitSingle(child, aliveAtt)
	end

	-- Nested Part-Icles: source-walk; link = visualAttachment drives position.
	pData._nestedAlive = { true }
	NestedEmit.walk(self, data.RenderTemplate, visualAttachment, pData._nestedAlive, emitCtx)
end

-- Beams: no spatial motion (welded to Attachment0/1). Animation via per-prop graphs,
-- GraphBlender, and BeamFlipbooks. Static graphs read once at emit.
function Particle:EmitBeam(beam, link, emitCtx)
	if not beam or not beam.Parent then return end
	local data = self:GetData(beam)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	-- PoolHide flipped Enabled=false on release; flip back here.
	local visualBeam = Pool.acquireOrClone(data.RenderTemplate, "Beam", data.Pool)
	visualBeam.Archivable = false
	visualBeam.Enabled = true
	if data.FaceCamera ~= nil then visualBeam.FaceCamera = data.FaceCamera end
	if data.ZOffset ~= nil then visualBeam.ZOffset = data.ZOffset end
	if data.TextureMode ~= nil then visualBeam.TextureMode = data.TextureMode end

	-- Rebind parent-scope Attachment0/1 refs via parent's clone map (nested-emit path).
	if emitCtx and emitCtx._parentCloneMap then
		local map = emitCtx._parentCloneMap
		if visualBeam.Attachment0 and map[visualBeam.Attachment0] then visualBeam.Attachment0 = map[visualBeam.Attachment0] end
		if visualBeam.Attachment1 and map[visualBeam.Attachment1] then visualBeam.Attachment1 = map[visualBeam.Attachment1] end
	end

	-- Static / animated beam property split.
	local animatedProps = {}
	for name, sequence in pairs(data.BeamProps) do
		if sequence then
			if GraphMod.IsStatic(sequence) then
				visualBeam[name] = GraphMod.GetStaticValue(sequence, visualBeam[name])
			else
				local seed = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(sequence)
				animatedProps[name] = { Sequence = sequence, Seed = seed }
				if name ~= "TextureSpeed" then
					local initVal = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, sequence, seed)
					if name == "Segments" then initVal = math.max(20, math.round(initVal)) end
					visualBeam[name] = initVal
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- Disable engine TextureSpeed accumulation; UpdateBeam computes offset.
	if animatedProps.TextureSpeed then
		visualBeam.TextureSpeed = 0
	end

	local transStates, colorStates = GraphMod.CollectGraphStates(data.GraphBlender)

	-- Cache merged keypoint times per adjacent pair.
	local transMergedTimes = {}
	for idx = 1, #transStates - 1 do
		transMergedTimes[idx] = GraphMod.PrecomputeMergedTimes(transStates[idx].Graph, transStates[idx + 1].Graph)
	end
	local colorMergedTimes = {}
	for idx = 1, #colorStates - 1 do
		colorMergedTimes[idx] = GraphMod.PrecomputeMergedColorTimes(colorStates[idx].Graph, colorStates[idx + 1].Graph)
	end

	-- Apply initial blender state (1-frame pop prevention).
	if #transStates > 0 then visualBeam.Transparency = transStates[1].Graph end
	if #colorStates > 0 then visualBeam.Color = colorStates[1].Graph end

	visualBeam.Parent = data.EmitParent or self:GetFolder()

	local safeLifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if safeLifeTime <= 0 then safeLifeTime = 0.001 end
	local beamTimescaleSeed = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.BeamTimescale)

	local pData = {
		Type = "Beam",
		VisualPart = visualBeam,
		Link = link,
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = 0,
		LifeTime = safeLifeTime,
		PartLife = data.PartLife or 0,

		AnimatedProps = animatedProps,

		TransStates = transStates,
		ColorStates = colorStates,
		TransMergedTimes = transMergedTimes,
		ColorMergedTimes = colorMergedTimes,

		Graphs = { Timescale = data.BeamTimescale },
		Seeds = { Timescale = beamTimescaleSeed },
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.BeamTimescale, beamTimescaleSeed, safeLifeTime),
	}

	-- Inherit parent model scale; cache bases for static props.
	if self._parentScaleMap and self._parentScaleMap[beam] then
		pData.ParentScale = self._parentScaleMap[beam]
		pData._baseWidth0 = visualBeam.Width0
		pData._baseWidth1 = visualBeam.Width1
		pData._baseCurveSize0 = visualBeam.CurveSize0
		pData._baseCurveSize1 = visualBeam.CurveSize1
		pData._baseTextureLength = visualBeam.TextureLength
		pData._baseSegments = visualBeam.Segments
	end

	pData._sourceItem = beam
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, beam)
	if data.Pool ~= false then pData._sourceRT, pData._poolKind = data.RenderTemplate, "Beam" end
	-- No _applyEmitVisualPasses for Beam (spatial-mesh only).
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)

	if data.CachedBeamTextures and #data.CachedBeamTextures > 0 and data.FlipbookParticle then
		MeshFlipMod.FlipBeam(pData, data.FlipbookParticle, data.CachedBeamTextures, visualBeam, safeLifeTime)
	end
end

end

children.name: EmitAnimate
children.source:
--[[
	EmitAnimate Mixin  -  Animate-mode emit for Part / Attachment / Beam.
	Operates on RenderTemplate directly (no clone). On Lifetime expiry, init.luau's Heartbeat
	resets position + snapshots; with AnimateLoop=true it replays. AnimateItem stamps pData
	for the loop branch. Screen / ImageLabel animate lives in ScreenEmit / ImageEmit.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local ParticlesMod = require(script.Parent.Particles)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local AxisLinksMod = require(script.Parent.AxisLinks)
local EventsMod = require(script.Parent.Events)
local StaticPass = require(script.Parent.StaticPass)
local DirectionVectors = Constants.DirectionVectors
local shapeFunctions = Constants.shapeFunctions

return function(Particle)

-- Part Animate. Mirrors Emit.luau but visualPart = LIVE RenderTemplate.
function Particle:EmitPartAnimate(part, link, emitCtx)
	if not part or not part.Parent then return end
	local data = self:GetData(part)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end
	link = link or data.Link

	local Time = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if Time <= 0 then Time = 0.001 end

	local visualPart = data.RenderTemplate -- LIVE source RT, not a clone
	local initialAnchorCF = visualPart.CFrame

	local unrotatedCF
	if link then
		local lCF = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(link)
		local lPos = lCF.Position
		if data.LinkMode == "Follow" then unrotatedCF = CFrame.new(lPos) * part.CFrame.Rotation
		else unrotatedCF = CFrame.new(lPos) * lCF.Rotation * part.CFrame.Rotation end
