-- ScreenHost  -  lazy singleton ScreenGui in CoreGui for ImageLabel emitters without an EmitParent.

local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local ScreenHost = {}
local _gui = nil

function ScreenHost.get()
	if _gui and _gui.Parent then return _gui end
	_gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	_gui.Name = "PartIclesScreenHost"
	_gui.Archivable = false
	_gui.DisplayOrder = -10 -- below plugin UI (default 0)
	_gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	_gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	_gui.Parent = CoreGui
	return _gui
end

function ScreenHost.destroy()
	if _gui then pcall(_gui.Destroy, _gui); _gui = nil end
end

function ScreenHost.exists() return _gui and _gui.Parent ~= nil end

return ScreenHost

children.name: StaticPass
children.source:
-- StaticPass  -  detect constant-valued NumberSequence graphs at emit / AnimateLoop
-- replay time. Constant graphs nil out of pData.Graphs and their value stamps onto
-- pData._static<Name>. Per-frame Update sites read the static value, skipping the
-- QueryPointsWithTime call. Idempotent: clears stale static fields before re-detecting,
-- so a graph switched from static→dynamic mid-cycle correctly re-arms the per-frame
-- sample path.
--
-- ColorSequence not handled  -  Graph.IsStatic is NumberSequence-only. Color graphs
-- remain per-frame sampled (cost is real but step-quantized).
local Graph = require(script.Parent.Graph)

local StaticPass = {}

-- Per-type list of { graphName, staticFieldName, default }.
-- Add a graph here, then add `pData._static<Name> or ` to the matching Update sample
-- site. Field name must match between the table entry and the Update read.
local FIELDS = {
	Part = {
		{ "Speed",         "_staticSpeed",         0 },
		{ "Brightness",    "_staticBrightness",    1 },
		{ "Transparency",  "_staticTransparency",  0 },
		{ "SizeX",         "_staticSizeX",         1 },
		{ "SizeY",         "_staticSizeY",         1 },
		{ "SizeZ",         "_staticSizeZ",         1 },
		{ "RotSpeedX",     "_staticRotSpeedX",     0 },
		{ "RotSpeedY",     "_staticRotSpeedY",     0 },
		{ "RotSpeedZ",     "_staticRotSpeedZ",     0 },
		{ "PosOffsetX",    "_staticPosOffsetX",    0 },
		{ "PosOffsetY",    "_staticPosOffsetY",    0 },
		{ "PosOffsetZ",    "_staticPosOffsetZ",    0 },
		{ "AccelStrength", "_staticAccelStrength", 0 },
	},
	Attachment = {
		{ "Speed",         "_staticSpeed",         0 },
		{ "RotSpeedX",     "_staticRotSpeedX",     0 },
		{ "RotSpeedY",     "_staticRotSpeedY",     0 },
		{ "RotSpeedZ",     "_staticRotSpeedZ",     0 },
		{ "PosOffsetX",    "_staticPosOffsetX",    0 },
		{ "PosOffsetY",    "_staticPosOffsetY",    0 },
		{ "PosOffsetZ",    "_staticPosOffsetZ",    0 },
	},
	Model = {
		{ "Speed",         "_staticSpeed",         0 },
		{ "Scale",         "_staticScale",         1 },
		{ "RotSpeedX",     "_staticRotSpeedX",     0 },
		{ "RotSpeedY",     "_staticRotSpeedY",     0 },
		{ "RotSpeedZ",     "_staticRotSpeedZ",     0 },
		{ "PosOffsetX",    "_staticPosOffsetX",    0 },
		{ "PosOffsetY",    "_staticPosOffsetY",    0 },
		{ "PosOffsetZ",    "_staticPosOffsetZ",    0 },
	},
	ImageLabel = {
		{ "ImageTransparency",      "_staticImageTransparency",      0 },
		{ "BackgroundTransparency", "_staticBackgroundTransparency", 0 },
		{ "ImgSpeed",               "_staticImgSpeed",               0 },
		{ "ImgRotSpeed",            "_staticImgRotSpeed",            0 },
		{ "SizeScaleX",             "_staticSizeScaleX",             1 },
		{ "SizeScaleY",             "_staticSizeScaleY",             1 },
	},
	-- Beam props live under pData.BeamProps / pData.AnimatedProps, not pData.Graphs.
	-- Beam keeps its inline static-pass in Emit.luau / EmitAnimate.luau / Engine.luau.
}

-- Walk the type's FIELDS table. For each entry: if pData.Graphs[name] is a constant
-- NumberSequence, stamp pData[staticField] and nil the graph. Otherwise clear any
-- stale static field (covers graph→dynamic transitions between AnimateLoop cycles).
function StaticPass.apply(pData)
	if not pData or not pData.Type then return end
	local list = FIELDS[pData.Type]
	if not list then return end
	local g = pData.Graphs
	if not g then return end
	for _, entry in ipairs(list) do
		local graphName, staticField, default = entry[1], entry[2], entry[3]
		local seq = g[graphName]
		if seq and Graph.IsStatic(seq) then
			pData[staticField] = Graph.GetStaticValue(seq, default)
			g[graphName] = nil
		else
			-- Graph absent or dynamic: clear stale static field from prior cycle.
			pData[staticField] = nil
		end
	end
end

-- AnimateLoop replay support. Prior cycle's StaticPass.apply nil'd constant graphs
-- from pData.Graphs. AxisLinks.refreshLoopGraphsAndSeeds iterates `pairs(pData.Graphs)`,
-- so nil keys aren't repopulated from freshData. Call this BEFORE refresh to put the
-- absent keys back, then refresh runs normally, then StaticPass.apply re-detects.
function StaticPass.restoreFromFreshData(pData, freshData)
	if not pData or not freshData or not pData.Type then return end
	local list = FIELDS[pData.Type]
	if not list then return end
	local g = pData.Graphs
	if not g then return end
	for _, entry in ipairs(list) do
		local graphName = entry[1]
		if g[graphName] == nil and freshData[graphName] then
			g[graphName] = freshData[graphName]
		end
	end
end

return StaticPass

children.name: TexturePin
children.source:
-- TexturePin  -  keeps texture assets resident in GPU memory so they don't redecode on first use.
-- 1×1 ImageLabel at ImageTransparency=0.99 parented to a hidden ScreenGui keeps the asset decoded
-- (fully transparent / invisible images get evicted). Owner-counted: pin survives until last owner
-- releases. Ref: https://devforum.roblox.com/t/preloading-images-and-keeping-them-loaded/2998098

local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")

local TexturePin = {}

local _gui = nil            -- hidden ScreenGui hosting every pin ImageLabel
local _pinned = {}          -- assetId -> ImageLabel
local _ownersOf = {}        -- assetId -> {[owner]=true,...}
local _assetsByOwner = {}   -- owner   -> {[assetId]=true,...}  reverse index for O(pins held) release
local _ANON = newproxy()    -- sentinel for pin() without owner; only clear() releases anonymous pins

local function ensureGui()
	if _gui and _gui.Parent then return _gui end
	_gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	_gui.Name = "PartIclesTexturePin"
	_gui.Archivable = false
	_gui.DisplayOrder = -999
	_gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	_gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	_gui.Parent = CoreGui
	return _gui
end

-- Resolve string ID or texture-bearing Instance to a Content ID; nil means skip.
local function _resolveAssetId(entry)
	if typeof(entry) == "string" then return entry ~= "" and entry or nil end
	if typeof(entry) ~= "Instance" then return nil end
	if entry:IsA("Decal") or entry:IsA("Texture") or entry:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or entry:IsA("Beam") or entry:IsA("Trail") then
		local t = entry.Texture; return (t and t ~= "") and t or nil
	elseif entry:IsA("ImageLabel") or entry:IsA("ImageButton") then
		local t = entry.Image; return (t and t ~= "") and t or nil
	elseif entry:IsA("SpecialMesh") then
		-- SpecialMesh.TextureId (lowercase d).
		local t = entry.TextureId; return (t and t ~= "") and t or nil
	elseif entry:IsA("MeshPart") then
		-- MeshPart.TextureID (uppercase D); checked AFTER Beam etc.
		local t = entry.TextureID; return (t and t ~= "") and t or nil
	end
end

-- SurfaceAppearance carries 4 PBR slots; pin all four. Other entries use _resolveAssetId.
local function _appendAssetIds(entry, list)
	if entry:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
		for _, prop in ipairs({"ColorMap", "NormalMap", "MetalnessMap", "RoughnessMap"}) do
			local ok, t = pcall(function() return entry[prop] end)
			if ok and t and t ~= "" then table.insert(list, t) end
		end
		return
	end
	local id = _resolveAssetId(entry)
	if id then table.insert(list, id) end
end

-- Pin one or many assets for `owner`. De-duped via `_pinned`; owner defaults to anonymous.
function TexturePin.pin(input, owner)
	if not input then return end
	owner = owner or _ANON
	local items = (type(input) == "table") and input or { input }
	local newPins = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(items) do
		local assetId = _resolveAssetId(entry)
		if assetId then
			if not _pinned[assetId] then
				local gui = ensureGui()
				local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
				img.Name = "Pin"; img.Image = assetId
				img.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1); img.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
				img.BackgroundTransparency = 1; img.ImageTransparency = 0.99 -- 1.0 culls and evicts
				img.BorderSizePixel = 0; img.ZIndex = 1
				img.Parent = gui
				_pinned[assetId] = img
				table.insert(newPins, img)
			end
			local owners = _ownersOf[assetId]; if not owners then owners = {}; _ownersOf[assetId] = owners end
			owners[owner] = true
			local assets = _assetsByOwner[owner]; if not assets then assets = {}; _assetsByOwner[owner] = assets end
			assets[assetId] = true
		end
	end
	if #newPins > 0 then task.spawn(function() pcall(ContentProvider.PreloadAsync, ContentProvider, newPins) end) end
end

-- Pin every texture-bearing descendant of `root`; owner = root.
function TexturePin.pinSubtree(root)
	if not root then return end
	local ids = {}
	_appendAssetIds(root, ids)
	local ok, descendants = pcall(root.GetDescendants, root)
	if ok then
		for _, d in ipairs(descendants) do _appendAssetIds(d, ids) end
	end
	if #ids > 0 then TexturePin.pin(ids, root) end
end

function TexturePin.isPinned(assetId) return _pinned[assetId] ~= nil end

function TexturePin.count()
	local n = 0; for _ in pairs(_pinned) do n += 1 end; return n
end

-- Drop owner's claim. Pin destroyed only when zero owners remain.
function TexturePin.unpin(input, owner)
	if not input then return end
	owner = owner or _ANON
	local items = (type(input) == "table") and input or { input }
	for _, entry in ipairs(items) do
		local assetId = _resolveAssetId(entry)
		if assetId and _pinned[assetId] then
			local owners = _ownersOf[assetId]
			if owners then owners[owner] = nil end
			local assets = _assetsByOwner[owner]
			if assets then assets[assetId] = nil end
			local anyOwner = false; if owners then for _ in pairs(owners) do anyOwner = true; break end end
			if not anyOwner then
				pcall(_pinned[assetId].Destroy, _pinned[assetId])
				_pinned[assetId] = nil; _ownersOf[assetId] = nil
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Release every pin this owner holds; hooked into DescendantRemoving for auto-cleanup.
function TexturePin.releaseOwner(owner)
	if not owner then return end
	local assets = _assetsByOwner[owner]; if not assets then return end
	for assetId in pairs(assets) do
		local owners = _ownersOf[assetId]
		if owners then owners[owner] = nil end
		local anyOwner = false; if owners then for _ in pairs(owners) do anyOwner = true; break end end
		if not anyOwner and _pinned[assetId] then
			pcall(_pinned[assetId].Destroy, _pinned[assetId])
			_pinned[assetId] = nil; _ownersOf[assetId] = nil
		end
	end
	_assetsByOwner[owner] = nil
end

-- Mirror of pinSubtree; other owners' shares persist.
function TexturePin.unpinSubtree(root)
	if not root then return end
	local ids = {}
	_appendAssetIds(root, ids)
	local ok, descendants = pcall(root.GetDescendants, root)
	if ok then
		for _, d in ipairs(descendants) do _appendAssetIds(d, ids) end
	end
	if #ids > 0 then TexturePin.unpin(ids, root) end
end

-- Destroy every pin + the host ScreenGui. Called on plugin toggle-off / Deactivate.
function TexturePin.clear()
	_pinned = {}; _ownersOf = {}; _assetsByOwner = {}
	if _gui then pcall(_gui.Destroy, _gui); _gui = nil end
end

return TexturePin

children.name: Timescale
children.source:
--[[
	Timescale Mixin  -  runtime timescale override for live particles + raw ParticleEmitters.

	Public API (after :Activate):
	  :SetTimescale(item, scale, duration, permanent)
	     scale      -  0 = time stop, <0 = reverse, >0 = speed multiplier.
	     duration   -  seconds before revert to original (ignored when permanent).
	     permanent  -  true → never expires (duration ignored); false → timed via duration;
	                 false + duration=0 collapses to :ClearTimescale so toggling off uses one method.
	  :ClearTimescale(item)
	  :AbsoluteSetTimescale / :AbsoluteClearTimescale (recursive, mirrors AbsoluteEnable).

	Dispatch:
	  - Transformed (Part-Icles) items: write `_tsOverride` + `_tsOverrideUntil` attrs;
	    SetTimescale walks `Particle.ActiveEmits` to flip existing pData; emit mixins call
	    `Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, src)` so new emits during the window inherit; Update
	    mixins gate on `currentTime < pData._tsOverrideUntil` and fall back to `Graphs.Timescale`.
	  - Raw `ParticleEmitter` instances: write `.TimeScale` directly. Original value stashed
	    in `_origTimeScale` so concurrent SetTimescale calls don't lose it. `_tsGen` invalidates
	    stale `task.delay` restore closures so newer calls win.
]]

return function(Particle)

	-- Emit-site seeder. Stale attrs on src are harmless: Update mixin gate expires them lazily.
	function Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, src)
		if not src then return end
		pData._tsOverride = src:GetAttribute("_tsOverride")
		pData._tsOverrideUntil = src:GetAttribute("_tsOverrideUntil")
	end

	-- Native ParticleEmitter path. Stash original once, write override, schedule restore.
	local function _setNativePE(pe, scale, duration, permanent)
		if pe:GetAttribute("_origTimeScale") == nil then
			pcall(function() pe:SetAttribute("_origTimeScale", pe.TimeScale) end)
		end
		pcall(function() pe.TimeScale = scale end)
		-- Generation token: bump invalidates any pending stale restore closure.
		local gen = (pe:GetAttribute("_tsGen") or 0) + 1
		pcall(function() pe:SetAttribute("_tsGen", gen) end)
		if permanent == true then return end
		task.delay(duration, function()
			if not pe.Parent then return end
			if pe:GetAttribute("_tsGen") ~= gen then return end
			local orig = pe:GetAttribute("_origTimeScale")
			if orig ~= nil then
				pcall(function() pe.TimeScale = orig end)
				pcall(function() pe:SetAttribute("_origTimeScale", nil) end)
			end
			pcall(function() pe:SetAttribute("_tsGen", nil) end)
		end)
	end

	local function _clearNativePE(pe)
		local orig = pe:GetAttribute("_origTimeScale")
		if orig ~= nil then
			pcall(function() pe.TimeScale = orig end)
			pcall(function() pe:SetAttribute("_origTimeScale", nil) end)
		end
		-- Bump + clear gen so any pending task.delay closure from a prior timed call bails.
		local gen = (pe:GetAttribute("_tsGen") or 0) + 1
		pcall(function() pe:SetAttribute("_tsGen", gen) end)
		pcall(function() pe:SetAttribute("_tsGen", nil) end)
	end

	-- Apply a timescale override to a Transformed item or raw ParticleEmitter. See file header
	-- for scale / duration / permanent semantics + dispatch table.
	function Particle:SetTimescale(item, scale, duration, permanent)
		if not item then return end
		if typeof(scale) ~= "number" then return end
		local effectiveDuration
		if permanent == true then
			effectiveDuration = nil
		elseif typeof(duration) == "number" and duration > 0 then
			effectiveDuration = duration
		else
			self:ClearTimescale(item)
			return
		end
		if item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			_setNativePE(item, scale, effectiveDuration, permanent)
			return
		end
		local until_ = (permanent == true) and math.huge or (os.clock() + effectiveDuration)
		pcall(function()
			item:SetAttribute("_tsOverride", scale)
			item:SetAttribute("_tsOverrideUntil", until_)
		end)
		local active = self.ActiveEmits
		for i = 1, #active do
			local pData = active[i]
			if pData and pData._sourceItem == item then
				pData._tsOverride = scale
				pData._tsOverrideUntil = until_
			end
		end
	end

	-- Remove timescale override from a Transformed item or raw ParticleEmitter. Inverse of
	-- SetTimescale; restores `Graphs.Timescale` (Transformed) or `_origTimeScale` (native PE).
	function Particle:ClearTimescale(item)
		if not item then return end
		if item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			_clearNativePE(item)
			return
		end
		pcall(function()
			item:SetAttribute("_tsOverride", nil)
			item:SetAttribute("_tsOverrideUntil", nil)
		end)
		local active = self.ActiveEmits
		for i = 1, #active do
			local pData = active[i]
			if pData and pData._sourceItem == item then
				pData._tsOverride = nil
				pData._tsOverrideUntil = nil
			end
		end
	end

	-- Recurse like AbsoluteEnable. Transformed items + raw ParticleEmitters both terminal.
	function Particle:AbsoluteSetTimescale(item, scale, duration, permanent)
		if not item then return end
		if item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
			self:SetTimescale(item, scale, duration, permanent)
			return
		end
		if item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			self:SetTimescale(item, scale, duration, permanent)
			return
		end
		for _, child in item:GetChildren() do
			if item:IsA("BasePart") and child:IsA("BasePart") and not child:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
				continue
			end
			self:AbsoluteSetTimescale(child, scale, duration, permanent)
		end
	end

	-- Recursive ClearTimescale across `item` + transformed descendants.
	function Particle:AbsoluteClearTimescale(item)
		if not item then return end
		if item:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
			self:ClearTimescale(item)
			return
		end
		if item:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			self:ClearTimescale(item)
			return
		end
		for _, child in item:GetChildren() do
			if item:IsA("BasePart") and child:IsA("BasePart") and not child:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
				continue
			end
			self:AbsoluteClearTimescale(child)
		end
	end

end

children.name: TrailEmitter
children.source:
--[[
	TrailEmitter Mixin  -  Emit + Update for Trail particles (emitter mode, post-Transform-as-Emitter).
	Mirrors Beam emitter pattern: static spatial position (welded to existing Attachment0/Attachment1),
	animation entirely via graphs. Width / Transparency / Color drive through TrailGraphBlender;
	Brightness / LightEmission / LightInfluence / TextureLength / MinLength / MaxLength are
	per-frame scalar graphs sampled at the current step's i.

	Cross-file invariants:
	  - pData.Type = "TrailEmitter"  -  Heartbeat dispatch routes to UpdateTrail
	  - Lifecycle.cancelAnimation reads pData.TrailEmitterSnapshot to restore live RT (animate mode)
	  - PoolHide kind "TrailEmitter" → Enabled=false on release / true on acquire
	  - data.RenderTemplate is the cloned Trail; clones share its Attachment0/Attachment1 references
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local RangeMod = require(script.Parent.Range)
local TrailGraphBlender = require(script.Parent.TrailGraphBlender)
local Pool = require(script.Parent.Pool)
local MeshFlipbook = require(script.Parent.Flipbook)

return function(Particle)

-- Per-particle scalar graphs sampled at each step. Keep aligned with TrailEmitterProperties.
local SCALAR_GRAPHS = {"Brightness", "LightEmission", "LightInfluence", "TextureLength", "MinLength", "MaxLength"}

local function _writeBlenderState(visual, propName, states, mergedTimesList, lastIdxField, pData, t)
	if not states or #states == 0 then return end
	if #states == 1 then
		visual[propName] = states[1].Graph
		return
	end
	local lastIdx = pData[lastIdxField] or 1
	if t < states[lastIdx].Time then lastIdx = 1 end
	local pairIdx = #states - 1
	for idx = lastIdx, #states - 1 do
		if t >= states[idx].Time and t <= states[idx + 1].Time then
			pairIdx = idx; break
		end
	end
	pData[lastIdxField] = pairIdx
	local lower = states[pairIdx]
	local upper = states[pairIdx + 1] or states[#states]
	local range = upper.Time - lower.Time
	local segmentAlpha = range > 0 and ((t - lower.Time) / range) or 0
	local mergedTimes = mergedTimesList and mergedTimesList[pairIdx]
	if mergedTimes then
		if propName == "Color" then
			visual[propName] = GraphMod.LerpColorGraphFast(lower.Graph, upper.Graph, segmentAlpha, mergedTimes)
		else
			visual[propName] = GraphMod.LerpGraphFast(lower.Graph, upper.Graph, segmentAlpha, mergedTimes)
		end
	end
end

-- Per-frame Heartbeat update for TrailEmitter particles. Width / Transparency / Color drive
-- through TrailGraphBlender; scalar graphs (Brightness / LightEmission / etc) sample per frame.
function Particle:UpdateTrail(pData, dt, currentTime)
	-- Signed-reverse timescale support: see Update.luau UpdatePart. SetTimescale override wins for its window.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	local dtTs = dt * ts
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local priorEff = pData._effectiveElapsed or 0
	local newEff = priorEff + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dtTs)
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff
	local atForwardEnd = newEff >= lifeTime
	local atBackwardEnd = newEff <= 0
	local elapsedTime = newEff
	local i = elapsedTime / lifeTime

	if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return true end
	local graphFinished = real_i >= 1
	local isDying = graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd)
	i = math.min(math.max(i, 0), 1)

	-- Width / Transparency / Color blender (continuous-time, FPS-independent).
	local t = i
	if not pData.SkipColor then
		_writeBlenderState(pData.VisualPart, "WidthScale",   pData.WidthStates, pData.WidthMergedTimes, "_lastWidthIdx", pData, t)
		_writeBlenderState(pData.VisualPart, "Color",        pData.ColorStates, pData.ColorMergedTimes, "_lastColorIdx", pData, t)
	end
	if not pData.SkipTransparency then
		_writeBlenderState(pData.VisualPart, "Transparency", pData.TransStates, pData.TransMergedTimes, "_lastTransIdx", pData, t)
	end

	-- Step-quantized scalar graphs (Brightness / LightEmission / LightInfluence / TextureLength / MinLength / MaxLength).
	if pData.TotalKeyFrames > 0 then
		local targetStep = math.floor(i * pData.TotalKeyFrames)
		if targetStep ~= pData.CurrentStep then
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
			local steppedI = pData.CurrentStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames
			for _, key in ipairs(SCALAR_GRAPHS) do
				local graph = pData.Graphs[key]
				if graph then
					pData.VisualPart[key] = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, graph, pData.Seeds[key])
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return isDying
end

local function _collectStatesAndMergedTimes(graphBlender)
	local widthStates, transStates, colorStates = TrailGraphBlender.CollectStates(graphBlender)
	local widthMergedTimes, transMergedTimes, colorMergedTimes = {}, {}, {}
	for idx = 1, #widthStates - 1 do widthMergedTimes[idx] = TrailGraphBlender.PrecomputeMergedTimes(widthStates[idx].Graph, widthStates[idx + 1].Graph) end
	for idx = 1, #transStates - 1 do transMergedTimes[idx] = TrailGraphBlender.PrecomputeMergedTimes(transStates[idx].Graph, transStates[idx + 1].Graph) end
	for idx = 1, #colorStates - 1 do colorMergedTimes[idx] = TrailGraphBlender.PrecomputeMergedColorTimes(colorStates[idx].Graph, colorStates[idx + 1].Graph) end
	return widthStates, transStates, colorStates, widthMergedTimes, transMergedTimes, colorMergedTimes
end

local function _buildScalarGraphs(data)
	local graphs = { Timescale = data.TEmitTimescale }
	local seeds = { Timescale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.TEmitTimescale) }
	for _, key in ipairs(SCALAR_GRAPHS) do
		local g = data["TEmit" .. key] or data[key]
		if g then
			graphs[key] = g
			seeds[key] = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(g)
		end
	end
	return graphs, seeds
end

-- Spawn a TrailEmitter particle: clones RenderTemplate, applies authored Width / Color graphs,
-- registers in ActiveEmits. Trail inherits Attachment0/Attachment1 references from the clone source.
function Particle:EmitTrail(trail, link, emitCtx)
	if not trail or not trail.Parent then return end
	local data = self:GetData(trail)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	local visual = Pool.acquireOrClone(data.RenderTemplate, "TrailEmitter", data.Pool)
	visual.Archivable = false
	visual.Enabled = true
	-- Static props (Texture/TextureMode/FaceCamera) come from the cloned RT directly; no
	-- attribute-side mirror, so no override needed here.

	-- Rebind parent-scope Attachment0/1 refs via parent's clone map (nested-emit path).
	if emitCtx and emitCtx._parentCloneMap then
		local map = emitCtx._parentCloneMap
		if visual.Attachment0 and map[visual.Attachment0] then visual.Attachment0 = map[visual.Attachment0] end
		if visual.Attachment1 and map[visual.Attachment1] then visual.Attachment1 = map[visual.Attachment1] end
	end

	local safeLifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if safeLifeTime <= 0 then safeLifeTime = 0.001 end
	-- visual.Lifetime is the Trail's segment fade duration, separate from particle Lifetime.
	local trailLifeRange = data.TrailLife or data.Lifetime
	local trailLifeVal = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(trailLifeRange)
	if trailLifeVal <= 0 then trailLifeVal = 0.001 end
	visual.Lifetime = trailLifeVal

	local widthStates, transStates, colorStates,
		widthMergedTimes, transMergedTimes, colorMergedTimes = _collectStatesAndMergedTimes(data.GraphBlender)

	if #widthStates > 0 then visual.WidthScale = widthStates[1].Graph end
	if #transStates > 0 then visual.Transparency = transStates[1].Graph end
	if #colorStates > 0 then visual.Color = colorStates[1].Graph end

	local graphs, seeds = _buildScalarGraphs(data)
	for _, key in ipairs(SCALAR_GRAPHS) do
		if graphs[key] then
			visual[key] = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, graphs[key], seeds[key])
		end
	end

	visual.Parent = data.EmitParent or self:GetFolder()

	local pData = {
		Type = "TrailEmitter",
		VisualPart = visual,
		Link = link,
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = 0,
		LifeTime = safeLifeTime,
		PartLife = data.PartLife or 0,
		WidthStates = widthStates, TransStates = transStates, ColorStates = colorStates,
		WidthMergedTimes = widthMergedTimes, TransMergedTimes = transMergedTimes, ColorMergedTimes = colorMergedTimes,
		Graphs = graphs,
		Seeds = seeds,
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.TEmitTimescale, seeds.Timescale, safeLifeTime),
	}

	pData._sourceItem = trail
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, trail)
	if data.Pool ~= false then pData._sourceRT, pData._poolKind = data.RenderTemplate, "TrailEmitter" end
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)

	-- Flipbook: cycle visual.Texture through TrailFlipbooks/Decals. FlipBeam is generic over any
	-- target with a Texture property (Trail qualifies); reuse rather than fork a TrailFlipbook
	-- runtime. Mode/framerate/etc. live in the TEmitFlipbook* attrs read by GetData.
	if data.TrailFlipbookMode and data.TrailFlipbooks then
		local decals = MeshFlipbook.GetSortedBeamTextures(data.TrailFlipbooks)
		if #decals > 0 then
			local spec = {
				FlipbookMode = data.TrailFlipbookMode,
				FlipbookFramerate = data.TrailFlipbookFramerate,
				FlipbookStartRandom = data.TrailFlipbookStartRandom,
				FlipbookReverse = data.TrailFlipbookReverse,
			}
			MeshFlipbook.FlipBeam(pData, spec, decals, visual, safeLifeTime)
		end
	end
end

-- Animate mode: operate on the LIVE RenderTemplate. cancelAnimation/finishAnimate restore the
-- snapshotted intrinsic Trail props and disable the trail when the cycle ends.
function Particle:EmitTrailAnimate(trail, link, emitCtx)
	if not trail or not trail.Parent then return end
	if self.ActiveAnimates[trail] then return end
	local data = self:GetData(trail)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	local visual = data.RenderTemplate -- LIVE source, not a clone

	-- Snapshot BEFORE mutating so cancelAnimation restores authored values (mirrors Beam pattern).
	local snapshot = {
		Lifetime = visual.Lifetime,
		Brightness = visual.Brightness,
		LightEmission = visual.LightEmission,
		LightInfluence = visual.LightInfluence,
		TextureLength = visual.TextureLength,
		MinLength = visual.MinLength,
		MaxLength = visual.MaxLength,
		Texture = visual.Texture,
		TextureMode = visual.TextureMode,
		FaceCamera = visual.FaceCamera,
		WidthScale = visual.WidthScale,
		Transparency = visual.Transparency,
		Color = visual.Color,
		Enabled = visual.Enabled,
	}

	visual.Enabled = true
	-- Static props (Texture/TextureMode/FaceCamera) come from the live source directly (no clone).

	local safeLifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if safeLifeTime <= 0 then safeLifeTime = 0.001 end
	local trailLifeRange = data.TrailLife or data.Lifetime
	local trailLifeVal = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(trailLifeRange)
	if trailLifeVal <= 0 then trailLifeVal = 0.001 end
	visual.Lifetime = trailLifeVal

	local widthStates, transStates, colorStates,
		widthMergedTimes, transMergedTimes, colorMergedTimes = _collectStatesAndMergedTimes(data.GraphBlender)

	if #widthStates > 0 then visual.WidthScale = widthStates[1].Graph end
	if #transStates > 0 then visual.Transparency = transStates[1].Graph end
	if #colorStates > 0 then visual.Color = colorStates[1].Graph end

	local graphs, seeds = _buildScalarGraphs(data)
	for _, key in ipairs(SCALAR_GRAPHS) do
		if graphs[key] then
			visual[key] = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, graphs[key], seeds[key])
		end
	end

	local pData = {
		Type = "TrailEmitter",
		VisualPart = visual,
		Link = link,
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = 0,
		LifeTime = safeLifeTime,
		PartLife = data.PartLife or 0,
		IsAnimate = true, AnimateItem = trail,
		TrailEmitterSnapshot = snapshot,
		WidthStates = widthStates, TransStates = transStates, ColorStates = colorStates,
		WidthMergedTimes = widthMergedTimes, TransMergedTimes = transMergedTimes, ColorMergedTimes = colorMergedTimes,
		Graphs = graphs,
		Seeds = seeds,
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.TEmitTimescale, seeds.Timescale, safeLifeTime),
	}

	pData._sourceItem = trail
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, trail)
	self.ActiveAnimates[trail] = pData
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)

	if data.TrailFlipbookMode and data.TrailFlipbooks then
		local decals = MeshFlipbook.GetSortedBeamTextures(data.TrailFlipbooks)
		if #decals > 0 then
			local spec = {
				FlipbookMode = data.TrailFlipbookMode,
				FlipbookFramerate = data.TrailFlipbookFramerate,
				FlipbookStartRandom = data.TrailFlipbookStartRandom,
				FlipbookReverse = data.TrailFlipbookReverse,
			}
			MeshFlipbook.FlipBeam(pData, spec, decals, visual, safeLifeTime)
		end
	end
end

end

children.name: TrailGraphBlender
children.source:
--[[
	TrailGraphBlender  -  multi-state interpolation for Trail emitter properties.
	Mirrors Graph.CollectGraphStates structure but adds a third Width track alongside
	Transparency + Color. Configuration children under the GraphBlender folder each
	carry Time + Width + Transparency + Color attributes; this collector returns three
	sorted state lists. The actual per-frame pair-state interpolation reuses Graph's
	PrecomputeMergedTimes + LerpGraphFast / LerpColorGraphFast.
]]

local Graph = require(script.Parent.Graph)

local TrailGraphBlender = {}

-- Collect blender states from a GraphBlender folder into three time-sorted lists
-- (width / transparency / color). Returned lists feed Graph.PrecomputeMergedTimes + LerpGraphFast
-- at runtime for per-frame interpolation between authored Configuration states.
function TrailGraphBlender.CollectStates(graphBlender)
	local widthStates, transStates, colorStates = {}, {}, {}
	if not graphBlender then return widthStates, transStates, colorStates end

	for _, child in pairs(graphBlender:GetChildren()) do
		if not child:IsA("Configuration") then continue end
		local time = child:GetAttribute("Time")
		if time == nil then
			local num = tonumber(string.match(child.Name, "%d+"))
			time = num and (num - 1) or 0
		end
		local width = child:GetAttribute("Width")
		if width and typeof(width) == "NumberSequence" then
			table.insert(widthStates, {Time = time, Graph = width})
		end
		local trans = child:GetAttribute("Transparency")
		if trans and typeof(trans) == "NumberSequence" then
			table.insert(transStates, {Time = time, Graph = trans})
		end
		local color = child:GetAttribute("Color")
		if color and typeof(color) == "ColorSequence" then
			table.insert(colorStates, {Time = time, Graph = color})
		end
	end

	-- Sort each list by Time + normalize fallback values into 0-1 range.
	for _, states in ipairs({widthStates, transStates, colorStates}) do
		table.sort(states, function(a, b) return a.Time < b.Time end)
		if #states > 1 and states[#states].Time > 1 then
			local maxTime = states[#states].Time
			if maxTime > 0 then for _, s in ipairs(states) do s.Time = s.Time / maxTime end end
		end
	end

	return widthStates, transStates, colorStates
end

-- Reuse Graph's existing math; Trail blender doesn't need new sequence-merge primitives.
TrailGraphBlender.PrecomputeMergedTimes = Graph.PrecomputeMergedTimes
TrailGraphBlender.PrecomputeMergedColorTimes = Graph.PrecomputeMergedColorTimes
TrailGraphBlender.LerpGraphFast = Graph.LerpGraphFast
TrailGraphBlender.LerpColorGraphFast = Graph.LerpColorGraphFast

return TrailGraphBlender

children.name: Transform
children.source:
--[[
	Transform Mixin  -  converts an Instance into a Part-Icles emitter.
	  :Transform stamps attributes, creates PartIcleProperties Configuration + RenderTemplate, hides source.
	  :PreSimulateForward / :PreSimulateAttachmentForward  -  return local CFrames per step
	    without emitting. Used by Motion Preview and reused by Emit so live sim matches preview.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local TypeRegistry = require(script.Parent.TypeRegistry)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local DirectionVectors = Constants.DirectionVectors

return function(Particle)

-- TransformCompleted fires after Transform/TransformModel/transformDirectAccess; lazy create.
if not Particle.TransformCompleted then
	Particle.TransformCompleted = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
end

-- Main dispatch. Plain directAccess Trail/Beam are promote-eligible: Transform stamps
-- PartIcleProperties + RenderTemplate so the item flips classCheck to TrailEmitter / Beam.
function Particle:Transform(part)
	if part:GetAttribute("Transformed") then return end
	local typeDef = TypeRegistry.getTypeFor(part)
	if not typeDef then return end

	-- Promoting a directAccess type: swap to the emitter typeDef before createConfig so the
	-- Configuration child carries TrailEmitter / Beam property defaults (not the directAccess shape).
	if typeDef.directAccess then
		if part:IsA("Trail") and TypeRegistry.Types.TrailEmitter then
			typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types.TrailEmitter
		elseif part:IsA("Beam") and TypeRegistry.Types.Beam then
			typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types.Beam
		else
			return
		end
	end

	if part:IsA("Model") then
		-- PrimaryPart not required. Model:GetPivot / PivotTo / ScaleTo work via the
		-- computed WorldPivot when PrimaryPart is unset.
		return self:TransformModel(part, typeDef)
	end

	local config = TypeRegistry.createConfig(part, typeDef)

	local renderTemplate = part:Clone()
	renderTemplate.Name = "RenderTemplate"

	for _, child in renderTemplate:GetChildren() do
		if child:GetAttribute("Transformed") or child:IsA("Attachment") then continue end
		if child.Name == TypeRegistry.CONFIG_NAME or child.Name == "EmitParent" or child.Name == "Link" or child.Name == "AccelTarget" or child.Name == "ImageFlipbooks" then
			child:Destroy()
		elseif part:IsA("PointLight") or part:IsA("Highlight") then
			child:Destroy()
		elseif part:IsA("Attachment") then
			-- Strip plugin internals; keep authored Trails/Beams/Decals.
			if child.Name == "MeshFlipbooks" or child.Name == "BeamFlipbooks" or child.Name == "GraphBlender" then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		elseif part:IsA("ImageLabel") then
			-- Keep UIComponent decorators (UIGradient/UICorner/UIStroke/UIPadding).
			if not child:IsA("UIComponent") then child:Destroy() end
		elseif not child:IsA("SpecialMesh") and not child:IsA("Decal") and not child:IsA("Texture") and not child:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
			-- SurfaceAppearance must survive; Emit reads it via FindFirstChildOfClass.
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end

	-- Strip plugin attributes; preserve user-authored ones.
	for _, attrName in ipairs({"Transformed", "Qwinkle", "IsEmitter", "EmitCount", "EmitDuration", "EmitDelay", "EmissionMode", "AnimateLoop", "PreloadTexture", "LinkMode", "LinkSource"}) do
		renderTemplate:SetAttribute(attrName, nil)
	end

	if renderTemplate:IsA("BasePart") then
		renderTemplate.Anchored = true; renderTemplate.CanCollide = false; renderTemplate.CanQuery = false
		renderTemplate.CanTouch = false; renderTemplate.CastShadow = false; renderTemplate.Massless = true; renderTemplate.Locked = true
		renderTemplate.Transparency = 1
		for _, c in ipairs(renderTemplate:GetChildren()) do
			if c:IsA("Decal") or c:IsA("Texture") then c.Transparency = 1 end
		end
	end

	if renderTemplate:IsA("Attachment") then
		renderTemplate.CFrame = CFrame.new()
	end

	-- Silence native PEs/Trails on the RT (they ignore parent hidden state). Skip Transformed
	-- ones  -  directAccess Trails own .Enabled, and nested transformed PEs have their own lifecycle.
	for _, desc in ipairs(renderTemplate:GetDescendants()) do
		if (desc:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or desc:IsA("Trail"))
			and not desc:GetAttribute("Transformed")
		then desc.Enabled = false end
	end

	renderTemplate.Parent = part

	-- Capture authored visuals so emitter defaults reflect the source's pre-transform state.
	-- Size: SpecialMesh.Scale wins. Color/Transparency: first Decal wins UNLESS a
	-- SurfaceAppearance is present (PBR covers the surface  -  Decal is irrelevant).
	-- Read BEFORE the source strip below destroys the SpecialMesh/Decal children.
	if part:IsA("BasePart") and not part:IsA("Terrain") then
		local sizeVec = part.Size
		local meshChild = part:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh")
		if meshChild then sizeVec = meshChild.Scale end
		local colorVal = part.Color
		local transparencyVal = part.Transparency
		local hasSurfaceAppearance = part:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SurfaceAppearance") ~= nil
		if not hasSurfaceAppearance then
			local decalChild = part:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Decal")
			if decalChild then
				colorVal = decalChild.Color3
				transparencyVal = decalChild.Transparency
			end
		end
		config:SetAttribute("SizeX", NumberSequence.new(sizeVec.X))
		config:SetAttribute("SizeY", NumberSequence.new(sizeVec.Y))
		config:SetAttribute("SizeZ", NumberSequence.new(sizeVec.Z))
		config:SetAttribute("Color", ColorSequence.new(colorVal))
		config:SetAttribute("Transparency", NumberSequence.new(transparencyVal))
	end

	-- Hide source: visual children moved to RT.
	if part:IsA("BasePart") then
		for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
			if child ~= renderTemplate and (child:IsA("SpecialMesh") or child:IsA("Decal") or child:IsA("Texture")) then child:Destroy() end
		end
		part.Transparency = 1
	elseif part:IsA("PointLight") then
		part.Enabled = false
	elseif part:IsA("Highlight") then
		part.Enabled = false
	elseif part:IsA("PostProcessEffect") then
		part.Enabled = false
	elseif part:IsA("ImageLabel") then
		part.Visible = false
	end

	if part:IsA("PointLight") then
		config:SetAttribute("Shadows", part.Shadows)
	end

	-- Capture authored PostProcessEffect / Atmosphere into config as single-keypoint sequences.
	if part:IsA("BlurEffect") then
		config:SetAttribute("BlurSize", NumberSequence.new(part.Size))
	elseif part:IsA("BloomEffect") then
		config:SetAttribute("BloomIntensity", NumberSequence.new(part.Intensity))
		config:SetAttribute("BloomSize", NumberSequence.new(part.Size))
		config:SetAttribute("BloomThreshold", NumberSequence.new(part.Threshold))
	elseif part:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") then
		config:SetAttribute("CCBrightness", NumberSequence.new(part.Brightness))
		config:SetAttribute("CCContrast", NumberSequence.new(part.Contrast))
		config:SetAttribute("CCSaturation", NumberSequence.new(part.Saturation))
		config:SetAttribute("CCTintColor", ColorSequence.new(part.TintColor))
	elseif part:IsA("Atmosphere") then
		config:SetAttribute("AtmDensity", NumberSequence.new(part.Density))
		config:SetAttribute("AtmOffset", NumberSequence.new(part.Offset))
		config:SetAttribute("AtmGlare", NumberSequence.new(part.Glare))
		config:SetAttribute("AtmHaze", NumberSequence.new(part.Haze))
		config:SetAttribute("AtmColor", ColorSequence.new(part.Color))
		config:SetAttribute("AtmDecay", ColorSequence.new(part.Decay))
	elseif part:IsA("Highlight") then
		config:SetAttribute("HLFillColor", ColorSequence.new(part.FillColor))
		config:SetAttribute("HLFillTransparency", NumberSequence.new(part.FillTransparency))
		config:SetAttribute("HLOutlineColor", ColorSequence.new(part.OutlineColor))
		config:SetAttribute("HLOutlineTransparency", NumberSequence.new(part.OutlineTransparency))
		config:SetAttribute("HLDepthMode", part.DepthMode.Name)
		-- Adornee picker child: emit-time _resolveAdornee falls through to source.Adornee then
		-- source.Parent when this ObjectValue is unset. Picker UI binds to the ObjectValue's
		-- Value field  -  required for the user-facing Adornee picker.
		if not part:FindFirstChild("Adornee") then
			local ad = Instance.new("ObjectValue"); ad.Name = "Adornee"; ad.Value = nil; ad.Parent = part
		end
	end

	-- RT must never render live (both source + RT live in Lighting / GUI tree).
	if renderTemplate:IsA("PostProcessEffect") then renderTemplate.Enabled = false end

	if part:IsA("ImageLabel") then
		if renderTemplate:IsA("ImageLabel") then renderTemplate.Visible = false end
		-- Only force BG=1 from the default; preserve user-authored translucent backdrops.
		if part.BackgroundTransparency == 0 then
			part.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		end
		config:SetAttribute("Image", part.Image)
		config:SetAttribute("Position", part.Position)
		config:SetAttribute("ImgSize", part.Size)
		config:SetAttribute("AnchorPoint", part.AnchorPoint)
		config:SetAttribute("ZIndex", part.ZIndex)
		config:SetAttribute("ScaleType", part.ScaleType.Name)
		config:SetAttribute("ResampleMode", part.ResampleMode.Name)
		if not part:FindFirstChild("ImageFlipbooks") then
			local ff = Instance.new("Folder"); ff.Name = "ImageFlipbooks"; ff.Parent = part
		end
	end

	if part:IsA("BasePart") and not part:IsA("Terrain") then
		if not part:FindFirstChild("MeshFlipbooks") then
			local mf = Instance.new("Folder"); mf.Name = "MeshFlipbooks"; mf.Parent = part
		end
	end

	-- Trail promote-to-emitter: disable source + RT Trail (RT gets re-Enabled on each emit clone).
	-- TrailEmitter properties auto-fill from TypeData.TrailEmitterProperties defaults via Migrate;
	-- explicit per-prop capture isn't required since native Trail values already live on the RT clone.
	if part:IsA("Trail") then
		part.Enabled = false
		if renderTemplate:IsA("Trail") then renderTemplate.Enabled = false end
		-- Default GraphBlender: state 1 seeds from source Trail's current Width / Transparency / Color
		-- so the emit immediately matches the visual the user authored before promoting.
		if not part:FindFirstChild("GraphBlender") then
			local gb = Instance.new("Folder"); gb.Name = "GraphBlender"
			local s1 = Instance.new("Configuration"); s1.Name = "1"
			s1:SetAttribute("Time", 0)
			s1:SetAttribute("Width", part.WidthScale or NumberSequence.new(1))
			s1:SetAttribute("Transparency", part.Transparency or NumberSequence.new(0))
			s1:SetAttribute("Color", part.Color or ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1,1,1)))
			s1:SetAttribute("_AutoTime", true)
			s1.Parent = gb; gb.Parent = part
		end
		if not part:FindFirstChild("TrailFlipbooks") then
			local tf = Instance.new("Folder"); tf.Name = "TrailFlipbooks"; tf.Parent = part
		end
	end

	if part:IsA("Beam") then
		part.Enabled = false
		part.LightInfluence = 0 -- Unlit default
		if renderTemplate:IsA("Beam") then renderTemplate.Enabled = false; renderTemplate.LightInfluence = 0 end

		if not part:FindFirstChild("BeamFlipbooks") then
			local bf = Instance.new("Folder"); bf.Name = "BeamFlipbooks"; bf.Parent = part
		end

		config:SetAttribute("BeamBrightness", NumberSequence.new(part.Brightness))
		config:SetAttribute("CurveSize0", NumberSequence.new(part.CurveSize0))
		config:SetAttribute("CurveSize1", NumberSequence.new(part.CurveSize1))
		config:SetAttribute("Width0", NumberSequence.new(part.Width0))
		config:SetAttribute("Width1", NumberSequence.new(part.Width1))
		config:SetAttribute("LightEmission", NumberSequence.new(part.LightEmission))
		config:SetAttribute("BeamLightInfluence", NumberSequence.new(0))
		config:SetAttribute("Segments", NumberSequence.new(part.Segments))
		config:SetAttribute("TextureLength", NumberSequence.new(part.TextureLength))
		config:SetAttribute("TextureSpeed", NumberSequence.new(part.TextureSpeed))
		config:SetAttribute("FaceCamera", part.FaceCamera)
		config:SetAttribute("ZOffset", part.ZOffset)
		config:SetAttribute("BeamTextureMode", part.TextureMode.Name)

		-- _AutoTime marks states whose Time was set by Add State (vs user-edited via TimeBox).
		local gb = Instance.new("Folder"); gb.Name = "GraphBlender"
		local s1 = Instance.new("Configuration"); s1.Name = "1"
		s1:SetAttribute("Time", 0); s1:SetAttribute("Transparency", part.Transparency); s1:SetAttribute("Color", part.Color)
		s1:SetAttribute("_AutoTime", true)
		s1.Parent = gb; gb.Parent = part
	end

	if not part:FindFirstChild("EmitParent") then
		local ep = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		ep.Name = "EmitParent"
		ep.Value = nil
		ep.Parent = part
	end

	if (part:IsA("BasePart") or part:IsA("Attachment")) and not part:FindFirstChild("Link") then
		local lk = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		lk.Name = "Link"
		lk.Parent = part
	end

	if part:IsA("BasePart") and not part:FindFirstChild("AccelTarget") then
		local at = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		at.Name = "AccelTarget"
		at.Value = nil
		at.Parent = part
	end

	-- ShapePart override: when UseShape=true, particles spawn within this BasePart's volume
	-- (using its Size + CFrame). Default Value = source itself so the picker UI shows the
	-- source explicitly; runtime `data.ShapePart or part` fallback handles unset values.
	if part:IsA("BasePart") and not part:FindFirstChild("ShapePart") then
		local sp = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		sp.Name = "ShapePart"
		sp.Value = part
		sp.Parent = part
	end

	part:SetAttribute("Transformed", true)
	part:SetAttribute("Qwinkle", true)
	-- Beam EmitCount=1 default (one beam = one instance); others default 0 (zero-as-zero contract).
	part:SetAttribute("EmitCount", part:IsA("Beam") and 1 or 0)
	part:SetAttribute("EmitDuration", 0)
	part:SetAttribute("EmitDelay", 0)
	part:SetAttribute("IsEmitter", true)
	if part:IsA("BasePart") or part:IsA("Beam") or part:IsA("Trail") or part:IsA("ImageLabel") then
		part:SetAttribute("PreloadTexture", false)
	end
	-- Atmosphere is singleton-per-Lighting; default to Animate to avoid flickering Emit stacks.
	part:SetAttribute("EmissionMode", part:IsA("Atmosphere") and "Animate" or "Emit")
	part:SetAttribute("AnimateLoop", false)
	-- Link-driven types only. Highlight (Adornee-driven) + Trail (Attachment0/1-driven) skip these.
	if part:IsA("BasePart") or part:IsA("Beam") or part:IsA("Attachment") or part:IsA("Model") then
		part:SetAttribute("LinkMode", "Follow")
		part:SetAttribute("LinkSource", "None")
	end
	pcall(function() Particle.TransformCompleted:Fire(part) end)
end

-- Walk a Part/Beam/Model emit's motion forward step-by-step and return the per-step local CFrames.
-- Called by Motion Preview to draw trajectory lines in the viewport; also reused inside Emit so
-- the live simulation matches the preview without re-deriving the math. The CFrames are local to
-- `parentCF` (Link target or world origin) so a moving Link naturally carries the path with it.
function Particle:PreSimulateForward(data, seeds, initialCF, baseDirection, spreadRotation, link, lifetime, previewMaxSteps, spawnEmitterRotation)
	local linkMode = data.LinkMode or "Follow"
	local parentCF
	if link then
		local worldCF = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(link)
		if linkMode == "Follow" or linkMode == "Pivot" then
			parentCF = CFrame.new(worldCF.Position)
		else parentCF = worldCF end
	else parentCF = CFrame.new() end
	local useVOS = (linkMode == "Weld" or linkMode == "WeldWithoutRotation" or linkMode == "RigidLocal") and link ~= nil
	-- previewMaxSteps caps preview callers; InvertMotion caps emit (per-particle CFrame allocation).
	local INVERT_MAX_STEPS = 500
	local totalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames)
	if previewMaxSteps and totalKeyFrames > previewMaxSteps then
		totalKeyFrames = previewMaxSteps
	elseif data.InvertMotion and totalKeyFrames > INVERT_MAX_STEPS then
		totalKeyFrames = INVERT_MAX_STEPS
	end
	local stepDT = lifetime / totalKeyFrames

	local currentPosition = initialCF.Position
	local localCF = parentCF:ToObjectSpace(initialCF)
	local baseDir = baseDirection
	local emissionDirection = data.EmissionDirection
	local rotMode = data.RotMode or "OverLife"
	local accRotX, accRotY, accRotZ = 0, 0, 0

	-- Snapshot AccelTarget pos at start; InvertMotion's cached CFrames can't track moving targets.
	local hasTargetAccel = data.AccelerationTowardsInstance == true and data.AccelTarget ~= nil and data.AccelStrength ~= nil and not data.InvertMotion
	local targetWorldPos
	if hasTargetAccel then
		local t = data.AccelTarget
		-- Type dispatch matches Update.getTargetPosition (Bone live pose, Model pivot, etc.).
		if t:IsA("Bone") then targetWorldPos = t.TransformedWorldCFrame.Position
		elseif t:IsA("BasePart") then targetWorldPos = t.Position
		elseif t:IsA("Attachment") then targetWorldPos = t.WorldPosition
		elseif t:IsA("Model") then local ok, cf = pcall(t.GetPivot, t); if ok and cf then targetWorldPos = cf.Position end
		end
		if not targetWorldPos then hasTargetAccel = false end
	end
	local targetVel = Vector3.zero
	local accelStrengthSeed = seeds.AccelStrength or {}

	-- PosOffset trajectory state for the precomputation loop. DisplacementMode +
	-- spawnEmitterRotation flow through Constants.resolveDisplacement below so the
	-- cached SimLocalCFrames honour the same frame the live Update.luau path uses.
	-- When spawnEmitterRotation is nil (preview path) it falls back to spawnRotation,
	-- degrading RigidLocal to Local for preview (preview is single-particle, no rotXYZ).
	local hasPosOffset = data.PosOffsetX ~= nil or data.PosOffsetY ~= nil or data.PosOffsetZ ~= nil
	local spawnRotation = initialCF.Rotation
	local prevWorldOff = Vector3.zero

	local localCFrames = {}
	localCFrames[0] = parentCF:ToObjectSpace(initialCF)

	for step = 1, totalKeyFrames do
		local steppedI = step / totalKeyFrames
		local elapsedSec = steppedI * lifetime

		local speed = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, data.Speed, seeds.Speed)
		local draggedSpeed = speed * math.exp(-data.ParticleData.Drag * elapsedSec)

		local accelVelocity = data.ParticleData.Acceleration * elapsedSec

		local displacement = (baseDir * draggedSpeed + accelVelocity) * stepDT

		if hasTargetAccel then
			local toTarget = targetWorldPos - currentPosition
			local dist = toTarget.Magnitude
			if dist > 1e-4 then
				local mag = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, data.AccelStrength, accelStrengthSeed)
				if mag and mag ~= 0 then
					targetVel = targetVel + toTarget * (mag * stepDT / dist)
					displacement = displacement + targetVel * stepDT
				end
			end
		end

		if hasPosOffset then
			local oX = data.PosOffsetX and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, data.PosOffsetX, seeds.PosOffsetX) or 0
			local oY = data.PosOffsetY and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, data.PosOffsetY, seeds.PosOffsetY) or 0
			local oZ = data.PosOffsetZ and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, data.PosOffsetZ, seeds.PosOffsetZ) or 0
			local worldOff = Constants.resolveDisplacement(Vector3.new(oX, oY, oZ),
				data.DisplacementMode or "Global", spawnRotation,
				spawnEmitterRotation or spawnRotation)
			displacement = displacement + (worldOff - prevWorldOff)
			prevWorldOff = worldOff
		end

		-- VOS only for Weld; Follow/Pivot keep world-relative velocity.
		local parentLocalDelta = useVOS and parentCF:VectorToObjectSpace(displacement) or displacement
		localCF = CFrame.new(parentLocalDelta) * localCF

		local rotSpeedX = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, data.RotSpeedX, seeds.RotSpeedX)
		local rotSpeedY = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, data.RotSpeedY, seeds.RotSpeedY)
		local rotSpeedZ = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, data.RotSpeedZ, seeds.RotSpeedZ)

		local rotCF
		local rotOrder = data.RotOrder or "Global"
		if rotMode == "Speed" then
			accRotX = accRotX + rotSpeedX * stepDT
			accRotY = accRotY + rotSpeedY * stepDT
			accRotZ = accRotZ + rotSpeedZ * stepDT
			rotCF = Constants.composeRotation(rotOrder, accRotX, accRotY, accRotZ)
		else
			rotCF = Constants.composeRotation(rotOrder, rotSpeedX, rotSpeedY, rotSpeedZ)
		end

		local worldCF = (parentCF * localCF) * rotCF
		currentPosition = worldCF.Position

		if data.VelocityVectored then
			local dirInfo = DirectionVectors[emissionDirection] or DirectionVectors[Enum.NormalId.Top]
			baseDir = (worldCF * spreadRotation)[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
		end

		localCFrames[step] = parentCF:ToObjectSpace(worldCF)
	end

	return localCFrames, totalKeyFrames
end

-- Attachment variant: no Link param, attachment-local space (initialCF doubles as localCF).
function Particle:PreSimulateAttachmentForward(data, seeds, initialCF, baseDirection, spreadRotation, lifetime, previewMaxSteps, spawnEmitterRotation)
	local INVERT_MAX_STEPS = 500
	local totalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames)
	if previewMaxSteps and totalKeyFrames > previewMaxSteps then
		totalKeyFrames = previewMaxSteps
	elseif data.InvertMotion and totalKeyFrames > INVERT_MAX_STEPS then
		totalKeyFrames = INVERT_MAX_STEPS
	end
	local stepDT = lifetime / totalKeyFrames

	local localCF = initialCF
	local baseDir = baseDirection
	local emissionDirection = data.EmissionDirection
	local rotMode = data.RotMode or "OverLife"
	local accRotX, accRotY, accRotZ = 0, 0, 0
	-- AccelerationTowardsInstance not integrated here (local-space mismatch with world target).
	-- Preview Attachment trajectories diverge from live emit when target accel is enabled.

	-- PosOffset trajectory state. Routes through Constants.resolveDisplacement with
	-- DisplacementMode + spawnEmitterRotation so cached frames match live Update path.
	local hasPosOffset = data.PosOffsetX ~= nil or data.PosOffsetY ~= nil or data.PosOffsetZ ~= nil
	local spawnRotation = initialCF.Rotation
	local prevWorldOff = Vector3.zero

	local localCFrames = {}
	localCFrames[0] = initialCF

	for step = 1, totalKeyFrames do
		local steppedI = step / totalKeyFrames
		local elapsedSec = steppedI * lifetime

		local speed = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, data.Speed, seeds.Speed)
		local draggedSpeed = speed * math.exp(-data.ParticleData.Drag * elapsedSec)

		local accelVelocity = data.ParticleData.Acceleration * elapsedSec
		local displacement = (baseDir * draggedSpeed + accelVelocity) * stepDT

		if hasPosOffset then
			local oX = data.PosOffsetX and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, data.PosOffsetX, seeds.PosOffsetX) or 0
			local oY = data.PosOffsetY and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, data.PosOffsetY, seeds.PosOffsetY) or 0
			local oZ = data.PosOffsetZ and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, data.PosOffsetZ, seeds.PosOffsetZ) or 0
			local worldOff = Constants.resolveDisplacement(Vector3.new(oX, oY, oZ),
				data.DisplacementMode or "Global", spawnRotation,
				spawnEmitterRotation or spawnRotation)
			displacement = displacement + (worldOff - prevWorldOff)
			prevWorldOff = worldOff
		end

		localCF = CFrame.new(displacement) * localCF

		-- Rotation
		local rotSpeedX = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, data.RotSpeedX, seeds.RotSpeedX)
		local rotSpeedY = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, data.RotSpeedY, seeds.RotSpeedY)
		local rotSpeedZ = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, data.RotSpeedZ, seeds.RotSpeedZ)

		local rotCF
		local rotOrder = data.RotOrder or "Global"
		if rotMode == "Speed" then
			accRotX = accRotX + rotSpeedX * stepDT
			accRotY = accRotY + rotSpeedY * stepDT
			accRotZ = accRotZ + rotSpeedZ * stepDT
			rotCF = Constants.composeRotation(rotOrder, accRotX, accRotY, accRotZ)
		else
			rotCF = Constants.composeRotation(rotOrder, rotSpeedX, rotSpeedY, rotSpeedZ)
		end

		local worldCF = localCF * rotCF

		if data.VelocityVectored then
			local dirVecInfo = DirectionVectors[emissionDirection] or DirectionVectors[Enum.NormalId.Top]
			baseDir = (worldCF * spreadRotation)[dirVecInfo.vector] * dirVecInfo.multiplier
		end

		localCFrames[step] = worldCF
	end

	return localCFrames, totalKeyFrames
end

-- Model Transform: RT is whole Model subtree; original descendants hidden, not destroyed
-- (preserves Motor6Ds / AnimationControllers for playtest).
function Particle:TransformModel(model, typeDef)
	if model:GetAttribute("Transformed") then return end
	local config = TypeRegistry.createConfig(model, typeDef)

	-- Create RenderTemplate (clean clone of the Model)
	local renderTemplate = model:Clone()
	renderTemplate.Name = "RenderTemplate"

	for _, child in renderTemplate:GetChildren() do
		if child.Name == TypeRegistry.CONFIG_NAME or child.Name == "EmitParent" or child.Name == "Link" or child.Name == "AccelTarget" then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end

	for _, attrName in ipairs({"Transformed", "Qwinkle", "IsEmitter", "EmitCount", "EmitDuration", "EmitDelay", "EmissionMode", "AnimateLoop"}) do
		renderTemplate:SetAttribute(attrName, nil)
	end

	-- Anchor + safe-clone every BasePart; silence native PEs/Trails (they ignore parent hidden state).
	for _, desc in renderTemplate:GetDescendants() do
		if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
			desc.Anchored = true; desc.CanCollide = false; desc.CanQuery = false
			desc.CanTouch = false; desc.CastShadow = false; desc.Massless = true; desc.Locked = true
		elseif (desc:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or desc:IsA("Trail"))
			and not desc:GetAttribute("Transformed")
		then
			desc.Enabled = false
		end
	end

	renderTemplate.Parent = model

	-- Hide originals; visuals moved to RT.
	for _, desc in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsDescendantOf(renderTemplate) then continue end
		if desc:IsA("BasePart") then desc.Transparency = 1
		elseif desc:IsA("SpecialMesh") or desc:IsA("Decal") or desc:IsA("Texture") then desc:Destroy() end
	end

	if not model:FindFirstChild("EmitParent") then
		local ep = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		ep.Name = "EmitParent"
		ep.Value = nil
		ep.Parent = model
	end

	if not model:FindFirstChild("Link") then
		local lk = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		lk.Name = "Link"
		lk.Parent = model
	end

	model:SetAttribute("Transformed", true)
	model:SetAttribute("Qwinkle", true)
	model:SetAttribute("EmitCount", 0)
	model:SetAttribute("EmitDuration", 0)
	model:SetAttribute("EmitDelay", 0)
	model:SetAttribute("IsEmitter", true)
	model:SetAttribute("PreloadTexture", false)
	model:SetAttribute("EmissionMode", "Emit")
	model:SetAttribute("AnimateLoop", false)
	model:SetAttribute("LinkMode", "Follow")
	model:SetAttribute("LinkSource", "None")
	pcall(function() Particle.TransformCompleted:Fire(model) end)
end

end

children.name: TypeRegistry
children.source:
--[[
	TypeRegistry  -  schema source of truth for every Part-Icle type.
	TypeData.luau + TypeDataScreen.luau hold per-type tables; this file is generic read/write.
	Enums serialize by Name (string) and deserialize via Enum[enumType][name].
]]

local TypeData = require(script.TypeData)

export type TypeDef = {
	classCheck: (Instance) -> boolean,
	pDataType: string,
	uiSection: string,
	properties: {[string]: {[string]: any}},
	resize: {[string]: any}?,
	retime: {[string]: any}?,
	clipboard: {any}?,
	directAccess: boolean?,
}

local TypeRegistry = {}

TypeRegistry.CONFIG_NAME = "PartIcleProperties"
TypeRegistry.Types = TypeData.Types

-- Returns (typeDef, typeName) or (nil, nil).
function TypeRegistry.getTypeFor(item): (TypeDef?, string?)
	for typeName, typeDef in pairs(TypeRegistry.Types) do
		if typeDef.classCheck(item) then
			return typeDef, typeName
		end
	end
	return nil, nil
end

function TypeRegistry.getTypeName(item): string?
	local _, name = TypeRegistry.getTypeFor(item)
	return name
end

function TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
	return item:FindFirstChild(TypeRegistry.CONFIG_NAME)
end

-- Resolve attrName overrides (BeamBrightness, PLRange, etc.); falls back to propName.
function TypeRegistry.getAttrName(typeDef, propName): string
	local propDef = typeDef.properties[propName]
	if propDef and propDef.attrName then
		return propDef.attrName
	end
	return propName
end

-- Read property value; enum returns EnumItem (not string).
function TypeRegistry.read(item, propName): any
	local typeDef = TypeRegistry.getTypeFor(item)
	if not typeDef then return nil end
	local propDef = typeDef.properties[propName]
	if not propDef then return nil end

	if typeDef.directAccess then
		if propDef.attribute then
			local attrName = propDef.attrName or propName
			local raw = item:GetAttribute(attrName)
			-- Explicit nil-check so stored `false` round-trips correctly.
			if raw ~= nil then return raw end
			return propDef.default
		end
		local ok, val = pcall(function() return item[propName] end)
		if ok and val ~= nil then return val end
		return propDef.default
	end

	local config = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
	if not config then return nil end

	local attrName = TypeRegistry.getAttrName(typeDef, propName)
	local raw = config:GetAttribute(attrName)

	if raw == nil then return propDef.default end

	if propDef.type == "enum" and type(raw) == "string" then
		-- Enum[type][name] raises on invalid names; pcall-wrap.
		local ok, enumVal = pcall(function() return Enum[propDef.enumType][raw] end)
		if ok and enumVal then return enumVal end
		return propDef.default
	end

	return raw
end

-- Bump RT _PoolGen so Pool flushes stale-look entries on next acquire. Inlined to keep
-- TypeRegistry's no-upward-dependency invariant (would otherwise require Pool).
local function _bumpPoolGen(item)
	local rt = item:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
	if not rt then return end
	local cur = rt:GetAttribute("_PoolGen") or 0
	pcall(function() rt:SetAttribute("_PoolGen", cur + 1) end)
end

-- Bump RenderTemplate's _PoolGen so pooled visuals invalidate. UI paths that
-- mutate RT directly (Material, Beam Texture, Attachment0/1) call this.
function TypeRegistry.bumpPoolGen(item)
	if not item then return end
	_bumpPoolGen(item)
end

-- Clamp NumberSequence so each keypoint Value >= 0 and Envelope <= Value.
local function _clampNonNegativeSeq(value)
	if typeof(value) ~= "NumberSequence" then return value end
	local kps = value.Keypoints
	local needsClamp = false
	for _, kp in ipairs(kps) do
		if kp.Value < 0 or kp.Envelope > kp.Value then needsClamp = true; break end
	end
	if not needsClamp then return value end
	local clamped = {}
	for _, kp in ipairs(kps) do
		local v = math.max(0, kp.Value)
		local e = math.max(0, math.min(kp.Envelope, v))
		table.insert(clamped, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(kp.Time, v, e))
	end
	return NumberSequence.new(clamped)
end

-- NaN/invalid guard: refuse writes that would persist garbage (NaN keypoints, infinite
-- numbers, malformed NumberSequence). Runtime guards degrade gracefully but stale-invalid
-- attrs survive across sessions and silently misbehave; reject at the write boundary so
-- the prior good value stays intact.
local function _isInvalidNumber(n)
	return type(n) == "number" and (n ~= n or n == math.huge or n == -math.huge)
end
local function _isInvalidValue(value)
	if type(value) == "number" then return _isInvalidNumber(value) end
	if typeof(value) == "NumberRange" then return _isInvalidNumber(value.Min) or _isInvalidNumber(value.Max) end
	if typeof(value) == "NumberSequence" then
		for _, kp in ipairs(value.Keypoints) do
			if _isInvalidNumber(kp.Time) or _isInvalidNumber(kp.Value) or _isInvalidNumber(kp.Envelope) then
				return true
			end
			if kp.Time < 0 or kp.Time > 1 then return true end
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- Write property value; enum stored as Name string (config) or EnumItem (direct).
function TypeRegistry.write(item, propName, value)
	if _isInvalidValue(value) then
		warn("[Part-Icles] TypeRegistry.write rejected invalid value for " .. tostring(propName))
		return
	end
	local typeDef = TypeRegistry.getTypeFor(item)
	if not typeDef then return end
	local propDef = typeDef.properties[propName]
	if not propDef then return end

	if typeDef.directAccess then
		if propDef.nonNegative then
			value = _clampNonNegativeSeq(value)
		end
		if propDef.attribute then
			local attrName = propDef.attrName or propName
			item:SetAttribute(attrName, value)
		else
			pcall(function() item[propName] = value end)
		end
		_bumpPoolGen(item)
		return
	end

	local config = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
	if not config then return end

	local attrName = TypeRegistry.getAttrName(typeDef, propName)

	if propDef.type == "enum" then
		if typeof(value) == "EnumItem" then
			config:SetAttribute(attrName, value.Name)
		else
			config:SetAttribute(attrName, tostring(value))
		end
	else
		-- nonNegative: clamp NumberSequence Value AND Envelope so Value + rand[-E,+E] >= 0.
		if propDef.nonNegative and typeof(value) == "NumberSequence" then
			local kps = value.Keypoints
			local needsClamp = false
			for _, kp in ipairs(kps) do
				if kp.Value < 0 or kp.Envelope > kp.Value then needsClamp = true; break end
			end
			if needsClamp then
				local clamped = {}
				for _, kp in ipairs(kps) do
					local v = math.max(0, kp.Value)
					local e = math.max(0, math.min(kp.Envelope, v))
					table.insert(clamped, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(kp.Time, v, e))
				end
				value = NumberSequence.new(clamped)
			end
		end
		config:SetAttribute(attrName, value)
	end
	_bumpPoolGen(item)
end

-- Read every property into a flat table (generic GetData).
function TypeRegistry.readAll(item): {[string]: any}?
	local typeDef = TypeRegistry.getTypeFor(item)
	if not typeDef then return nil end
	local config = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
	if not config then return nil end

	local data = {}
	for propName, propDef in pairs(typeDef.properties) do
		local attrName = TypeRegistry.getAttrName(typeDef, propName)
		local raw = config:GetAttribute(attrName)
		if raw == nil then
			data[propName] = propDef.default
		elseif propDef.type == "enum" and type(raw) == "string" then
			data[propName] = Enum[propDef.enumType][raw]
		else
			data[propName] = raw
		end
	end
	return data
end

-- Stamp every default property; called by Transform.
function TypeRegistry.writeDefaults(config, typeDef)
	for propName, propDef in pairs(typeDef.properties) do
		local attrName = propDef.attrName or propName
		local value = propDef.default
		if propDef.type == "enum" then
			config:SetAttribute(attrName, value.Name)
		else
			config:SetAttribute(attrName, value)
		end
	end
end

-- New Configuration with defaults stamped; parented to item.
function TypeRegistry.createConfig(item, typeDef)
	local config = Instance.new("Configuration")
	config.Name = TypeRegistry.CONFIG_NAME
	TypeRegistry.writeDefaults(config, typeDef)
	config.Parent = item
	return config
end

function TypeRegistry.isGraph(propDef): boolean
	return propDef.type == "NumberSequence" or propDef.type == "ColorSequence"
end

function TypeRegistry.isNonNegative(propDef): boolean
	return propDef.nonNegative == true
end

function TypeRegistry.getPropDef(typeName, propName)
	local typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types[typeName]
	if not typeDef then return nil end
	return typeDef.properties[propName]
end

-- Type-aware default lookup; required because pairs() over Types isn't order-stable.
function TypeRegistry.getDefault(typeName, propName)
	local typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types[typeName]
	if not typeDef then return nil end
	local propDef = typeDef.properties[propName]
	if not propDef then return nil end
	return propDef.default
end

return TypeRegistry

children.name: TypeData
children.source:
--[[
	TypeData  -  property descriptors for 3D / workspace types (Part / Beam / PointLight /
	Attachment / Model / Trail). Screen types live in TypeDataScreen.luau (500-line split).

	Property entry: { type, default, attrName?, enumType?, nonNegative?, attribute? }
	  attrName    config attribute name override (avoids collision with native props)
	  enumType    Roblox Enum category name (required for type="enum")
	  nonNegative NumberSequence keypoints clamped to >= 0 on write
	  attribute   directAccess only  -  store as instance attribute, not property
]]

local TypeData = {}

TypeData.PartProperties = {
	-- Graph properties (NumberSequence)
	Brightness    = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(1) },
	Color         = { type = "ColorSequence", default = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1,1,1)) },
	SizeX         = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(1), nonNegative = true },
	SizeY         = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(1), nonNegative = true },
	SizeZ         = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(1), nonNegative = true },
	Transparency  = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0) },
	Speed         = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0) },
	-- Per-axis position offset graphs over normalized life (studs, spawn-local frame).
	-- Trajectory shape, distinct from emit-time PosX/Y/Z NumberRange spreads below.
	-- Composed ADDITIVELY with Speed × Direction via per-frame delta accumulation.
	PosOffsetX    = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0) },
	PosOffsetY    = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0) },
	PosOffsetZ    = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0) },
	RotSpeedX     = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0) },
	RotSpeedY     = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0) },
	RotSpeedZ     = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0) },
	-- Timescale graph: scales per-frame elapsed-time advancement. Default constant 1
	-- means real-time playback. <1 slows, 0 freezes, >1 speeds up, NEGATIVE rewinds (v2).
	-- Sampled at REAL normalized time `(now - StartTime) / LifeTime` so the graph
	-- progresses monotonically through its keypoints regardless of which direction
	-- the particle's effective time is moving. Initial `_effectiveElapsed` depends on
	-- the graph's value at i=0: ts(0) >= 0 → particle starts at 0 and plays forward;
	-- ts(0) < 0 → particle starts at LifeTime (end-state visual) and rewinds to 0.
	-- This is what makes a STATIC `Timescale = -1` produce end-to-start playback.
	-- Runtime: `dt *= ts(real_i)`, `_effectiveElapsed += dt` clamped to [0, LifeTime].
	-- Death rule: ONLY after the graph has finished playing (real_i >= 1) does a
	-- boundary cross (effective hit 0 or LifeTime) trigger death. During graph
	-- playback the particle bounces freely between bounds  -  users can author graphs
	-- that overshoot either bound without prematurely killing the particle. Sticky-
	-- zero post-graph (last-keypoint ts == 0 + effective stuck mid-life) is
	-- documented user error: no real-time cap, particle leaks the slot.
	Timescale     = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(1) },

	-- Non-graph properties
	Lifetime          = { type = "NumberRange",  default = NumberRange.new(1) },
	Rate              = { type = "number",       default = 10 },
	Drag              = { type = "number",       default = 0 },
	Acceleration      = { type = "Vector3",      default = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) },
	SpreadAngle       = { type = "Vector2",      default = Vector2.new(0, 0) },
	RotX              = { type = "NumberRange",   default = NumberRange.new(0) },
	RotY              = { type = "NumberRange",   default = NumberRange.new(0) },
	RotZ              = { type = "NumberRange",   default = NumberRange.new(0) },
	PosX              = { type = "NumberRange",   default = NumberRange.new(0) },
	PosY              = { type = "NumberRange",   default = NumberRange.new(0) },
	PosZ              = { type = "NumberRange",   default = NumberRange.new(0) },
	PosMode           = { type = "string",       default = "Local" },
	RotMode           = { type = "string",       default = "OverLife" },
	RotOrder          = { type = "string",       default = "Global" },
	TotalKeyFrames    = { type = "number",       default = 100 },
	PartLife          = { type = "number",       default = 0, nonNegative = true },
	ShapePartial      = { type = "number",       default = 0 },
	VelocityVectored  = { type = "boolean",      default = false },
	DirMode           = { type = "string",       default = "RigidLocal" },
	-- Frame for PosOffsetX/Y/Z over-life graphs. Mirrors DirMode's role for
	-- Speed but applied to displacement-through-life instead of velocity.
	-- Global = world axes; Local = particle's spawn frame (post-RotXYZ);
	-- RigidLocal = emitter's frame at spawn (pre-RotXYZ).
	DisplacementMode  = { type = "string",       default = "Global" },
	InvertMotion      = { type = "boolean",      default = false },
	Enabled           = { type = "boolean",      default = false },

	-- Target acceleration. AccelerationTowardsInstance gates the AccelStrength + AccelTarget pair.
	-- AccelStrength is a non-negative scalar magnitude over normalized particle lifetime.
	-- AccelTarget is the picked instance (stored as ObjectValue child, not attribute -- see Transform).
	AccelerationTowardsInstance = { type = "boolean",        default = false },
	AccelStrength               = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0), nonNegative = true },

	-- Axis links: per-axis "LinkedTo" attribute names the primary axis whose graph + seed (or
	-- per-emit sampled range value) the follower axis should adopt. Stored as full property
	-- keys (e.g. SizeYLinkedTo = "SizeX"). Registered here so QOL snapshot/Migrate see them.
	-- Default "" means unlinked; GetData sanitizes empty/invalid values to nil. Clipboard
	-- companion-copy (auto-include LinkedTo when its primary axis is copied) is a separate
	-- piece of work  -  registration alone does not make per-prop clipboard preserve them.
	SizeXLinkedTo        = { type = "string", default = "" },
	SizeYLinkedTo        = { type = "string", default = "" },
	SizeZLinkedTo        = { type = "string", default = "" },
	RotSpeedXLinkedTo    = { type = "string", default = "" },
	RotSpeedYLinkedTo    = { type = "string", default = "" },
	RotSpeedZLinkedTo    = { type = "string", default = "" },
	PosOffsetXLinkedTo   = { type = "string", default = "" },

	-- Native Beam (directAccess): plain Beam without PartIcleProperties. Read/write directly

		},

	Trail = {
		classCheck = function(item) return item:IsA("Trail") and item:FindFirstChild("PartIcleProperties") == nil end,

			{name = "Emission", props = {"Duration"}},

		clipboard = {
			{name = "Spawning", props = {"Rate", "Lifetime", "SpreadAngle", "EmissionDirection", "PosX", "PosY", "PosZ", "PosXEven", "PosYEven", "PosZEven", "PosMode", "Orientation", "ZOffset"}},

			{name = "Movement", props = {"Speed", "PosOffsetX", "PosOffsetY", "PosOffsetZ", "RotMode", "RotOrder", "RotSpeedX", "RotSpeedY", "RotSpeedZ", "Acceleration", "Drag", "DirMode", "DisplacementMode", "InvertMotion", "Timescale"}},
			{name = "Advanced", props = {"TotalKeyFrames", "PartLife", "RotX", "RotY", "RotZ", "RotXEven", "RotYEven", "RotZEven", "Pool"}},
			{name = "Events", props = {"OnEmit", "OnDeath", "OnDestruction", "OnHit"}},

	Model = {
		classCheck = function(item) return item:IsA("Model") end,

		properties = TypeData.ModelProperties,

		resize = {

			scaleVectors = { "Acceleration" },
			scaleRanges = { "PosX", "PosY", "PosZ" },
		},
		retime = {
			multiplyNumbers = { "Rate", "Drag" },
			divideRanges = { "Lifetime" },
			multiplyGraphs = { "Speed" },
			rotSpeedGraphs = { "RotSpeedX", "RotSpeedY", "RotSpeedZ" },
			squareVectors = { "Acceleration" },
		},
		clipboard = {
			{name = "Spawning", props = {"Rate", "Lifetime", "SpreadAngle", "EmissionDirection", "PosX", "PosY", "PosZ", "PosXEven", "PosYEven", "PosZEven", "PosMode", "Orientation", "ZOffset"}},
			{name = "Emission", props = {"EmitCount", "EmitDelay", "EmitDuration"}},
			{name = "Scale", props = {"Scale", "ScaleTextureLength"}},
			{name = "Movement", props = {"Speed", "PosOffsetX", "PosOffsetY", "PosOffsetZ", "RotMode", "RotOrder", "RotSpeedX", "RotSpeedY", "RotSpeedZ", "Acceleration", "Drag", "DirMode", "DisplacementMode", "InvertMotion", "Timescale"}},

children.source:
-- TypeDataScreen  -  Property tables + Types entries for the five screen-space types:
-- Blur, Bloom, ColorCorrection, Atmosphere, ImageLabel.
-- Shape + schema identical to TypeData  -  see that file's header for the property-entry format.

local Screen = {}

Screen.BlurProperties = {
	-- Graph properties
	Size           = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(10), attrName = "BlurSize", nonNegative = true },

	-- Timescale graph: see TypeData.PartProperties for full semantics.
	Timescale      = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(1) },

	-- Non-graph properties
	Lifetime       = { type = "NumberRange", default = NumberRange.new(1) },
	Rate           = { type = "number",      default = 10 },
	TotalKeyFrames = { type = "number",      default = 100 },
	PartLife       = { type = "number",      default = 0 },
	Enabled        = { type = "boolean",     default = false },
}

Screen.BloomProperties = {
	-- Graph properties (per BloomEffect spec: Intensity 0..1, Size 0..56, Threshold 0..10)
	Intensity      = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0.4),  attrName = "BloomIntensity", nonNegative = true },
	Size           = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(24),   attrName = "BloomSize",      nonNegative = true },
	Threshold      = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0.95), attrName = "BloomThreshold", nonNegative = true },

	-- Timescale graph: see TypeData.PartProperties for full semantics.
	Timescale      = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(1) },

	-- Non-graph properties
	Lifetime       = { type = "NumberRange", default = NumberRange.new(1) },
	Rate           = { type = "number",      default = 10 },
	TotalKeyFrames = { type = "number",      default = 100 },
	PartLife       = { type = "number",      default = 0 },
	Enabled        = { type = "boolean",     default = false },
}

Screen.ColorCorrectionProperties = {
	-- Graph properties (all signed: -1..1 range, so no nonNegative)
	Brightness     = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0), attrName = "CCBrightness" },
	Contrast       = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0), attrName = "CCContrast" },
	Saturation     = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0), attrName = "CCSaturation" },
	TintColor      = { type = "ColorSequence",  default = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1,1,1)), attrName = "CCTintColor" },

	-- Timescale graph: see TypeData.PartProperties for full semantics.
	Timescale      = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(1) },

	-- Non-graph properties
