	TotalKeyFrames = { type = "number",      default = 100 },
	PartLife       = { type = "number",      default = 0 },
	Enabled        = { type = "boolean",     default = false },
}

Screen.AtmosphereProperties = {
	-- Graph properties (Density/Offset 0..1, Glare 0..24, Haze 0..10 per Atmosphere spec)
	Density        = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0.3),  attrName = "AtmDensity", nonNegative = true },
	Offset         = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0.25), attrName = "AtmOffset",  nonNegative = true },
	Glare          = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0),    attrName = "AtmGlare",   nonNegative = true },
	Haze           = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0),    attrName = "AtmHaze",    nonNegative = true },
	Color          = { type = "ColorSequence",  default = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(0.78, 0.78, 0.78)), attrName = "AtmColor" },
	Decay          = { type = "ColorSequence",  default = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(0.416, 0.471, 0.541)), attrName = "AtmDecay" },
	-- Timescale graph: see TypeData.PartProperties for full semantics.
	Timescale      = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(1), attrName = "AtmTimescale" },

	-- Non-graph properties (Atmosphere has no native Enabled; we track it for emission timing only)
	Lifetime       = { type = "NumberRange", default = NumberRange.new(1) },
	Rate           = { type = "number",      default = 10 },
	TotalKeyFrames = { type = "number",      default = 100 },
	PartLife       = { type = "number",      default = 0 },
	Enabled        = { type = "boolean",     default = false },
}

Screen.ImageLabelProperties = {
	-- Graph properties (animate per-life)
	ImageTransparency       = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0) },
	BackgroundTransparency  = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(1) }, -- default invisible
	Speed                   = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0), attrName = "ImgSpeed", nonNegative = true },

	-- Per-axis Size scale graphs (multiply base Size components per frame). Keys match the
	-- axis_graph_select widget's expected naming (baseKey "SizeScale" + axis "X"/"Y").
	SizeScaleX              = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(1), nonNegative = true },
	SizeScaleY              = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(1), nonNegative = true },

	-- Rotation system (RotRange for random initial; RotSpeed graph for continuous/over-life spin; RotMode switches semantics)
	RotRange                = { type = "NumberRange",    default = NumberRange.new(0),   attrName = "ImgRotRange" },
	RotSpeed                = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0), attrName = "ImgRotSpeed" },
	RotMode                 = { type = "string",         default = "OverLife",            attrName = "ImgRotMode" },

	-- ColorSequences
	ImageColor3             = { type = "ColorSequence",  default = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1,1,1)) },
	BackgroundColor3        = { type = "ColorSequence",  default = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1,1,1)) },

	-- Static at emit
	Image             = { type = "string",    default = "" },
	Position          = { type = "UDim2",     default = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5) },
	Size              = { type = "UDim2",     default = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 100), attrName = "ImgSize" },
	AnchorPoint       = { type = "Vector2",   default = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5) },
	ZIndex            = { type = "number",    default = 1 },
	ScaleType         = { type = "enum",      enumType = "ScaleType",       default = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch },
	ResampleMode      = { type = "enum",      enumType = "ResamplerMode",   default = Enum.ResamplerMode.Default },

	-- 2D motion
	EmissionAngle     = { type = "number",    default = 90 }, -- 90 = up, 0 = right, 180 = left, 270 = down
	SpreadAngle       = { type = "number",    default = 0, attrName = "ImgSpreadAngle" },
	Acceleration      = { type = "Vector2",   default = Vector2.new(0, 0), attrName = "ImgAcceleration" },
	Drag              = { type = "number",    default = 0, attrName = "ImgDrag" },
	InvertMotion      = { type = "boolean",   default = false, attrName = "ImgInvertMotion" },

	-- Flipbook source type (asset layout)  -  "Decals" = numbered-Decals folder, "Spritesheet" = grid on single Image.
	FlipbookSource     = { type = "string",      default = "Decals", attrName = "ImgFlipbookSource" },
	-- Flipbook playback mode  -  matches Roblox's Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode convention (Loop/OneShot/PingPong/Random).
	FlipbookMode       = { type = "enum",        enumType = "ParticleFlipbookMode", default = Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.Loop, attrName = "ImgFlipbookMode" },
	FlipbookStartRandom = { type = "boolean",    default = false, attrName = "ImgFlipbookStartRandom" },
	GridCols           = { type = "number",      default = 8 },
	GridRows           = { type = "number",      default = 1 },
	FlipbookFramerate  = { type = "NumberRange", default = NumberRange.new(10), attrName = "ImgFlipbookFramerate" },
	FlipbookReverse    = { type = "boolean",     default = false, attrName = "ImgFlipbookReverse" },

	-- Timescale graph: see TypeData.PartProperties for full semantics.
	Timescale      = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(1), attrName = "ImgTimescale" },

	-- Standard
	Lifetime       = { type = "NumberRange", default = NumberRange.new(1) },
	Rate           = { type = "number",      default = 10 },
	TotalKeyFrames = { type = "number",      default = 100 },
	PartLife       = { type = "number",      default = 0 },
	Enabled        = { type = "boolean",     default = false },
}

Screen.Types = {
	Blur = {
		classCheck = function(item) return item:IsA("BlurEffect") end,
		pDataType = "Blur",
		uiSection = "Blurs",
		properties = Screen.BlurProperties,
		resize = { scaleGraphs = { "Size" } },
		retime = { multiplyNumbers = { "Rate" }, divideRanges = { "Lifetime" } },
		clipboard = {
			{name = "Spawning",   props = {"Rate", "Lifetime"}},
			{name = "Emission",   props = {"EmitCount", "EmitDelay", "EmitDuration"}},
			{name = "Appearance", props = {"Size"}},
			{name = "Advanced",   props = {"TotalKeyFrames", "PartLife", "Timescale"}},
			{name = "Events",     props = {"OnEmit", "OnDeath", "OnDestruction"}},
		},
	},

	Bloom = {
		classCheck = function(item) return item:IsA("BloomEffect") end,
		pDataType = "Bloom",
		uiSection = "Blooms",
		properties = Screen.BloomProperties,
		resize = { scaleGraphs = { "Size" } },
		retime = { multiplyNumbers = { "Rate" }, divideRanges = { "Lifetime" } },
		clipboard = {
			{name = "Spawning",   props = {"Rate", "Lifetime"}},
			{name = "Emission",   props = {"EmitCount", "EmitDelay", "EmitDuration"}},
			{name = "Appearance", props = {"Intensity", "Size", "Threshold"}},
			{name = "Advanced",   props = {"TotalKeyFrames", "PartLife", "Timescale"}},
			{name = "Events",     props = {"OnEmit", "OnDeath", "OnDestruction"}},
		},
	},

	ColorCorrection = {
		classCheck = function(item) return item:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") end,
		pDataType = "ColorCorrection",
		uiSection = "ColorCorrections",
		properties = Screen.ColorCorrectionProperties,
		resize = {},
		retime = { multiplyNumbers = { "Rate" }, divideRanges = { "Lifetime" } },
		clipboard = {
			{name = "Spawning",   props = {"Rate", "Lifetime"}},
			{name = "Emission",   props = {"EmitCount", "EmitDelay", "EmitDuration"}},
			{name = "Appearance", props = {"Brightness", "Contrast", "Saturation", "TintColor"}},
			{name = "Advanced",   props = {"TotalKeyFrames", "PartLife", "Timescale"}},
			{name = "Events",     props = {"OnEmit", "OnDeath", "OnDestruction"}},
		},
	},

	Atmosphere = {
		classCheck = function(item) return item:IsA("Atmosphere") end,
		pDataType = "Atmosphere",
		uiSection = "Atmospheres",
		properties = Screen.AtmosphereProperties,
		resize = {},
		retime = { multiplyNumbers = { "Rate" }, divideRanges = { "Lifetime" } },
		clipboard = {
			{name = "Spawning",   props = {"Rate", "Lifetime"}},
			{name = "Emission",   props = {"EmitCount", "EmitDelay", "EmitDuration"}},
			{name = "Appearance", props = {"Density", "Offset", "Glare", "Haze", "Color", "Decay"}},
			{name = "Advanced",   props = {"TotalKeyFrames", "PartLife", "Timescale"}},
			{name = "Events",     props = {"OnEmit", "OnDeath", "OnDestruction"}},
		},

	ImageLabel = {
		classCheck = function(item) return item:IsA("ImageLabel") end,
		pDataType = "ImageLabel",
		uiSection = "ImageLabels",
		properties = Screen.ImageLabelProperties,
		resize = {
			-- Pixel-sized bits scale: Speed graph (px/sec), per-axis size scale graphs, Acceleration (Vector2),
			-- and the UDim2 Position/Size rectangles (both Scale and Offset components scale together).
			scaleGraphs  = { "Speed", "SizeScaleX", "SizeScaleY" },
			scaleVectors = { "Acceleration" },
			scaleUDim2s  = { "Position", "Size" },

		retime = {
			multiplyNumbers = { "Rate", "Drag" },
			divideRanges    = { "Lifetime" },
			multiplyRanges  = { "FlipbookFramerate" },
			multiplyGraphs  = { "Speed", "RotSpeed" },
			-- Acceleration is studs/sec² (or screen-pixels/sec² here); kinematic shape preserved
			-- under retime requires factor² scaling. Other types include this; ImageLabel was missing.
			squareVectors   = { "Acceleration" },
		},
		clipboard = {
			{name = "Spawning",   props = {"Rate", "Lifetime", "RotRange", "RotSpeed", "RotMode"}},
			{name = "Emission",   props = {"EmitCount", "EmitDelay", "EmitDuration"}},
			{name = "Appearance", props = {"Image", "ImageColor3", "ImageTransparency", "BackgroundColor3", "BackgroundTransparency", "ScaleType", "ResampleMode"}},

			{name = "Layout",     props = {"Position", "Size", "SizeScaleX", "SizeScaleY", "AnchorPoint", "ZIndex"}},

			{name = "Flipbook",   props = {"FlipbookSource", "FlipbookMode", "FlipbookStartRandom", "GridCols", "GridRows", "FlipbookFramerate", "FlipbookReverse"}},
			{name = "Advanced",   props = {"TotalKeyFrames", "PartLife", "Timescale"}},
			{name = "Events",     props = {"OnEmit", "OnDeath", "OnDestruction"}},
		},
	},
}

return Screen

children.source:
--[[
	Update Mixin  -  per-frame update for Part / Beam / Attachment.
	Returns true when Lifetime expires (swap-and-pop or animate-loop reset).
	Hot-path zero-allocation contract: no CFrame/Vector3/table creation in step loops.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local EventsCollision = require(script.Parent.EventsCollision)
local DirectionVectors = Constants.DirectionVectors

-- Per-frame parent CFrame for linked particles. Weld uses full link CFrame; Follow/Pivot strip rotation.
-- RigidLocal reads the at-emit snapshot in pData._rigidLocalParentCF; live link motion is ignored.
local function getLinkCF(pData)
	local lk = pData.Link
	if not (lk and lk.Parent) then return CFrame.new(), false end
	local worldCF
	if pData.LinkMode == "RigidLocal" then
		worldCF = pData._rigidLocalParentCF or CFrame.new()
	else
		worldCF = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(lk)
	end
	if pData.LinkMode == "Follow" or pData.LinkMode == "Pivot" then
		return CFrame.new(worldCF.Position), false
	end
	return worldCF, true
end

-- Attachment variant: convert link world CFrame → visual's parent-local space.
-- RigidLocal reads the snapshot (world); conversion to visualParent-local still runs
-- per-frame so a moving visualParent stays correct.
local function getAttachmentLinkCF(pData)
	local lk = pData.Link
	if not (lk and lk.Parent) then return CFrame.new(), false, false end
	local visualParent = pData.VisualPart and pData.VisualPart.Parent
	if not visualParent then return CFrame.new(), false, false end
	local linkWorldCF
	if pData.LinkMode == "RigidLocal" then
		linkWorldCF = pData._rigidLocalParentCF or CFrame.new()
	else
		linkWorldCF = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(lk)
	end
	local convCF = visualParent:IsA("BasePart") and visualParent.CFrame or CFrame.new()
	local linkLocalCF = convCF:ToObjectSpace(linkWorldCF)
	if pData.LinkMode == "Follow" or pData.LinkMode == "Pivot" then
		return CFrame.new(linkLocalCF.Position), false, true
	end
	return linkLocalCF, true, true
end

-- World position for target-accel; nil for destroyed / no-Position types.
-- Bone before BasePart (Bone IS-A BasePart but .Position is bind pose, not live).
local function getTargetPosition(target)
	if not target or not target.Parent then return nil end
	if target:IsA("Bone") then return target.TransformedWorldCFrame.Position end
	if target:IsA("BasePart") then return target.Position end
	if target:IsA("Attachment") then return target.WorldPosition end
	if target:IsA("Camera") then return target.CFrame.Position end
	if target:IsA("Model") then local ok, cf = pcall(target.GetPivot, target); if ok and cf then return cf.Position end end
	return nil
end

-- PosOffsetX/Y/Z over-life graph → per-frame delta added to displacement.
-- Difference-based: sample absolute offset at t_norm in the DisplacementMode
-- frame, subtract _prevWorldOff. LocalCF accumulator integrates correctly.
-- Three frames mirror DirMode (Speed direction):
--   Global     = world axes (no rotation applied)
--   Local      = SpawnRotation (post-RotXYZ particle frame; per-particle RotXYZ
--                rotates the path → fans / scatter / convergence patterns)
--   RigidLocal = SpawnEmitterRotation (emitter frame at spawn, pre-RotXYZ;
--                path follows emitter orientation but not particle tumble)
local function _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, steppedI)
	if not pData.HasPosOffsetGraphs then return Vector3.zero end
	local oX = pData._staticPosOffsetX or (pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetX)) or 0
	local oY = pData._staticPosOffsetY or (pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetY)) or 0
	local oZ = pData._staticPosOffsetZ or (pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetZ)) or 0
	local worldOff = Constants.resolveDisplacement(Vector3.new(oX, oY, oZ),
		pData.DisplacementMode or "Global", pData.SpawnRotation, pData.SpawnEmitterRotation,
		pData._displacementMirrorX, pData._displacementMirrorY, pData._displacementMirrorZ)
	local delta = worldOff - pData._prevWorldOff
	pData._prevWorldOff = worldOff
	return delta
end

return function(Particle)

-- Part update: position (4 branches), rotation, size, color/transparency, flipbook.
-- Branches: Inverted reads precomputed CFrames; VelocityVectored needs full per-step iteration;
-- fast paths skip ahead with no accel/drag.
function Particle:UpdatePart(pData, dt, currentTime)
	-- Signed-reverse Timescale: ts sampled at real_i (not effective i) so it progresses
	-- monotonically through keypoints regardless of effective-time direction. ts(0)<0 →
	-- particle starts at end of life and rewinds; ts(0)>=0 → starts forward.
	-- SetTimescale override (Lifecycle.luau) wins over the graph for its window.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	dt = dt * ts
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local priorEff = pData._effectiveElapsed or 0
	local newEff = priorEff + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dt)
	if dt < 0 and pData._hitHistory and #pData._hitHistory > 0 then
		EventsCollision.restoreHitsOnReverse(pData, priorEff, newEff)
	end
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff
	-- After-clamp dt: boundary frames see partial step instead of overshooting.
	dt = newEff - priorEff
	pData._lastEffectiveDt = dt
	-- Particle dies when effective sits at a boundary AND the graph has finished playing.
	local atForwardEnd = newEff >= lifeTime
	local atBackwardEnd = newEff <= 0
	local elapsedTime = newEff
	local i = elapsedTime / lifeTime

	if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return true end
	if pData.TotalKeyFrames <= 0 then return true end
	local graphFinished = real_i >= 1
	-- OnHit Collision=Stop (or auto-settle freeze): skip motion/step work, age normally.
	if pData._collisionStopped then return graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd) end
	local isDying = graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd)
	i = math.min(math.max(i, 0), 1)

	pData.AccumulatedDT += dt
	local targetStep = math.floor(i * pData.TotalKeyFrames)

	if targetStep ~= pData.CurrentStep then
		local prevStep = pData.CurrentStep
		local stepDir = (targetStep > prevStep) and 1 or -1
		local stepsToProcess = math.abs(targetStep - prevStep)
		local perStepDT = pData.AccumulatedDT / stepsToProcess
		local frameDT = pData.AccumulatedDT
		pData.AccumulatedDT = 0

		-- Collision spin (deg/sec) into _spinAccum (degrees); composes with both rotation modes.
		local spinRate = pData._spinRate
		if spinRate and (spinRate.X ~= 0 or spinRate.Y ~= 0 or spinRate.Z ~= 0) then
			pData._spinAccumX = (pData._spinAccumX or 0) + spinRate.X * frameDT
			pData._spinAccumY = (pData._spinAccumY or 0) + spinRate.Y * frameDT
			pData._spinAccumZ = (pData._spinAccumZ or 0) + spinRate.Z * frameDT
		end
		local speedMult = pData.SpeedMultiplier or 1

		-- POSITION: Inverted
		if pData.InvertMotion then
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
			local reverseStep = pData.TotalKeyFrames - targetStep
			local localCF = pData.SimLocalCFrames[reverseStep] or pData.SimLocalCFrames[0]
			local parentCF_now = getLinkCF(pData)
			pData.VisualPart.CFrame = parentCF_now * localCF
			pData._localWorldCF = localCF
			pData.CurrentPosition = pData.VisualPart.Position

		-- POSITION: Forward, FULL iteration (VelocityVectored)
		elseif pData.NeedsFullIteration then
			-- parentCF_now / dirInfo hoisted outside the loop; final CFrame written once at batch end.
			local hasDrag = pData.HasDrag
			local hasAccel = pData.HasAccel
			local parentCF_now, useVOS = getLinkCF(pData)
			local dirInfo = DirectionVectors[pData.EmissionDirection] or DirectionVectors[Enum.NormalId.Top]
			local localCF = pData.LocalCF
			local accRotX, accRotY, accRotZ = pData.AccRotX, pData.AccRotY, pData.AccRotZ
			local baseDir = pData.BaseDirection
			local accelVel = pData._accelVel or Vector3.zero
			local targetVel = pData.TargetVel
			-- Seed simPos from live VisualPart.Position (overlays moved CFrame since CurrentPosition write).
			local simPos = pData.VisualPart.Position
			local rotMode = pData.RotMode
			local rotOrder = pData.RotOrder or "Global"
			local lastWorldCF, lastLocalWorldCF
			for step = prevStep + stepDir, targetStep, stepDir do
				local si = step / pData.TotalKeyFrames
				local elapsedSec = si * pData.LifeTime

				local speed = pData._speedOverride or ((pData._staticSpeed or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed)) * speedMult)
				local draggedSpeed = hasDrag and (speed * math.exp(-pData.Drag * elapsedSec)) or speed

				local displacement
				if hasAccel then
					local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, perStepDT)
					accelVel = accelVel + effA * perStepDT
					displacement = (baseDir * draggedSpeed + accelVel) * perStepDT
				else
					displacement = baseDir * (draggedSpeed * perStepDT)
				end

				-- Target accel: Euler integration; reads simPos for mid-substep tracking.
				if pData.HasTargetAccel then
					local tPos = getTargetPosition(pData.AccelTarget)
					if tPos then
						local toTarget = tPos - simPos
						local dist = toTarget.Magnitude
						if dist > 1e-4 then
							local mag = pData._staticAccelStrength or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.AccelStrength, pData.Seeds.AccelStrength)
							if mag and mag ~= 0 then
								targetVel = targetVel + toTarget * (mag * perStepDT / dist)
								displacement = displacement + targetVel * perStepDT
							end
						end
					end
				end

				-- PosOffset per-step delta. Telescoping sums across the loop integrate
				-- to the correct absolute-offset change over this Heartbeat's steps.
				displacement = displacement + _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, si)

				local parentLocalDelta = useVOS and parentCF_now:VectorToObjectSpace(displacement) or displacement
				localCF = CFrame.new(parentLocalDelta) * localCF

				local rotDamp = pData._settleRotDamp or 1
				local rotSpeedX = (pData._staticRotSpeedX or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedX, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedX)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedY = (pData._staticRotSpeedY or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedY, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedY)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedZ = (pData._staticRotSpeedZ or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedZ, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedZ)) * rotDamp

				local rotationCFrame
				local sx = pData._spinAccumX or 0
				local sy = pData._spinAccumY or 0
				local sz = pData._spinAccumZ or 0
				if rotMode == "Speed" then
					accRotX = accRotX + rotSpeedX * perStepDT
					accRotY = accRotY + rotSpeedY * perStepDT
					accRotZ = accRotZ + rotSpeedZ * perStepDT
					rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(rotOrder, accRotX + sx, accRotY + sy, accRotZ + sz)
				else
					rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(rotOrder, rotSpeedX + sx, rotSpeedY + sy, rotSpeedZ + sz)
				end

				lastWorldCF = (parentCF_now * localCF) * rotationCFrame
				lastLocalWorldCF = localCF * rotationCFrame
				simPos = lastWorldCF.Position

				local rotatedCF = lastWorldCF * pData.SpreadRotation
				baseDir = rotatedCF[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
			end
			pData.LocalCF = localCF
			pData.AccRotX, pData.AccRotY, pData.AccRotZ = accRotX, accRotY, accRotZ
			pData.BaseDirection = baseDir
			pData._accelVel = accelVel
			pData.TargetVel = targetVel
			pData.CurrentPosition = simPos
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
			if lastWorldCF then
				pData.VisualPart.CFrame = lastWorldCF
				pData._localWorldCF = lastLocalWorldCF
			end

		-- POSITION: Forward, SPEED ROTATION
		elseif pData.NeedsRotAccum then
			local hasDrag = pData.HasDrag
			local hasAccel = pData.HasAccel
			local totalScalarDisp = 0
			local totalAccelDisp = Vector3.zero
			local accelVel = pData._accelVel or Vector3.zero

			for step = prevStep + stepDir, targetStep, stepDir do
				local si = step / pData.TotalKeyFrames
				local elapsedSec = si * pData.LifeTime
				local speed = pData._speedOverride or ((pData._staticSpeed or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed)) * speedMult)
				if hasDrag then speed = speed * math.exp(-pData.Drag * elapsedSec) end
				totalScalarDisp = totalScalarDisp + speed * perStepDT
				if hasAccel then
					local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, perStepDT)
					accelVel = accelVel + effA * perStepDT
					totalAccelDisp = totalAccelDisp + accelVel * perStepDT
				end

				local rotDamp = pData._settleRotDamp or 1
				local rotSpeedX = (pData._staticRotSpeedX or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedX, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedX)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedY = (pData._staticRotSpeedY or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedY, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedY)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedZ = (pData._staticRotSpeedZ or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedZ, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedZ)) * rotDamp
				pData.AccRotX = pData.AccRotX + rotSpeedX * perStepDT
				pData.AccRotY = pData.AccRotY + rotSpeedY * perStepDT
				pData.AccRotZ = pData.AccRotZ + rotSpeedZ * perStepDT
			end
			pData._accelVel = accelVel

			local totalDisplacement = pData.BaseDirection * totalScalarDisp + totalAccelDisp

			-- Target accel: frame-granularity (mid-frame si).
			if pData.HasTargetAccel then
				local tPos = getTargetPosition(pData.AccelTarget)
				if tPos then
					local toTarget = tPos - pData.VisualPart.Position
					local dist = toTarget.Magnitude
					if dist > 1e-4 then
						local frameDT2 = perStepDT * (targetStep - prevStep)
						local midSI = ((prevStep + 1 + targetStep) * 0.5) / pData.TotalKeyFrames
						local mag = pData._staticAccelStrength or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(midSI, pData.Graphs.AccelStrength, pData.Seeds.AccelStrength)
						if mag and mag ~= 0 then
							pData.TargetVel = pData.TargetVel + toTarget * (mag * frameDT2 / dist)
							totalDisplacement = totalDisplacement + pData.TargetVel * frameDT2
						end
					end
				end
			end

			-- PosOffsetX/Y/Z over-life position graphs. Adds the frame-delta of the
			-- current absolute offset (in world space, rotated from spawn-local) so
			-- the LocalCF accumulator naturally integrates to the final offset.
			totalDisplacement = totalDisplacement + _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames)

			local parentCF_now, useVOS = getLinkCF(pData)
			local parentLocalDelta = useVOS and parentCF_now:VectorToObjectSpace(totalDisplacement) or totalDisplacement
			pData.LocalCF = CFrame.new(parentLocalDelta) * pData.LocalCF
			local sx = pData._spinAccumX or 0
			local sy = pData._spinAccumY or 0
			local sz = pData._spinAccumZ or 0
			local rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(pData.RotOrder or "Global", pData.AccRotX + sx, pData.AccRotY + sy, pData.AccRotZ + sz)

			pData.VisualPart.CFrame = (parentCF_now * pData.LocalCF) * rotationCFrame
			pData._localWorldCF = pData.LocalCF * rotationCFrame
			pData.CurrentPosition = pData.VisualPart.Position
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep

		-- POSITION: Forward, FAST
		else
			local hasDrag = pData.HasDrag
			local hasAccel = pData.HasAccel
			local totalScalarDisp = 0
			local totalAccelDisp = Vector3.zero
			local accelVel = pData._accelVel or Vector3.zero

			-- Drag-free closed form: speed integral + (accelVel*Δt + 0.5*accel*Δt²).
			if not hasDrag then
				local invTKF = 1 / pData.TotalKeyFrames
				local prevT = prevStep * invTKF
				local targetT = targetStep * invTKF
				local override = pData._speedOverride
				if override then
					totalScalarDisp = override * (targetT - prevT) * pData.LifeTime
				elseif pData._staticSpeed then
					-- Constant Speed integrates to value × duration.
					totalScalarDisp = pData._staticSpeed * speedMult * (targetT - prevT) * pData.LifeTime
				else
					totalScalarDisp = pData.LifeTime * speedMult * (GraphMod.IntegrateUpTo(targetT, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed) - GraphMod.IntegrateUpTo(prevT, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed))
				end
				if hasAccel then
					local deltaSec = (targetT - prevT) * pData.LifeTime
					local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, deltaSec)
					totalAccelDisp = accelVel * deltaSec + effA * (deltaSec * deltaSec * 0.5)
					accelVel = accelVel + effA * deltaSec
				end
			else
				-- Drag fallback: per-step loop.
				for step = prevStep + stepDir, targetStep, stepDir do
					local si = step / pData.TotalKeyFrames
					local elapsedSec = si * pData.LifeTime
					local speed = pData._speedOverride or ((pData._staticSpeed or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed)) * speedMult)
					speed = speed * math.exp(-pData.Drag * elapsedSec)
					totalScalarDisp = totalScalarDisp + speed * perStepDT
					if hasAccel then
						local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, perStepDT)
						accelVel = accelVel + effA * perStepDT
						totalAccelDisp = totalAccelDisp + accelVel * perStepDT
					end
				end
			end
			pData._accelVel = accelVel

			local totalDisplacement = pData.BaseDirection * totalScalarDisp + totalAccelDisp

			-- Target accel: frame-granularity sample.
			if pData.HasTargetAccel then
				local tPos = getTargetPosition(pData.AccelTarget)
				if tPos then
					local toTarget = tPos - pData.VisualPart.Position
					local dist = toTarget.Magnitude
					if dist > 1e-4 then
						local frameDT = perStepDT * (targetStep - prevStep)
						local midSI = ((prevStep + 1 + targetStep) * 0.5) / pData.TotalKeyFrames
						local mag = pData._staticAccelStrength or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(midSI, pData.Graphs.AccelStrength, pData.Seeds.AccelStrength)
						if mag and mag ~= 0 then
							pData.TargetVel = pData.TargetVel + toTarget * (mag * frameDT / dist)
							totalDisplacement = totalDisplacement + pData.TargetVel * frameDT
						end
					end
				end
			end

			-- PosOffsetX/Y/Z over-life position graphs (see helper at top of file).
			totalDisplacement = totalDisplacement + _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames)

			local parentCF_now, useVOS = getLinkCF(pData)
			local parentLocalDelta = useVOS and parentCF_now:VectorToObjectSpace(totalDisplacement) or totalDisplacement
			pData.LocalCF = CFrame.new(parentLocalDelta) * pData.LocalCF

			local steppedI = targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames
			local rotDamp = pData._settleRotDamp or 1
			local rotX = (pData._staticRotSpeedX or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedX, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedX)) * rotDamp + (pData._spinAccumX or 0)
			local rotY = (pData._staticRotSpeedY or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedY, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedY)) * rotDamp + (pData._spinAccumY or 0)
			local rotZ = (pData._staticRotSpeedZ or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedZ, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedZ)) * rotDamp + (pData._spinAccumZ or 0)
			local rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(pData.RotOrder or "Global", rotX, rotY, rotZ)

			pData.VisualPart.CFrame = (parentCF_now * pData.LocalCF) * rotationCFrame
			pData._localWorldCF = pData.LocalCF * rotationCFrame
			pData.CurrentPosition = pData.VisualPart.Position
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
		end

		-- SIZE  -  gated by pData.SkipSize (set via payload.SetSkipSize).
		local steppedI = targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames
		if not pData.SkipSize then
			local sizex = pData._staticSizeX or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.SizeX, pData.Seeds.SizeX)
			local sizey = pData._staticSizeY or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.SizeY, pData.Seeds.SizeY)
			local sizez = pData._staticSizeZ or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.SizeZ, pData.Seeds.SizeZ)

			if pData.ParentScale then
				-- StaticValue path skips per-frame Query when parent Model's Scale graph is constant
				-- (StaticPass nilled ps.Graph). Avoids nil-graph crash post-Fix on default Scale=1.
				local ps = pData.ParentScale
				local pFactor
				if ps.StaticValue then
					pFactor = math.max(0.001, ps.StaticValue)
				else
					local pI = math.clamp((currentTime - ps.StartTime) / ps.LifeTime, 0, 1)
					pFactor = math.max(0.001, GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(pI, ps.Graph, ps.Seed))
				end
				sizex = sizex * pFactor
				sizey = sizey * pFactor
				sizez = sizez * pFactor
			end

			if pData.SpecialMesh then
				pData.SpecialMesh.Scale = Vector3.new(sizex, sizey, sizez)
			else
				pData.VisualPart.Size = Vector3.new(sizex, sizey, sizez)
			end
		end

		-- VISUAL
		local transparency = pData._staticTransparency or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.Transparency, pData.Seeds.Transparency)

		if pData.SurfaceAppearance then
			-- Color graph tints SA.Color raw; Brightness graph drives SA.EmissiveTint only.
			-- EmissiveTint write pcall-guarded for older Studio builds without the property.
			local brightness = pData._staticBrightness or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.Brightness, pData.Seeds.Brightness)
			local color = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.Color)
			if not pData.SkipTransparency then pData.VisualPart.Transparency = transparency end
			if not pData.SkipColor then
				pData.VisualPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(color.R * 255, color.G * 255, color.B * 255)
				pData.SurfaceAppearance.Color = Color3.fromRGB(color.R * 255, color.G * 255, color.B * 255)
				pcall(function() pData.SurfaceAppearance.EmissiveTint = Color3.new(color.R * brightness, color.G * brightness, color.B * brightness) end)
			end
		elseif pData.HasDecal then
			local brightness = pData._staticBrightness or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.Brightness, pData.Seeds.Brightness)
			local color = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.Color)
			if not pData.SkipTransparency then pData.Decal.Transparency = transparency end
			if not pData.SkipColor then pData.Decal.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(color.R * 255 * brightness, color.G * 255 * brightness, color.B * 255 * brightness) end
		else
			-- Plain MeshPart: Brightness multiplies SA/Decal only, not mesh Color.
			local color = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.Color)
			if not pData.SkipTransparency then pData.VisualPart.Transparency = transparency end
			if not pData.SkipColor then pData.VisualPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(color.R * 255, color.G * 255, color.B * 255) end
		end
	end

	return isDying
end

-- Attachment update: parent-local motion. No Size graph (Attachments drive child instances).
function Particle:UpdateAttachment(pData, dt, currentTime)
	-- Signed-reverse Timescale: see UpdatePart. SetTimescale override wins for its window.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	dt = dt * ts
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local priorEff = pData._effectiveElapsed or 0
	local newEff = priorEff + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dt)
	if dt < 0 and pData._hitHistory and #pData._hitHistory > 0 then
		EventsCollision.restoreHitsOnReverse(pData, priorEff, newEff)
	end
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff
	-- After-clamp dt: boundary frames see partial step instead of overshooting.
	dt = newEff - priorEff
	pData._lastEffectiveDt = dt
	local atForwardEnd = newEff >= lifeTime
	local atBackwardEnd = newEff <= 0
	local elapsedTime = newEff
	local i = elapsedTime / lifeTime
	if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return true end
	if pData.TotalKeyFrames <= 0 then return true end
	local graphFinished = real_i >= 1
	if pData._collisionStopped then return graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd) end
	local isDying = graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd)
	i = math.min(math.max(i, 0), 1)
	pData.AccumulatedDT += dt
	local targetStep = math.floor(i * pData.TotalKeyFrames)

	if targetStep ~= pData.CurrentStep then
		local prevStep = pData.CurrentStep
		local stepDir = (targetStep > prevStep) and 1 or -1
		local stepsToProcess = math.abs(targetStep - prevStep)
		local perStepDT = pData.AccumulatedDT / stepsToProcess
		local frameDT = pData.AccumulatedDT
		pData.AccumulatedDT = 0
		local spinRate = pData._spinRate
		if spinRate and (spinRate.X ~= 0 or spinRate.Y ~= 0 or spinRate.Z ~= 0) then
			pData._spinAccumX = (pData._spinAccumX or 0) + spinRate.X * frameDT
			pData._spinAccumY = (pData._spinAccumY or 0) + spinRate.Y * frameDT
			pData._spinAccumZ = (pData._spinAccumZ or 0) + spinRate.Z * frameDT
		end
		local speedMult = pData.SpeedMultiplier or 1

		-- actualParent-local link CFrame; identity when no link.
		local parentCF_now, useVOS = getAttachmentLinkCF(pData)

		if pData.InvertMotion then
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
			local reverseStep = pData.TotalKeyFrames - targetStep
			local localCF = pData.SimLocalCFrames[reverseStep] or pData.SimLocalCFrames[0]
			pData.VisualPart.CFrame = parentCF_now * localCF
			pData.LocalCF = localCF
			pData._localWorldCF = localCF

		-- POSITION: Forward, FULL iteration (VelocityVectored)
		elseif pData.NeedsFullIteration then
			local hasDrag = pData.HasDrag
			local hasAccel = pData.HasAccel
			local accelVel = pData._accelVel or Vector3.zero
			local sx = pData._spinAccumX or 0
			local sy = pData._spinAccumY or 0
			local sz = pData._spinAccumZ or 0
			local rotOrder = pData.RotOrder or "Global"
			for step = prevStep + stepDir, targetStep, stepDir do
				local si = step / pData.TotalKeyFrames
				local elapsedSec = si * pData.LifeTime

				local speed = pData._speedOverride or ((pData._staticSpeed or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed)) * speedMult)
				local draggedSpeed = hasDrag and (speed * math.exp(-pData.Drag * elapsedSec)) or speed

				local displacement
				if hasAccel then
					local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, perStepDT)
					accelVel = accelVel + effA * perStepDT
					displacement = (pData.BaseDirection * draggedSpeed + accelVel) * perStepDT
				else
					displacement = pData.BaseDirection * (draggedSpeed * perStepDT)
				end

				-- PosOffset per-step delta. Telescoping integration across loop iterations.
				displacement = displacement + _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, si)

				-- Weld/WeldWithoutRotation: rotate displacement from world into link-local before stacking onto LocalCF.
				local stepDelta = useVOS and parentCF_now:VectorToObjectSpace(displacement) or displacement
				pData.LocalCF = CFrame.new(stepDelta) * pData.LocalCF

				-- Rotation
				local rotDamp = pData._settleRotDamp or 1
				local rotSpeedX = (pData._staticRotSpeedX or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedX, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedX)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedY = (pData._staticRotSpeedY or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedY, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedY)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedZ = (pData._staticRotSpeedZ or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedZ, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedZ)) * rotDamp

				local rotationCFrame
				if pData.RotMode == "Speed" then
					pData.AccRotX = pData.AccRotX + rotSpeedX * perStepDT
					pData.AccRotY = pData.AccRotY + rotSpeedY * perStepDT
					pData.AccRotZ = pData.AccRotZ + rotSpeedZ * perStepDT
					rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(rotOrder, pData.AccRotX + sx, pData.AccRotY + sy, pData.AccRotZ + sz)
				else
					rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(rotOrder, rotSpeedX + sx, rotSpeedY + sy, rotSpeedZ + sz)
				end

				pData.VisualPart.CFrame = parentCF_now * pData.LocalCF * rotationCFrame
				pData._localWorldCF = pData.LocalCF * rotationCFrame

				local rotatedCF = pData.VisualPart.CFrame * pData.SpreadRotation
				local dirInfo = DirectionVectors[pData.EmissionDirection] or DirectionVectors[Enum.NormalId.Top]
				pData.BaseDirection = rotatedCF[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
			end
			pData._accelVel = accelVel
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep

		-- POSITION: Forward, SPEED ROTATION
		elseif pData.NeedsRotAccum then
			local hasDrag = pData.HasDrag
			local hasAccel = pData.HasAccel
			local totalScalarDisp = 0
			local totalAccelDisp = Vector3.zero
			local accelVel = pData._accelVel or Vector3.zero

			for step = prevStep + stepDir, targetStep, stepDir do
				local si = step / pData.TotalKeyFrames
				local elapsedSec = si * pData.LifeTime
				local speed = pData._speedOverride or ((pData._staticSpeed or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed)) * speedMult)
				if hasDrag then speed = speed * math.exp(-pData.Drag * elapsedSec) end
				totalScalarDisp = totalScalarDisp + speed * perStepDT
				if hasAccel then
					local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, perStepDT)
					accelVel = accelVel + effA * perStepDT
					totalAccelDisp = totalAccelDisp + accelVel * perStepDT
				end

				local rotDamp = pData._settleRotDamp or 1
				local rotSpeedX = (pData._staticRotSpeedX or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedX, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedX)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedY = (pData._staticRotSpeedY or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedY, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedY)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedZ = (pData._staticRotSpeedZ or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedZ, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedZ)) * rotDamp
				pData.AccRotX = pData.AccRotX + rotSpeedX * perStepDT
				pData.AccRotY = pData.AccRotY + rotSpeedY * perStepDT
				pData.AccRotZ = pData.AccRotZ + rotSpeedZ * perStepDT
			end
			pData._accelVel = accelVel

			local totalDisplacement = pData.BaseDirection * totalScalarDisp + totalAccelDisp
			totalDisplacement = totalDisplacement + _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames)

			local stepDelta = useVOS and parentCF_now:VectorToObjectSpace(totalDisplacement) or totalDisplacement
			pData.LocalCF = CFrame.new(stepDelta) * pData.LocalCF
			local sx = pData._spinAccumX or 0
			local sy = pData._spinAccumY or 0
			local sz = pData._spinAccumZ or 0
			local rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(pData.RotOrder or "Global", pData.AccRotX + sx, pData.AccRotY + sy, pData.AccRotZ + sz)

			pData.VisualPart.CFrame = parentCF_now * pData.LocalCF * rotationCFrame
			pData._localWorldCF = pData.LocalCF * rotationCFrame
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep

		-- POSITION: Forward, FAST
		else
			local hasDrag = pData.HasDrag
			local hasAccel = pData.HasAccel
			local totalScalarDisp = 0
			local totalAccelDisp = Vector3.zero
			local accelVel = pData._accelVel or Vector3.zero

			-- Drag-free closed form: speed integral + (accelVel*Δt + 0.5*accel*Δt²).
			if not hasDrag then
				local invTKF = 1 / pData.TotalKeyFrames
				local prevT = prevStep * invTKF
				local targetT = targetStep * invTKF
				local override = pData._speedOverride
				if override then
					totalScalarDisp = override * (targetT - prevT) * pData.LifeTime
				elseif pData._staticSpeed then
					-- Constant Speed integrates to value × duration.
					totalScalarDisp = pData._staticSpeed * speedMult * (targetT - prevT) * pData.LifeTime
				else
					totalScalarDisp = pData.LifeTime * speedMult * (GraphMod.IntegrateUpTo(targetT, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed) - GraphMod.IntegrateUpTo(prevT, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed))
				end
				if hasAccel then
					local deltaSec = (targetT - prevT) * pData.LifeTime
					local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, deltaSec)
					totalAccelDisp = accelVel * deltaSec + effA * (deltaSec * deltaSec * 0.5)
					accelVel = accelVel + effA * deltaSec
				end
			else
				for step = prevStep + stepDir, targetStep, stepDir do
					local si = step / pData.TotalKeyFrames
					local elapsedSec = si * pData.LifeTime
					local speed = pData._speedOverride or ((pData._staticSpeed or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed)) * speedMult)
					speed = speed * math.exp(-pData.Drag * elapsedSec)
					totalScalarDisp = totalScalarDisp + speed * perStepDT
					if hasAccel then
						local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, perStepDT)
						accelVel = accelVel + effA * perStepDT
						totalAccelDisp = totalAccelDisp + accelVel * perStepDT
					end
				end
			end
			pData._accelVel = accelVel

			local totalDisplacement = pData.BaseDirection * totalScalarDisp + totalAccelDisp
			totalDisplacement = totalDisplacement + _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames)

			local stepDelta = useVOS and parentCF_now:VectorToObjectSpace(totalDisplacement) or totalDisplacement
			pData.LocalCF = CFrame.new(stepDelta) * pData.LocalCF

			local steppedI = targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames
			local rotDamp = pData._settleRotDamp or 1
			local rotX = (pData._staticRotSpeedX or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedX, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedX)) * rotDamp + (pData._spinAccumX or 0)
			local rotY = (pData._staticRotSpeedY or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedY, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedY)) * rotDamp + (pData._spinAccumY or 0)
			local rotZ = (pData._staticRotSpeedZ or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedZ, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedZ)) * rotDamp + (pData._spinAccumZ or 0)
			local rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(pData.RotOrder or "Global", rotX, rotY, rotZ)

			pData.VisualPart.CFrame = parentCF_now * pData.LocalCF * rotationCFrame
			pData._localWorldCF = pData.LocalCF * rotationCFrame
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
		end
	end

	return isDying
end

end

children.name: UpdateBeam
children.source:
--[[
	UpdateBeam Mixin  -  per-frame update for Beam particles (no spatial motion).
	GraphBlender lerps between authored Transparency/Color states; pair-index cached for O(1) search.
	Animate-loop reset must clear _lastTransIdx/_lastColorIdx (init.luau handles this).
	TextureSpeed uses integral-based offset (engine's rate-accumulator is FPS-dependent).
	ParentScale multiplies Width/CurveSize/TextureLength/Segments by nested-Model scale factor.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)

return function(Particle)

-- Per-frame update for a Beam-typed particle (`pData`). Advances effective elapsed,
-- writes Width0/1, Color, Transparency from authored graphs + GraphBlender states.
-- Returns true when the particle has died.
function Particle:UpdateBeam(pData, dt, currentTime)
	-- Signed-reverse Timescale: see Update.luau UpdatePart. SetTimescale override wins for its window.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	local dtTs = dt * ts
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local priorEff = pData._effectiveElapsed or 0
	local newEff = priorEff + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dtTs)
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff
	local atForwardEnd = newEff >= lifeTime
	local atBackwardEnd = newEff <= 0
	local elapsedTime = newEff
	local i = elapsedTime / lifeTime

	if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return true end
	local graphFinished = real_i >= 1
	local isDying = graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd)
	i = math.min(math.max(i, 0), 1)

	-- Continuous-time, FPS-independent.
	local t = i

	local transStates = pData.TransStates
	local colorStates = pData.ColorStates

	-- Transparency blender
	if not pData.SkipTransparency then
		if transStates and #transStates >= 2 then
			local lastTrans = pData._lastTransIdx or 1
			-- Reverse-Timescale support: rescan from start when t dropped below cached pair's lower bound.
			if t < transStates[lastTrans].Time then lastTrans = 1 end
			local pairIdx = #transStates - 1
			for idx = lastTrans, #transStates - 1 do
				if t >= transStates[idx].Time and t <= transStates[idx + 1].Time then
					pairIdx = idx; break
				end
			end
			pData._lastTransIdx = pairIdx
			local lower = transStates[pairIdx]
			local upper = transStates[pairIdx + 1] or transStates[#transStates]
			local range = upper.Time - lower.Time
			local segmentAlpha = range > 0 and ((t - lower.Time) / range) or 0
			local mergedTimes = pData.TransMergedTimes[pairIdx]
			if mergedTimes then
				pData.VisualPart.Transparency = GraphMod.LerpGraphFast(lower.Graph, upper.Graph, segmentAlpha, mergedTimes)
			else
				pData.VisualPart.Transparency = GraphMod.LerpGraph(lower.Graph, upper.Graph, segmentAlpha)
			end
		elseif transStates and #transStates == 1 then
			pData.VisualPart.Transparency = transStates[1].Graph
		end
	end

	-- Color blender
	if not pData.SkipColor then
		if colorStates and #colorStates >= 2 then
			local lastColor = pData._lastColorIdx or 1
			if t < colorStates[lastColor].Time then lastColor = 1 end
			local pairIdx = #colorStates - 1
			for idx = lastColor, #colorStates - 1 do
				if t >= colorStates[idx].Time and t <= colorStates[idx + 1].Time then
					pairIdx = idx; break
				end
			end
			pData._lastColorIdx = pairIdx
			local lower = colorStates[pairIdx]
			local upper = colorStates[pairIdx + 1] or colorStates[#colorStates]
			local range = upper.Time - lower.Time
			local segmentAlpha = range > 0 and ((t - lower.Time) / range) or 0
			local mergedTimes = pData.ColorMergedTimes[pairIdx]
			if mergedTimes then
				pData.VisualPart.Color = GraphMod.LerpColorGraphFast(lower.Graph, upper.Graph, segmentAlpha, mergedTimes)
			else
				pData.VisualPart.Color = GraphMod.LerpColorGraph(lower.Graph, upper.Graph, segmentAlpha)
			end
		elseif colorStates and #colorStates == 1 then
			pData.VisualPart.Color = colorStates[1].Graph
		end
	end

	-- TextureSpeed: integral-based offset for FPS independence.
	local tsAnim = pData.AnimatedProps.TextureSpeed
	if tsAnim then
		local integral = GraphMod.IntegrateUpTo(t, tsAnim.Sequence, tsAnim.Seed)
		pData.VisualPart:SetTextureOffset((-integral * pData.LifeTime) % 1)
	end

	-- Other animated beam properties (Width0, Width1, CurveSize, etc.)
	for name, animData in pairs(pData.AnimatedProps) do
		if name ~= "TextureSpeed" then
			local val = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(t, animData.Sequence, animData.Seed)
			if name == "Segments" then val = math.max(20, math.round(val)) end
			pData.VisualPart[name] = val
		end
	end

	-- Parent model scale (nested beams). StaticValue path skips per-frame Query when the
	-- parent Model's Scale graph is constant (StaticPass nilled ps.Graph; constant value
	-- lives on ps.StaticValue). Avoids the nil-graph crash post-Fix on default Scale=1.
	if pData.ParentScale then
		local ps = pData.ParentScale
		local pFactor
		if ps.StaticValue then
			pFactor = math.max(0.001, ps.StaticValue)
		else
			local pI = math.clamp((currentTime - ps.StartTime) / ps.LifeTime, 0, 1)
			pFactor = math.max(0.001, GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(pI, ps.Graph, ps.Seed))
		end
		local vb = pData.VisualPart
		local ap = pData.AnimatedProps
		vb.Width0 = (ap.Width0 and vb.Width0 or pData._baseWidth0) * pFactor
		vb.Width1 = (ap.Width1 and vb.Width1 or pData._baseWidth1) * pFactor
		vb.CurveSize0 = (ap.CurveSize0 and vb.CurveSize0 or pData._baseCurveSize0) * pFactor
		vb.CurveSize1 = (ap.CurveSize1 and vb.CurveSize1 or pData._baseCurveSize1) * pFactor
		-- TextureLength multiplies (preserves tile count as beam scales) when Model's
		-- ScaleTextureLength attribute is true (default). False leaves authored value
		-- so tiles repeat more densely as beam grows.
		if ps.ScaleTextureLength ~= false then
			vb.TextureLength = (ap.TextureLength and vb.TextureLength or pData._baseTextureLength) * pFactor
		end
		vb.Segments = math.max(20, math.round((ap.Segments and vb.Segments or pData._baseSegments) * pFactor))
	end

	return isDying
end

end

children.name: UpdateModel
children.source:
--[[
	UpdateModel Mixin  -  per-frame update for Model particles.
	Same motion branches as UpdatePart; uses :PivotTo for position and :ScaleTo for size.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local EventsCollision = require(script.Parent.EventsCollision)
local DirectionVectors = Constants.DirectionVectors

-- PosOffsetX/Y/Z over-life graph → per-frame delta added to displacement.
-- Routes through Constants.resolveDisplacement so DisplacementMode (Global / Local /
-- RigidLocal) + OnHit mirror axes apply uniformly with the Part / Attachment path
-- in Update.luau:_posOffsetFrameDelta.
local function _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, steppedI)
	if not pData.HasPosOffsetGraphs then return Vector3.zero end
	local oX = pData._staticPosOffsetX or (pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetX, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetX)) or 0
	local oY = pData._staticPosOffsetY or (pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetY, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetY)) or 0
	local oZ = pData._staticPosOffsetZ or (pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PosOffsetZ, pData.Seeds.PosOffsetZ)) or 0
	local worldOff = Constants.resolveDisplacement(Vector3.new(oX, oY, oZ),
		pData.DisplacementMode or "Global", pData.SpawnRotation, pData.SpawnEmitterRotation,
		pData._displacementMirrorX, pData._displacementMirrorY, pData._displacementMirrorZ)
	local delta = worldOff - pData._prevWorldOff
	pData._prevWorldOff = worldOff
	return delta
end

-- Routes through Constants.resolveLinkCFrame for Model + Bone link targets.
-- RigidLocal reads the at-emit snapshot in pData._rigidLocalParentCF.
local function getLinkCF(pData)
	local lk = pData.Link
	if not (lk and lk.Parent) then return CFrame.new(), false end
	local worldCF
	if pData.LinkMode == "RigidLocal" then
		worldCF = pData._rigidLocalParentCF or CFrame.new()
	else
		worldCF = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(lk)
	end
	if pData.LinkMode == "Follow" or pData.LinkMode == "Pivot" then
		return CFrame.new(worldCF.Position), false
	end
	return worldCF, true
end

return function(Particle)

-- Per-frame update for a Model-typed particle (`pData`). Advances effective elapsed,
-- writes the new pivot via :PivotTo, applies scale + flipbook. Returns true when the
-- particle has died (consumed by Engine.luau's swap-and-pop loop).
function Particle:UpdateModel(pData, dt, currentTime)
	-- Signed-reverse Timescale: see Update.luau UpdatePart. SetTimescale override wins for its window.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	dt = dt * ts
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local priorEff = pData._effectiveElapsed or 0
	local newEff = priorEff + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dt)
	if dt < 0 and pData._hitHistory and #pData._hitHistory > 0 then
		EventsCollision.restoreHitsOnReverse(pData, priorEff, newEff)
	end
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff
	-- After-clamp dt: boundary frames see partial step instead of overshooting.
	dt = newEff - priorEff
	pData._lastEffectiveDt = dt
	local atForwardEnd = newEff >= lifeTime
	local atBackwardEnd = newEff <= 0
	local elapsedTime = newEff
	local i = elapsedTime / lifeTime

	if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return true end
	if pData.TotalKeyFrames <= 0 then return true end
	local graphFinished = real_i >= 1
	if pData._collisionStopped then return graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd) end
	local isDying = graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd)
	i = math.min(math.max(i, 0), 1)

	pData.AccumulatedDT += dt
	local targetStep = math.floor(i * pData.TotalKeyFrames)

	if targetStep ~= pData.CurrentStep then
		local prevStep = pData.CurrentStep
		local stepDir = (targetStep > prevStep) and 1 or -1
		local stepsToProcess = math.abs(targetStep - prevStep)
		local frameDT = pData.AccumulatedDT
		local perStepDT = frameDT / stepsToProcess
		pData.AccumulatedDT = 0

		-- Collision spin: angular velocity (deg/sec) into per-axis accumulators.
		local spinRate = pData._spinRate
		if spinRate and (spinRate.X ~= 0 or spinRate.Y ~= 0 or spinRate.Z ~= 0) then
			pData._spinAccumX = (pData._spinAccumX or 0) + spinRate.X * frameDT
			pData._spinAccumY = (pData._spinAccumY or 0) + spinRate.Y * frameDT
			pData._spinAccumZ = (pData._spinAccumZ or 0) + spinRate.Z * frameDT
		end
		local speedMult = pData.SpeedMultiplier or 1
		local spinAddX = pData._spinAccumX or 0
		local spinAddY = pData._spinAccumY or 0
		local spinAddZ = pData._spinAccumZ or 0
		local rotOrder = pData.RotOrder or "Global"

		-- POSITION: Inverted
		if pData.InvertMotion then
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
			local reverseStep = pData.TotalKeyFrames - targetStep
			local localCF = pData.SimLocalCFrames[reverseStep] or pData.SimLocalCFrames[0]
			local parentCF_now = getLinkCF(pData)
			pData.VisualPart:PivotTo(parentCF_now * localCF)
			pData._localWorldCF = localCF
			pData.CurrentPosition = pData.VisualPart:GetPivot().Position

		-- POSITION: Forward, FULL iteration (VelocityVectored)
		elseif pData.NeedsFullIteration then
			local hasDrag = pData.HasDrag
			local hasAccel = pData.HasAccel
			local accelVel = pData._accelVel or Vector3.zero
			for step = prevStep + stepDir, targetStep, stepDir do
				local si = step / pData.TotalKeyFrames
				local elapsedSec = si * pData.LifeTime

				local speed = pData._speedOverride or ((pData._staticSpeed or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed)) * speedMult)
				local draggedSpeed = hasDrag and (speed * math.exp(-pData.Drag * elapsedSec)) or speed

				local displacement
				if hasAccel then
					local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, perStepDT)
					accelVel = accelVel + effA * perStepDT
					displacement = (pData.BaseDirection * draggedSpeed + accelVel) * perStepDT
				else
					displacement = pData.BaseDirection * (draggedSpeed * perStepDT)
				end

				-- PosOffset per-step delta. Telescoping integration across loop iterations.
				displacement = displacement + _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, si)

				local parentCF_now, useVOS = getLinkCF(pData)
				local parentLocalDelta = useVOS and parentCF_now:VectorToObjectSpace(displacement) or displacement
				pData.LocalCF = CFrame.new(parentLocalDelta) * pData.LocalCF

				local rotDamp = pData._settleRotDamp or 1
				local rotSpeedX = (pData._staticRotSpeedX or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedX, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedX)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedY = (pData._staticRotSpeedY or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedY, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedY)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedZ = (pData._staticRotSpeedZ or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedZ, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedZ)) * rotDamp

				local rotationCFrame
				if pData.RotMode == "Speed" then
					pData.AccRotX = pData.AccRotX + rotSpeedX * perStepDT
					pData.AccRotY = pData.AccRotY + rotSpeedY * perStepDT
					pData.AccRotZ = pData.AccRotZ + rotSpeedZ * perStepDT
					rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(rotOrder, pData.AccRotX + spinAddX, pData.AccRotY + spinAddY, pData.AccRotZ + spinAddZ)
				else
					rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(rotOrder, rotSpeedX + spinAddX, rotSpeedY + spinAddY, rotSpeedZ + spinAddZ)
				end

				pData.VisualPart:PivotTo((parentCF_now * pData.LocalCF) * rotationCFrame)
				pData._localWorldCF = pData.LocalCF * rotationCFrame
				pData.CurrentPosition = pData.VisualPart:GetPivot().Position

				local rotatedCF = pData.VisualPart:GetPivot() * pData.SpreadRotation
				local dirInfo = DirectionVectors[pData.EmissionDirection] or DirectionVectors[Enum.NormalId.Top]
				pData.BaseDirection = rotatedCF[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
			end
			pData._accelVel = accelVel
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep

		-- POSITION: Forward, SPEED ROTATION (accumulated rotation)
		elseif pData.NeedsRotAccum then
			local hasDrag = pData.HasDrag
			local hasAccel = pData.HasAccel
			local totalScalarDisp = 0
			local totalAccelDisp = Vector3.zero
			local accelVel = pData._accelVel or Vector3.zero

			for step = prevStep + stepDir, targetStep, stepDir do
				local si = step / pData.TotalKeyFrames
				local elapsedSec = si * pData.LifeTime
				local speed = pData._speedOverride or ((pData._staticSpeed or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed)) * speedMult)
				if hasDrag then speed = speed * math.exp(-pData.Drag * elapsedSec) end
				totalScalarDisp = totalScalarDisp + speed * perStepDT
				if hasAccel then
					local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, perStepDT)
					accelVel = accelVel + effA * perStepDT
					totalAccelDisp = totalAccelDisp + accelVel * perStepDT
				end

				local rotDamp = pData._settleRotDamp or 1
				local rotSpeedX = (pData._staticRotSpeedX or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedX, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedX)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedY = (pData._staticRotSpeedY or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedY, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedY)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedZ = (pData._staticRotSpeedZ or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedZ, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedZ)) * rotDamp
				pData.AccRotX = pData.AccRotX + rotSpeedX * perStepDT
				pData.AccRotY = pData.AccRotY + rotSpeedY * perStepDT
				pData.AccRotZ = pData.AccRotZ + rotSpeedZ * perStepDT
			end
			pData._accelVel = accelVel

			local totalDisplacement = pData.BaseDirection * totalScalarDisp + totalAccelDisp
			totalDisplacement = totalDisplacement + _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames)

			local parentCF_now, useVOS = getLinkCF(pData)
			local parentLocalDelta = useVOS and parentCF_now:VectorToObjectSpace(totalDisplacement) or totalDisplacement
			pData.LocalCF = CFrame.new(parentLocalDelta) * pData.LocalCF
			local rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(rotOrder, pData.AccRotX + spinAddX, pData.AccRotY + spinAddY, pData.AccRotZ + spinAddZ)

			pData.VisualPart:PivotTo((parentCF_now * pData.LocalCF) * rotationCFrame)
			pData._localWorldCF = pData.LocalCF * rotationCFrame
			pData.CurrentPosition = pData.VisualPart:GetPivot().Position
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep

		-- POSITION: Forward, FAST (absolute rotation)
		else
			local hasDrag = pData.HasDrag
			local hasAccel = pData.HasAccel
			local totalScalarDisp = 0
			local totalAccelDisp = Vector3.zero
			local accelVel = pData._accelVel or Vector3.zero

			for step = prevStep + stepDir, targetStep, stepDir do
				local si = step / pData.TotalKeyFrames
				local elapsedSec = si * pData.LifeTime
				local speed = pData._speedOverride or ((pData._staticSpeed or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed)) * speedMult)
				if hasDrag then speed = speed * math.exp(-pData.Drag * elapsedSec) end
				totalScalarDisp = totalScalarDisp + speed * perStepDT
				if hasAccel then
					local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, perStepDT)
					accelVel = accelVel + effA * perStepDT
					totalAccelDisp = totalAccelDisp + accelVel * perStepDT
				end
			end
			pData._accelVel = accelVel

			local totalDisplacement = pData.BaseDirection * totalScalarDisp + totalAccelDisp
			totalDisplacement = totalDisplacement + _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames)

			local parentCF_now, useVOS = getLinkCF(pData)
			local parentLocalDelta = useVOS and parentCF_now:VectorToObjectSpace(totalDisplacement) or totalDisplacement
			pData.LocalCF = CFrame.new(parentLocalDelta) * pData.LocalCF

			local steppedI = targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames
			local rotDamp = pData._settleRotDamp or 1
			local rotX = (pData._staticRotSpeedX or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedX, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedX)) * rotDamp
			local rotY = (pData._staticRotSpeedY or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedY, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedY)) * rotDamp
			local rotZ = (pData._staticRotSpeedZ or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedZ, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedZ)) * rotDamp
			local rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(rotOrder, rotX + spinAddX, rotY + spinAddY, rotZ + spinAddZ)

			pData.VisualPart:PivotTo((parentCF_now * pData.LocalCF) * rotationCFrame)
			pData._localWorldCF = pData.LocalCF * rotationCFrame
			pData.CurrentPosition = pData.VisualPart:GetPivot().Position
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
		end

		-- SCALE: ScaleTo cascades to BaseParts, Meshes, PEs, Beams, Trails.
		local steppedI = targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames
		local scale = math.max(0.001, pData._staticScale or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.Scale, pData.Seeds.Scale))
		pData.VisualPart:ScaleTo(scale)
		-- ScaleTo can drop descendant Beam.Segments below 20; re-clamp.
		if pData._visualBeams then
			for _, beam in ipairs(pData._visualBeams) do
				if beam.Parent and beam.Segments < 20 then beam.Segments = 20 end
			end
		end
	end

	return isDying
end

end

children.source:
--[[
	ZOffset Mixin  -  per-frame position shift along particle→camera line for Part / Model / Attachment.
	Positive = closer to camera. Runs after Orientation so velocity derivation uses pre-shifted position.
]]

return function(Particle)

local EPS = 1e-3

function Particle:ApplyZOffset(pData, camPos)
	local zo = pData.ZOffset
	if not zo or zo == 0 then return end
	if not camPos then return end
	if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return end
	local t = pData.Type
	if t ~= "Part" and t ~= "Model" and t ~= "Attachment" then return end

	local isModel = t == "Model"
	local isAttachment = t == "Attachment"
	-- Use the pre-overlay base CFrame so ZOffset is an absolute shift; reading live would compound each frame.
	local currentCF = pData._postUpdateCF or (isModel and pData.VisualPart:GetPivot() or pData.VisualPart.CFrame)

	-- Attachment.CFrame is parent-local; convert to world for the camera shift, back to local on write.
	local parentPart
	if isAttachment then
		parentPart = pData.VisualPart.Parent
		if parentPart and parentPart:IsA("BasePart") then
			currentCF = parentPart.CFrame * currentCF
		else
			parentPart = nil
		end
	end

	local pos = currentCF.Position
	local toCam = camPos - pos
	local mag = toCam.Magnitude
	if mag < EPS then return end
	local newPos = pos + (toCam / mag) * zo
	local newCF = CFrame.new(newPos) * (currentCF - pos)

	if parentPart then
		newCF = parentPart.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(newCF)
	end

	if isModel then
		pData.VisualPart:PivotTo(newCF)
	else
		pData.VisualPart.CFrame = newCF
	end
end

end

children.source:
--!native
--!optimize 2

local Types = require(script.Types)

local chunkReaders = require(script.chunks)
local crc32 = require(script.crc32)
local zlib = require(script.zlib)

local COLOR_TYPE_CHANNELS = {
	[0] = 1,
	[2] = 3,
	[3] = 1,
	[4] = 2,
	[6] = 4,
}

local INTERLACE_ROW_START = { 0, 0, 4, 0, 2, 0, 1 }
local INTERLACE_COL_START = { 0, 4, 0, 2, 0, 1, 0 }
local INTERLACE_ROW_INCR = { 8, 8, 8, 4, 4, 2, 2 }
local INTERLACE_COL_INCR = { 8, 8, 4, 4, 2, 2, 1 }

-- https://github.com/Kampfkarren/selene/issues/584
-- selene: allow(bad_string_escape)
local SIGNATURE = "\x89PNG\x0D\x0A\x1A\x0A"

export type PNG = Types.PNG

export type DecodeOptions = {
	allowIncorrectCRC: boolean?,
}

export type EncodeOptions = {
	width: number,
	height: number,
}

local function decode(buf: buffer, options: DecodeOptions?): PNG
	local bufLen = buffer.len(buf)
	assert(bufLen >= 8, "not a PNG")
	assert(buffer.readstring(buf, 0, 8) == SIGNATURE, "not a PNG")

	local chunks: { Types.Chunk } = table.create(3) -- minimal: IHDR, IDAT, IEND
	local offset = 8

	local skipCRC = options ~= nil and options.allowIncorrectCRC == true
	repeat
		local dataLength = bit32.byteswap(buffer.readu32(buf, offset))
		local chunkType = buffer.readstring(buf, offset + 4, 4)
		assert(string.match(chunkType, "%a%a%a%a"), `invalid chunk type {chunkType}`)

		local dataOffset = offset + 8
		local nextOffset = dataOffset + dataLength + 4
		assert(nextOffset <= bufLen, `EOF while reading {chunkType} chunk`)

		local chunkCode = bit32.byteswap(buffer.readu32(buf, nextOffset - 4))
		local expectCode = crc32(buf, offset + 4, nextOffset - 5)
		assert(skipCRC or chunkCode == expectCode, `incorrect checksum in {chunkType}`)

		table.insert(chunks, {
			type = chunkType,
			offset = dataOffset,
			length = dataLength,
		})
		offset = nextOffset
	until offset >= bufLen
	assert(offset == bufLen, "trailing data in file")

	for _, chunk in chunks do
		local t = chunk.type
		if bit32.extract(string.byte(t, 1, 1), 5) == 0 then
			if t ~= "IHDR" and t ~= "IDAT" and t ~= "PLTE" and t ~= "IEND" then
				error(`unhandled critical chunk {t}`)
			end
		end
	end

	local header: Types.IHDRChunk
	local headerChunk = chunks[1]
	assert(headerChunk.type == "IHDR", "first chunk must be IHDR")
	for i = 2, #chunks do
		assert(chunks[i].type ~= "IHDR", "multiple IHDR chunks are not allowed")
	end
	header = chunkReaders.IHDR(buf, headerChunk)

	local dataChunkIndex0 = -1
	local dataChunkIndex1 = -1
	local compressedDataLength = 0
	for i, chunk in chunks do
		if chunk.type == "IDAT" then
			if dataChunkIndex0 < 0 then
				dataChunkIndex0 = i
			else
				assert(i == dataChunkIndex1 + 1, "multiple IDAT chunks must be consecutive")
			end
			dataChunkIndex1 = i
			compressedDataLength += chunk.length
		end
	end
	assert(dataChunkIndex0 > 0, "no IDAT chunks")
	assert(compressedDataLength > 0, "no image data in IDAT chunks")

	local palette: Types.PLTEChunk?
	local paletteChunkIndex = -1
	for i, chunk in chunks do
		if chunk.type == "PLTE" then
			assert(not palette, "multiple PLTE chunks are not allowed")
			assert(i < dataChunkIndex0, "PLTE not allowed after IDAT chunks")
			assert(header.colorType ~= 0 and header.colorType ~= 4, "PLTE not allowed for color type")
			palette = chunkReaders.PLTE(buf, chunk, header)
			paletteChunkIndex = i
		end
	end
	if header.colorType == 3 then
		assert(palette ~= nil, "color type requires a PLTE chunk")
	end

	local transparencyData: Types.tRNSChunk?
	for i, chunk in chunks do
		if chunk.type == "tRNS" then
			assert(transparencyData == nil, "multiple tRNS chunks are not allowed")
			assert(i < dataChunkIndex0, "tRNS not allowed after IDAT chunks")
			assert(not palette or i > paletteChunkIndex, "tRNS must be after PLTE")
			assert(header.colorType ~= 4 and header.colorType ~= 6, "tRNS not allowed for color type")
			transparencyData = chunkReaders.tRNS(buf, chunk, header, palette)
		end
	end

	local finalChunk = chunks[#chunks]
	assert(finalChunk.type == "IEND", "final chunk must be IEND")
	assert(finalChunk.length == 0, "IEND chunk must be empty")
	for i = 2, #chunks - 1 do
		assert(chunks[i].type ~= "IEND", "multiple IEND chunks are not allowed")
	end

	local compressedData = buffer.create(compressedDataLength)
	local compressedOffset = 0
	for _, chunk in chunks do
		if chunk.type == "IDAT" then
			buffer.copy(compressedData, compressedOffset, buf, chunk.offset, chunk.length)
			compressedOffset += chunk.length
		end
	end

	local width = header.width
	local height = header.height
	local bitDepth = header.bitDepth
	local colorType = header.colorType
	local channels = COLOR_TYPE_CHANNELS[colorType]

	local rawSize = 0
	if not header.interlaced then
		rawSize = height * (math.ceil(width * channels * bitDepth / 8) + 1)
	else
		for i = 1, 7 do
			local w = math.ceil((width - INTERLACE_COL_START[i]) / INTERLACE_COL_INCR[i])
			local h = math.ceil((height - INTERLACE_ROW_START[i]) / INTERLACE_ROW_INCR[i])
			if w > 0 and h > 0 then
				local scanlineSize = math.ceil(w * channels * bitDepth / 8) + 1
				rawSize += h * scanlineSize
			end
		end
	end

	local paletteColors
	if palette then
		paletteColors = palette.colors
	end

	local rescale
	if colorType ~= 3 and bitDepth < 8 then
		rescale = 0xFF / (2 ^ bitDepth - 1)
	end

	local bpp = math.ceil(channels * bitDepth / 8)
	local defaultAlpha = 2 ^ bitDepth - 1

	local idx = 0
	local working = buffer.create(rawSize)
	local inflatedSize = zlib.inflate(compressedData, working)
	assert(inflatedSize == rawSize, "decompressed data size mismatch")

	local rgba8 = buffer.create(width * height * 4)

	local alphaGray = if transparencyData then transparencyData.gray else -1
	local alphaRed = if transparencyData then transparencyData.red else -1
	local alphaGreen = if transparencyData then transparencyData.green else -1
	local alphaBlue = if transparencyData then transparencyData.blue else -1

	local function pass(sx: number, sy: number, dx: number, dy: number)
		local w = math.ceil((width - sx) / dx)
		local h = math.ceil((height - sy) / dy)
		if w < 1 or h < 1 then
			return
		end

		local scanlineSize = math.ceil(w * channels * bitDepth / 8)
		local newIdx = idx

		for y = 1, h do
			local rowFilter = buffer.readu8(working, idx)
			idx += 1

			if rowFilter == 0 or (rowFilter == 2 and y == 1) then
				idx += scanlineSize
			elseif rowFilter == 1 then
				for x = 1, scanlineSize do
					local sub = if x <= bpp then 0 else buffer.readu8(working, idx - bpp)
					local value = bit32.band(buffer.readu8(working, idx) + sub, 0xFF)
					buffer.writeu8(working, idx, value)
					idx += 1
				end
			elseif rowFilter == 2 then
				for _ = 1, scanlineSize do
					local up = buffer.readu8(working, idx - scanlineSize - 1)
					local value = bit32.band(buffer.readu8(working, idx) + up, 0xFF)
					buffer.writeu8(working, idx, value)
					idx += 1
				end
			elseif rowFilter == 3 then
				for x = 1, scanlineSize do
					local sub = if x <= bpp then 0 else buffer.readu8(working, idx - bpp)
					local up = if y == 1 then 0 else buffer.readu8(working, idx - scanlineSize - 1)
					local value = bit32.band(buffer.readu8(working, idx) + bit32.rshift(sub + up, 1), 0xFF)
					buffer.writeu8(working, idx, value)
					idx += 1
				end
			elseif rowFilter == 4 then
				for x = 1, scanlineSize do
					local sub = if x <= bpp then 0 else buffer.readu8(working, idx - bpp)
					local up = if y == 1 then 0 else buffer.readu8(working, idx - scanlineSize - 1)
					local corner = if x <= bpp or y == 1
						then 0
						else buffer.readu8(working, idx - scanlineSize - bpp - 1)
					local p0 = math.abs(up - corner)
					local p1 = math.abs(sub - corner)
					local p2 = math.abs(sub + up - 2 * corner)
					local paeth = if p0 <= p1 and p0 <= p2 then sub elseif p1 <= p2 then up else corner
					local value = bit32.band(buffer.readu8(working, idx) + paeth, 0xFF)
					buffer.writeu8(working, idx, value)
					idx += 1
				end
			else
				error("invalid row filter")
			end
		end

		local bit = 8
		local function readValue()
			local b = buffer.readu8(working, newIdx)
			if bitDepth < 8 then
				b = bit32.extract(b, bit - bitDepth, bitDepth)
				bit -= bitDepth
				if bit == 0 then
					bit = 8
					newIdx += 1
				end
			elseif bitDepth == 8 then
				newIdx += 1
			else
				b = bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(b, 8), buffer.readu8(working, newIdx + 1))
				newIdx += 2
			end
			return b
		end

		for y = 1, h do
			newIdx += 1
			if bit < 8 then
				bit = 8
				newIdx += 1
			end

			for x = 1, w do
				local r, g, b, a

				if colorType == 0 then
					local gray = readValue()
					r = gray
					g = gray
					b = gray
					a = if gray == alphaGray then 0 else defaultAlpha
				elseif colorType == 2 then
					r = readValue()
					g = readValue()
					b = readValue()
					a = if r == alphaRed and g == alphaGreen and b == alphaBlue then 0 else defaultAlpha
				elseif colorType == 3 then
					local color = paletteColors[readValue() + 1]
					r = color.r
					g = color.g
					b = color.b
					a = color.a
				elseif colorType == 4 then
					local gray = readValue()
					r = gray
					g = gray
					b = gray
					a = readValue()
				elseif colorType == 6 then
					r = readValue()
					g = readValue()
					b = readValue()
					a = readValue()
				end

				local py = sy + (y - 1) * dy
				local px = sx + (x - 1) * dx
				local i = (py * width + px) * 4

				if rescale then
					r = math.round(r * rescale)
					g = math.round(g * rescale)
					b = math.round(b * rescale)
					a = math.round(a * rescale)
				elseif bitDepth == 16 then
					r = bit32.rshift(r, 8)
					g = bit32.rshift(g, 8)
					b = bit32.rshift(b, 8)
					a = bit32.rshift(a, 8)
				end

				buffer.writeu32(rgba8, i, bit32.bor(bit32.lshift(a, 24), bit32.lshift(b, 16), bit32.lshift(g, 8), r))
			end
		end
	end

	if not header.interlaced then
		pass(0, 0, 1, 1)
	else
		for i = 1, 7 do
			pass(INTERLACE_COL_START[i], INTERLACE_ROW_START[i], INTERLACE_COL_INCR[i], INTERLACE_ROW_INCR[i])
		end
	end

	local function readPixel(x: number, y: number)
		assert(x >= 1 and x <= width and y >= 1 and y <= height, "pixel out of range")

		local i = ((y - 1) * width + x - 1) * 4
		return buffer.readu8(rgba8, i),
			buffer.readu8(rgba8, i + 1),
			buffer.readu8(rgba8, i + 2),
			buffer.readu8(rgba8, i + 3)
	end

	return {
		width = width,
		height = height,
		pixels = rgba8,
		readPixel = readPixel,
	}
end

local function encode(pixels: buffer, options: EncodeOptions): buffer
	local width = options.width
	local height = options.height

	local dataSize = buffer.len(pixels)
	local expectSize = width * height * 4
	assert(dataSize == expectSize, `expected {expectSize} bytes, got {dataSize} bytes`)

	local imageDataRowSize = width * 4 + 1
	local imageData = buffer.create(height * imageDataRowSize)
	for row = 0, height - 1 do
		local sourceOffset = row * width * 4
		local targetOffset = row * imageDataRowSize
		buffer.writeu8(imageData, targetOffset, 0) -- filter method = 0
		buffer.copy(imageData, targetOffset + 1, pixels, sourceOffset, 4 * width)
	end

	local imageDataDeflated, imageDataDeflatedLength = zlib.deflate(imageData)
	local outputLength = 8 -- signature
		+ 25 -- IHDR
		+ (8 + imageDataDeflatedLength + 4) -- IDAT
		+ 12 -- IEND

	local output = buffer.create(outputLength)
	buffer.writestring(output, 0, SIGNATURE)

	-- IHDR
	buffer.writeu32(output, 8, bit32.byteswap(13)) -- chunk length
	buffer.writestring(output, 12, "IHDR")
	buffer.writeu32(output, 16, bit32.byteswap(width))
	buffer.writeu32(output, 20, bit32.byteswap(height))
	buffer.writeu8(output, 24, 8) -- 8-bit depth
	buffer.writeu8(output, 25, 6) -- rgba color
	buffer.writeu8(output, 26, 0) -- deflate compression
	buffer.writeu8(output, 27, 0) -- adaptive filtering
	buffer.writeu8(output, 28, 0) -- non-interlaced
	buffer.writeu32(output, 29, bit32.byteswap(crc32(output, 12, 28)))

	-- IDAT
	buffer.writeu32(output, 33, bit32.byteswap(imageDataDeflatedLength))
	buffer.writestring(output, 37, "IDAT")
	buffer.copy(output, 41, imageDataDeflated, 0, imageDataDeflatedLength)
	local x = 41 + imageDataDeflatedLength
	buffer.writeu32(output, x, bit32.byteswap(crc32(output, 37, x - 1)))

	-- IEND
	buffer.writeu32(output, x + 4, 0)
	buffer.writestring(output, x + 8, "IEND")
	buffer.writeu32(output, x + 12, 0x826042AE)

	return output
end

return {
	decode = decode,
	encode = encode,
}

IHDR
children.source:
local Types = require(script.Parent.Parent.Types)

local COLOR_TYPE_BIT_DEPTH = {
	[0] = { 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 },
	[2] = { 8, 16 },
	[3] = { 1, 2, 4, 8 },
	[4] = { 8, 16 },
	[6] = { 8, 16 },
}

local function read(buf: buffer, chunk: Types.Chunk): Types.IHDRChunk
	assert(chunk.length == 13, "IHDR data must be 13 bytes")

	local offset = chunk.offset

	local width = bit32.byteswap(buffer.readu32(buf, offset))
	local height = bit32.byteswap(buffer.readu32(buf, offset + 4))
	local bitDepth = buffer.readu8(buf, offset + 8)
	local colorType = buffer.readu8(buf, offset + 9)
	local compression = buffer.readu8(buf, offset + 10)
	local filter = buffer.readu8(buf, offset + 11)
	local interlace = buffer.readu8(buf, offset + 12)

	assert(width > 0 and width <= 2 ^ 31 and height > 0 and height <= 2 ^ 31, "invalid dimensions")
	assert(compression == 0, "invalid compression method")
	assert(filter == 0, "invalid filter method")
	assert(interlace == 0 or interlace == 1, "invalid interlace method")

	local allowedBitDepth = COLOR_TYPE_BIT_DEPTH[colorType]
	assert(allowedBitDepth ~= nil, "invalid color type")
	assert(table.find(allowedBitDepth, bitDepth) ~= nil, "invalid bit depth")

	return {
		width = width,
		height = height,
		bitDepth = bitDepth,
		colorType = colorType,
		interlaced = interlace == 1,
	}
end

return read
